paras.en: NASA’s Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the moon in April — the first time humans had been anywhere near our natural satellite in more than 50 years. Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen spent about seven hours in close proximity to the moon taking scientific observations, describing the moon’s surprising colors and textures and witnessing a solar eclipse from space.
paras.zh: 今年 4 月，美国宇航局的阿耳忒弥斯二号任务派出四名宇航员进行了为期 10 天的绕月之旅，这是 50 多年来人类首次接近我们的天然卫星。宇航员里德·怀斯曼（Reid Wiseman）、维克多·格洛弗（Victor Glover）、克里斯蒂娜·科赫（Christina Koch）和杰里米·汉森（Jeremy Hansen）在月球附近进行了大约七个小时的科学观测，描述了月球令人惊讶的颜色和纹理，并从太空目睹了日食。

paras.en: Almost all of that event was livestreamed. But the astronauts took thousands of photos, notes and audio recordings that weren’t immediately made public. Part of the science team’s job was to digest those observations and release the data to anyone who wants to study them within six months of splashdown on April 10.
paras.zh: 几乎所有活动都进行了现场直播。但宇航员拍摄了数千张照片、笔记和录音，这些照片、笔记和录音并未立即公开。科学团队的部分工作是消化这些观察结果，并在 4 月 10 日溅落后的六个月内向任何想要研究这些数据的人发布数据。

paras.en: With three days to spare, the team released three reports and a massive data archive on October 7, the 67th anniversary of when the Soviet Luna 3 spacecraft took the first photograph of the farside of the moon. The results offer a rare test of what trained human observers can add to lunar research and what NASA can learn for future missions to the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日是苏联月球 3 号宇宙飞船拍摄第一张月球背面照片 67 周年，利用三天的时间，该团队发布了三份报告和大量数据档案。这些结果提供了一次罕见的测试，检验训练有素的人类观察者可以为月球研究添加什么，以及美国宇航局可以为未来的月球表面任务学到什么。

paras.en: “We’re really excited to release all of this data,” earth scientist Sara Schmidt of NASA Johnson Space flight Cener in Houston said during the meeting. After six months of hard work, “this is enabling science to happen for the next, I don’t know, 60 years, if not more.”
paras.zh: “我们非常高兴能够发布所有这些数据，”休斯敦美国宇航局约翰逊太空飞行中心的地球科学家萨拉·施密特在会议上说道。经过六个月的努力，“这将使科学在未来，我不知道，60 年，甚至更长时间内继续发展。”

paras.en: How astronauts learn to observe the moon
paras.zh: 宇航员如何学习观察月球

paras.en: Surprisingly, the most valuable data from the mission were not the mind-blowingly gorgeous photos, but the astronauts’ verbal and written descriptions of what they were seeing.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，这次任务中最有价值的数据并不是令人惊叹的华丽照片，而是宇航员对所见事物的口头和书面描述。

paras.en: Before launch, the astronauts had extensive training in lunar geology and science observations. They were an extension of the science team, said field geologist Cindy Evans also of NASA Johnson Space Flight Center, one of the astronauts’ instructors.
paras.zh: 在发射之前，宇航员接受了月球地质学和科学观测方面的广泛培训。美国宇航局约翰逊太空飞行中心的现场地质学家辛迪·埃文斯（Cindy Evans）是宇航员的教练之一，他说，他们是科学团队的延伸。

paras.en: “You could hear it in their voices. They understood the language of geology,” she said.
paras.zh: “你可以从他们的声音中听到这一点。他们懂得地质学的语言，”她说。

paras.en: That training was meant to help answer a question Young hears often: What can humans add that a camera can’t?
paras.zh: 这项训练旨在帮助回答杨经常听到的一个问题：人类可以添加哪些相机不能添加的内容？

paras.en: During the flyby, the astronauts worked in pairs. Two of them spoke to mission control on the ground, giving periodic updates to the science team on what they were seeing. The other two recorded themselves describing their observations and reactions and used a stylus to annotate specially made maps of the moon that had been uploaded to their tablets during flight. Those notes, doodles and recordings were not made public until now.
paras.zh: 在飞越过程中，宇航员两人一组工作。其中两人与地面任务控制中心进行了交谈，定期向科学团队通报他们所看到的情况。另外两人记录了自己的观察和反应，并使用手写笔注释了特制的月球地图，这些地图在飞行过程中上传到了他们的平板电脑上。这些笔记、涂鸦和录音直到现在才被公开。

paras.en: The idea was to give the crew high tech field notebooks, Young says.
paras.zh: 杨说，这个想法是为船员提供高科技野外笔记本。

paras.en: “If you have any field experience, you know your field notebook is your best friend,” she said in the meeting. On Earth, geologists capture nuance and context in written and spoken words, as well as sketches, she said. “We wanted to provide the ability to capture that nuanced information from the crew.”
paras.zh: “如果你有任何现场经验，你就会知道你的现场笔记本是你最好的朋友，”她在会议上说。她说，在地球上，地质学家通过书面和口头文字以及草图捕捉细微差别和背景。 “我们希望提供从机组人员那里捕获细微信息的能力。”

paras.en: One example of this was when Koch sketched her view of the Orientale basin, detailing differences in texture and layers around the crater.
paras.zh: 其中一个例子是科赫描绘了她对东方盆地的看法，详细描述了火山口周围纹理和层次的差异。

paras.en: “Sketches can be so powerful,” Young says. “They’re quick and dirty and that’s exactly the right thing to do. You’re capturing that nuance really quickly before it leaves your brain.”
paras.zh: “草图可以如此强大，”杨说。 “它们又快又脏，这正是正确的做法。在它离开你的大脑之前，你很快就能捕捉到这种细微差别。”

paras.en: Some of the most unique observations came during the 54 minutes when the moon eclipsed the sun, giving the astronauts a view of the solar corona, interplanetary dust and other stars and planets. That was a favorite moment for planetary scientist Jennifer Heldmann of NASA’s Ames Research Center in California.
paras.zh: 一些最独特的观测发生在月球遮住太阳的 54 分钟期间，宇航员可以看到日冕、行星际尘埃以及其他恒星和行星。这是美国宇航局加利福尼亚州艾姆斯研究中心的行星科学家詹妮弗·赫尔德曼最喜欢的时刻。

paras.en: “That audio showed their sheer joy and amazement in what they were seeing and where they were,” Heldmann says. “They were so blown away by what they were seeing, while also taking very relevant science observations.”
paras.zh: “这段音频显示了他们对所看到的事物和所在位置的纯粹的喜悦和惊讶，”赫尔德曼说。 “他们对所看到的一切感到非常震惊，同时也进行了非常相关的科学观察。”

paras.en: But some of the most affecting moments were when words failed. When Glover and Koch saw the Earth emerge from behind the moon, for a while all they could say was “Oh my gosh!”
paras.zh: 但一些最感人的时刻是言语无法表达的时候。当格洛弗和科赫看到地球从月球后面出现时，有一段时间他们只能说“天哪！”

paras.en: “I guess I should be trying to describe it, but I mean, good grief,” Glover’s tablet recorded him saying.
paras.zh: “我想我应该尝试描述一下，但我的意思是，天哪，”格洛弗的平板电脑记录了他的说法。

paras.en: “No, I tried, but it’s impossible,” Koch agreed. “You might be able to fly a spaceship and talk, but if you can see that and talk, you just ain’t right.”
paras.zh: “不，我试过了，但这是不可能的，”科赫同意道。 “你也许能够驾驶宇宙飞船并说话，但如果你能看到它并说话，那你就是不对的。”

paras.en: Astronauts spotted tiny impacts on the moon
paras.zh: 宇航员发现月球上的微小撞击

paras.en: Another thing the astronauts were able to see during the eclipse were impact flashes — tiny blips of light marking where bits of rock hit the moon.
paras.zh: 宇航员在日食期间能够看到的另一件事是撞击闪光——微小的光点标志着岩石碎片撞击月球的位置。

paras.en: “It’s a pinpoint of light,” Hansen said in his recorded observations. “It’s not like a meteor, you didn’t see anything else, it’s just like a bloop.”
paras.zh: “这是一个精确的光点，”汉森在他的观察记录中说道。 “它不像流星，你没有看到任何其他东西，它只是像一个斑点。”

paras.en: Before launch, the science team identified and prioritized observations they hoped the crew would be able to make during the flyby. Impact flashes were at the top of the list. Seeing the flashes would give scientists a way to estimate how often the moon is struck by incoming rocks, and how large those rocks are. That’s an important thing to know for protecting future missions where astronauts will walk on the surface or build a long-term moon base.
paras.zh: 在发射之前，科学团队确定了他们希望机组人员在飞越过程中能够进行的观察结果并确定了优先顺序。冲击闪光位居榜首。看到闪光将使科学家能够估计月球被撞击岩石的频率以及这些岩石有多大。对于保护宇航员在月球表面行走或建立长期月球基地的未来任务来说，了解这一点非常重要。

paras.en: Scientists didn’t know whether the astronauts would see any flashes at all. They saw five. The flashes were “pinpricks of light lasting less than a second, with no color associated with the flash,” Heldmann said at the meeting.
paras.zh: 科学家们根本不知道宇航员是否会看到任何闪光。他们看到了五个。赫尔德曼在会议上说，这些闪光是“持续时间不到一秒的针刺光，没有与闪光相关的颜色”。

paras.en: Comparing the number of flashes per minute to theoretical models of how many impacts the moon might experience, scientists determined that the incoming rocks were tiny, about 8.5 grams and just over 4.5 centimeters across — about the size of a golf ball.
paras.zh: 通过将每分钟的闪光次数与月球可能经历的撞击次数的理论模型进行比较，科学家们确定，传入的岩石很小，约为 8.5 克，直径略多于 4.5 厘米，大约相当于高尔夫球的大小。

paras.en: “With these observations, we believe that the Artemis II crew set a record for the smallest meteorites ever optically observed to impact the moon,” Heldmann said.
paras.zh: 赫尔德曼说：“通过这些观察，我们相信阿耳忒弥斯二号机组人员创造了有史以来光学观测到撞击月球的最小陨石的记录。”

paras.en: The resulting craters are probably less than a meter wide, too small for cameras on NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter to see.
paras.zh: 由此产生的陨石坑可能不到一米宽，对于美国宇航局月球勘测轨道飞行器上的相机来说太小了。

paras.en: That’s good news for future astronauts. Artemis IV, planned for 2028, is supposed to bring astronauts to the lunar surface for the first time since Apollo. If successful, it will be a two-week mission using landers from spaceflight companies Blue Origin or SpaceX. The probability of dangerous impact during such a mission is less than 1 in 10 million, Heldmann said. For a larger moon base meant to last a decade, the probability is higher, but still low.
paras.zh: 这对未来的宇航员来说是个好消息。计划于 2028 年进行的阿耳忒弥斯四号计划将继阿波罗计划之后首次将宇航员送上月球表面。如果成功，这将是一次为期两周的任务，使用航天公司 Blue Origin 或 SpaceX 的着陆器。赫尔德曼说，在此类任务中发生危险撞击的可能性小于千万分之一。对于一个打算持续十年的更大的月球基地来说，可能性更高，但仍然很低。

paras.en: “Now we can start to quantify those impact probabilities, which turns out are very very low,” she says. “Crews will be very safe.”
paras.zh: “现在我们可以开始量化这些影响概率，结果证明这些概率非常非常低，”她说。 “工作人员将会非常安全。”

paras.en: The moon’s muted colors were another high-priority observation for the science team. Lunar hues and brightnesses can change with terrain roughness, surface temperature and mineralogy — and they’re much more discernable with human eyes than with cameras. The crew also saw how colors changed as the viewing angle and light levels changed.
paras.zh: 月亮的柔和颜色是科学团队的另一个高度优先的观测。月球的色调和亮度会随着地形粗糙度、表面温度和矿物学的变化而变化——而且人眼比相机更容易辨别它们。工作人员还看到颜色如何随着视角和光照水平的变化而变化。

paras.en: “This is such a cool demonstration of the value of human eyes as scientific sensors,” said planetary scientist Ariel Deutsch, also of NASA Ames.
paras.zh: “这非常酷地证明了人眼作为科学传感器的价值，”同样来自美国宇航局艾姆斯研究中心的行星科学家阿里尔·多伊奇 (Ariel Deutsch) 说道。

paras.en: Combining the crew’s observations with other data going back to the 1970s let scientists connect colors to composition. Blues were associated with titanium-rich volcanic rocks. Browns reflect different iron levels. Greens are from glass formed during volcanic eruptions or asteroid impacts.
paras.zh: 将机组人员的观察结果与 20 世纪 70 年代的其他数据相结合，科学家们将颜色与构图联系起来。蓝色与富含钛的火山岩有关。棕色反映了不同的铁含量。绿色是由火山爆发或小行星撞击期间形成的玻璃制成的。

paras.en: Future astronauts could use this information to create terrain maps and to find specific materials on the moon for sample collection or resources.
paras.zh: 未来的宇航员可以利用这些信息来创建地形图，并在月球上寻找特定材料以收集样本或资源。

paras.en: The crew also was enamored with the terminator, the boundary between light and dark, which revealed lunar topography in a new way.
paras.zh: 船员们还着迷于“明暗界限”，它以一种新的方式揭示了月球的地形。

paras.en: “Even as rugged as the far side looks … man, when you look at the terminator, it is just, like, impossibly rugged,” Wiseman said during the flight. “And it reminds you that the whole farside is that way. It’s just the terminator is really bringing out the shadows and the hills and the valleys. And it is just — it’s unbelievable.”
paras.zh: 怀斯曼在飞行过程中说：“即使远方看起来很崎岖……伙计，当你看终结者时，它就像是难以置信的崎岖不平。” “它提醒你，整个远端都是那样的。只是终结者真正带出了阴影、丘陵和山谷。这只是——这令人难以置信。”

paras.en: The lighting at the terminator is similar to what future astronauts might expect at the moon’s south pole, where the sun will be low on the horizon and may cast dramatic shadows.
paras.zh: 明暗界线处的照明类似于未来宇航员在月球南极所期望的照明，在那里太阳将位于地平线下方，并可能投射出戏剧性的阴影。

paras.en: “We want to make sure we have a good handle on that for both science and operations and exploration,” Heldmann said.
paras.zh: 赫尔德曼说：“我们希望确保我们能够很好地处理科学、运营和勘探方面的问题。”

paras.en: What Artemis II taught NASA for future moon missions
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号教会了美国宇航局未来的月球任务

paras.en: With the lessons from Artemis II in hand, now it’s the next astronauts’ turn.
paras.zh: 有了阿尔忒弥斯二号的经验教训，现在轮到下一位宇航员了。

paras.en: Some recommendations coming out of Artemis II focus on improving conditions in the spacecraft and weaving science into mission planning better. For example, due to time constraints, the astronauts’ cameras were not calibrated before flight. The team is now trying to calibrate them back on Earth, but it can’t re-create how the windows affected images because the windows were charred on the way back through Earth’s atmosphere.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号提出的一些建议侧重于改善航天器的条件，并将科学更好地融入任务规划中。例如，由于时间限制，宇航员的相机在飞行前没有进行校准。该团队现在正试图在地球上校准它们，但无法重现窗户如何影响图像，因为窗户在返回地球大气层的途中被烧焦。

paras.en: Another takeaway from Artemis II is to continue to refine and train astronauts in descriptive notetaking. The audio notes will be even more important for the first landed missions, where astronauts in spacesuits will not be able to write in a notebook.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号的另一个收获是继续完善和训练宇航员进行描述性笔记。对于第一次着陆任务来说，音频笔记将更加重要，因为穿着宇航服的宇航员将无法在笔记本上书写。

paras.en: “We want to train astronauts to be field scientists, regardless of the landing site, regardless of the mission that they’re given,” Young says.
paras.zh: “我们希望将宇航员训练成现场科学家，无论着陆地点如何，无论他们承担的任务是什么，”杨说。

paras.en: The buddy system of two astronauts at the windows, two talking to the ground, led to better science, the team concluded.
paras.zh: 研究小组得出结论，两名宇航员在窗户旁、两人与地面交谈的伙伴系统带来了更好的科学结果。

paras.en: “The crew had scientific discussions and tried to understand what they were viewing,” Heldmann says. For surface missions, where time is limited and choices must be made quickly, that collaboration will be even more important.
paras.zh: “工作人员进行了科学讨论，并试图了解他们所看到的内容，”赫尔德曼说。对于时间有限且必须快速做出选择的地面任务，协作将更加重要。

paras.en: The crew also commented on how helpful it was.
paras.zh: 工作人员还评论说它有多么有帮助。

paras.en: “When we actually do go down there to the surface, I know for safety reasons that we would never send someone alone, but I just want to really emphasize how important the discussion time was,” Glover said. “When we started to talk, we not only got better science discussion, we got better human connection.”
paras.zh: “当我们真正到地面时，我知道出于安全原因，我们永远不会单独派人，但我只是想真正强调讨论时间的重要性，”格洛弗说。 “当我们开始交谈时，我们不仅得到了更好的科学讨论，而且得到了更好的人际关系。”

articles.title: Horned dinosaurs’ weapons evolved to handle the forces of combat
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: Triceratops’ massive skulls were built for horn-to-horn grappling. The rhino-like Centrosaurus could withstand stabbing its nose horn up and down. And the parrot-faced Psittacosaurus would have been wise to avoid a fight: Its head was ill-suited to handle blows.
paras.zh: 三角龙巨大的头骨是为角对角格斗而建造的。像犀牛一样的尖角龙可以承受上下刺伤它的鼻角。鹦鹉嘴龙应该明智地避免战斗：它的头部不适合承受打击。

paras.en: New simulations using 3-D models of the heads of five different horned dinosaurs reveal what forces the skulls could withstand in battle. The results provide insight into how these dinosaurs evolved to use their face-based armory in combat, researchers report September 24 in PeerJ.
paras.zh: 使用五种不同有角恐龙头部的 3D 模型进行的新模拟揭示了头骨在战斗中可以承受的力量。研究人员于 9 月 24 日在 PeerJ 上发表报告称，这些结果让我们深入了解这些恐龙如何进化到在战斗中使用基于面部的军械库。

paras.en: Ceratopsians — horned dinosaurs like Triceratops — have been hypothesized to use their imposing headgear as armaments for battling with other members of the species.
paras.zh: 角龙——像三角龙一样有角的恐龙——被认为会使用它们雄伟的头饰作为与该物种其他成员战斗的武器。

paras.en: Fossilized facial injuries consistent with head-to-head violence have provided physical clues. “We know from many fossils that ceratopsian skulls tended to get banged up a little bit … in very particular spots on the frill or on the cheek,” says Andrew Farke, a paleontologist at Raymond M. Alf Museum of Paleontology in Claremont, California. But little else was known about how ceratopsians actually used their horns in battle.
paras.zh: 与头对头暴力相符的面部损伤化石提供了物理线索。 “我们从许多化石中得知，角龙的头骨往往会受到一点撞击……特别是在褶边或脸颊上的特定位置，”加利福尼亚州克莱蒙特市雷蒙德·M·阿尔夫古生物学博物馆的古生物学家安德鲁·法克说。但人们对角龙在战斗中如何实际使用它们的角知之甚少。

paras.en: Studying the biomechanics of the animals’ weaponized skulls could provide information on what movements and forces the dinosaurs evolved to tolerate. Such biomechanics research had previously been done on the bite stresses of theropod dinosaurs like Tyrannosaurus and on the forces felt by the club tails of armored dinosaurs, says vertebrate paleontologist Eric Austin Ames Jr.
paras.zh: 研究动物武器化头骨的生物力学可以提供有关恐龙进化到能够承受哪些运动和力量的信息。脊椎动物古生物学家小埃里克·奥斯汀·艾姆斯 (Eric Austin Ames Jr.) 表示，此类生物力学研究以前是针对暴龙等兽脚亚目恐龙的咬合应力以及装甲恐龙的棒尾所感受到的力进行的。

paras.en: Ames and his colleagues at the University of Bristol in England developed digital 3-D models of six skulls across five ceratopsian species spread across the group’s evolutionary tree. They simulated the combat stress experienced across the skull, varying the direction of attack and how the weaponry was used. Higher stresses in the skull meant a greater risk of mechanical failure, Ames says. The dinosaurs are more likely to have evolved to fight in a way that was well-tolerated by the skull’s mechanics.
paras.zh: 艾姆斯和他在英国布里斯托大学的同事开发了数字 3D 模型，其中包含五个角龙物种的六个头骨，这些物种分布在该群体的进化树上。他们模拟了头骨上所经历的战斗压力，改变了攻击方向和武器的使用方式。艾姆斯说，头骨中的应力越高，机械故障的风险就越大。恐龙更有可能进化成一种头骨结构能够很好耐受的战斗方式。

paras.en: The team found that early members of the group from about 125 million years ago — like the hornless, husky-sized Psittacosaurus — didn’t have skulls well-suited for combat of any type. The pig-sized Protoceratops had a skull that tolerated ramming fairly well. Larger, later-diverging species like Centrosaurus and the three-horned Triceratops and Spiclypeus appeared adapted to a wider range of combat styles.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，大约 1.25 亿年前该群体的早期成员——比如无角、体型哈士奇的鹦鹉嘴龙——没有适合任何类型战斗的头骨。猪大小的原角龙的头骨能够很好地承受撞击。较大的、后来分化的物种，如尖角龙、三角三角龙和尖角龙，似乎适应了更广泛的战斗风格。

paras.en: Centrosaurus may have been a specialized stabber, lunging its head to jab at opponents. “When we tested [the skull] with vertical forces, it actually handled the stresses really well,” Ames says. “But when we tried side-to-side, it did not perform very well.”In contrast, Triceratops and Spiclypeus had skulls that tolerate the forces generated by interlocking horns and wrestling.
paras.zh: 尖角龙可能是一种专门的刺伤者，用它的头刺向对手。 “当我们用垂直力测试[头骨]时，它实际上很好地处理了压力，”艾姆斯说。 “但当我们尝试并排时，它的表现并不是很好。”相比之下，三角龙和尖角龙的头骨可以承受角交错和摔跤产生的力量。

paras.en: Ames thinks ceratopsians’ horns and frills probably first evolved for social and sexual display, but were soon used for full contact purposes. “Throughout their evolutionary history, their [horns’ traits] started to really explode in diversity and that coincided with different intraspecific combat styles,” he says. “This is something we see in modern herbivores.”
paras.zh: 艾姆斯认为角龙的角和饰边可能最初是为了社交和性展示而进化的，但很快就被用于充分接触的目的。 “在它们的进化史上，它们的[角的特征]开始真正爆发出多样性，这与不同的种内战斗风格相吻合，”他说。 “这是我们在现代食草动物身上看到的。”

paras.en: Much like with the antlers and horns of modern deer, buffalo or antelope, these weapons could have easily been turned on predators as well. “These adaptations are kind of like a Swiss Army knife,” Ames says. “They can be used for multiple things.”
paras.zh: 就像现代鹿、水牛或羚羊的鹿角和角一样，这些武器也可以很容易地用来攻击掠食者。 “这些改编有点像瑞士军刀，”艾姆斯说。 “它们可以用于多种用途。”

paras.en: The team created its 3-D models from surface scans of fossilized skulls. More detailed models that better simulate the complicated internal structure of these dinosaurs’ immense, bizarre skulls could provide even more insight to this prehistoric fight club, Farke says.
paras.zh: 该团队根据头骨化石的表面扫描创建了 3D 模型。法克说，更详细的模型可以更好地模拟这些恐龙巨大而奇异的头骨的复杂内部结构，可以为这个史前搏击俱乐部提供更多的见解。

articles.title: New Genus of Nightmare Spaghetti Worms Found Deep Under The Indian Ocean
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: Just when you thought it was safe to enter the benthic depths of the Indian Ocean, a new eldritch horror emerges from the darkness.
paras.zh: 就在您认为可以安全进入印度洋海底深处时，黑暗中出现了新的恐怖恐怖。

paras.en: Hundreds of meters below the waves off the coasts of Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands, scientists have found a whole new genus of seafloor-dwelling worms.
paras.zh: 在圣诞岛和科科斯（基林）群岛海岸海浪以下数百米处，科学家们发现了一种全新的海底蠕虫属。

paras.en: They're known as spaghetti worms, but their resemblance to delicious pasta is more of a nightmare variety – a horrible tangle of spaghetti-like tendrils writhing from a squishy body that spends its life sheltered inside a protective tube.
paras.zh: 它们被称为意大利面蠕虫，但它们与美味意大利面的相似之处更像是一种噩梦——一团可怕的意大利面状卷须从柔软的身体中扭动起来，一生都被保护在保护管内。

paras.en: It's that squishy body that makes the three species assigned to the new genus Terebellosuctoria stand out: On their undersides are modified pads that form strange, sucker-like structures unlike those of any other known genus of spaghetti worm.
paras.zh: 正是这种柔软的身体使属于新属 Terebellosuctoria 的三个物种脱颖而出：它们的底面有经过改造的肉垫，形成奇怪的吸盘状结构，与任何其他已知的意大利面条虫属不同。

paras.en: While the team of scientists that described the genus in a paper published in Records of the Australian Museum has some clues, the purpose of the suckers is something of a mystery.
paras.zh: 虽然在《澳大利亚博物馆记录》上发表的一篇论文中描述该属的科学家团队掌握了一些线索，但吸盘的用途仍然是个谜。

paras.en: They could be for sucking out the souls of drowned sailors, for all we know.
paras.zh: 据我们所知，它们可能是为了吸出溺水水手的灵魂。

paras.en: "The sucker-like structure is what makes this new genus so interesting and unique," says marine zoologist Elena Kupriyanova of the Australian Museum, the paper's first author.
paras.zh: 该论文的第一作者、澳大利亚博物馆的海洋动物学家埃琳娜·库普里亚诺娃（Elena Kupriyanova）说：“吸盘状结构使这个新属如此有趣和独特。”

paras.en: Actually, for all their somewhat alarming appearance outside of their habitat, spaghetti worms are relatively unassuming little creatures. Their family, Terebellidae, is related to earthworms, in fact – although the spaghetti worms' anatomy is significantly more baroque.
paras.zh: 事实上，尽管意大利面条虫在栖息地之外的外表有些令人担忧，但它们是相对不起眼​​的小生物。事实上，它们的家族（Terebellidae）与蚯蚓有亲缘关系——尽管意大利面条虫的解剖结构明显更加巴洛克式。

paras.en: They usually plonk themselves into the seabed, building a tube for protection, and extending their tentacles – the 'spaghetti' – to truffle out tasty morsels from the surrounding sediment.
paras.zh: 它们通常会潜入海底，建造一根管子进行保护，并伸出触手（“意大利面条”），从周围的沉积物中挖出美味的松饼。

paras.en: They're also not exclusive to the deep ocean. Many Terebellid worms live in shallower waters, and almost all Australian species described to date inhabit more sunlit depths.
paras.zh: 它们也并非深海独有。许多Terebellid蠕虫生活在较浅的水域中，迄今为止描述的几乎所有澳大利亚物种都栖息在阳光照射较多的深处。

paras.en: But our understanding of the life that inhabits deeper waters is significantly more limited than our knowledge of the shallows.
paras.zh: 但我们对深海生物的了解远比对浅海生物的了解要有限。

paras.en: During research voyages in 2021 and 2022, scientists aboard Australia's research vessel Investigator explored seamounts around Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands, collecting specimens from these little-explored deep-sea ecosystems.
paras.zh: 在 2021 年和 2022 年的研究航行中，澳大利亚研究船“调查者”号上的科学家探索了圣诞岛和科科斯（基林）群岛周围的海山，从这些鲜为人知的深海生态系统中收集了标本。

paras.en: These voyages yielded many species totally new to science. Some have already been described. Others are still awaiting formal description.
paras.zh: 这些航行产生了许多对科学来说全新的物种。有些已经描述过。其他人仍在等待正式描述。

paras.en: But among the hundreds of specimens collected from the seafloor, two kinds of worms in particular stood out as unusual.
paras.zh: 但在从海底收集的数百个标本中，有两种蠕虫特别引人注目，显得异常异常。

paras.en: They were collected from seamounts at depths between 467 and 674 meters (1,532 and 2,211 feet), and, when extracted from their protective tubes, revealed sucker-like structures formed from modified pads on the undersides of the front portions of their segmented bodies.
paras.zh: 它们是从 467 至 674 米（1,532 至 2,211 英尺）深处的海山中采集的，当从保护管中取出时，会发现在其分段身体前部的下侧有由改良垫形成的吸盘状结构。

paras.en: One increasingly common step in describing a new species is to sequence its DNA.
paras.zh: 描述新物种的一个越来越常见的步骤是对其 DNA 进行测序。

paras.en: When the researchers analyzed the DNA of their peculiar worms, the evidence – combined with their distinctive anatomy – pointed to something even more exciting than two new species: an entirely new genus.
paras.zh: 当研究人员分析这些特殊蠕虫的 DNA 时，证据——结合它们独特的解剖结构——指出了比两个新物种更令人兴奋的东西：一个全新的属。

paras.en: That genus is Terebellosuctoria, a name that acknowledges their weird sucker-like structures, and the two species are Terebellosuctoria jimii and Terebellosuctoria keelingensis.
paras.zh: 该属是 Terebellosuctoria，这个名字承认了它们奇怪的吸盘状结构，这两个物种是 Terebellosuctoria jimii 和 Terebellosuctoria keelingensis。

paras.en: Eagle-eyed readers, however, will recall that we mentioned three species of Terebellosuctoria.
paras.zh: 然而，眼尖的读者会记得我们提到过三种 Terebellosuctoria。

paras.en: The third member of this strange little group had actually been discovered before – thousands of kilometers away, in even deeper waters (843 meters) off the coast of Japan.
paras.zh: 这个奇怪的小群体的第三个成员实际上以前就被发现过——在数千公里之外，在日本海岸附近更深的水域（843 米）。

paras.en: It was described in a 2025 paper, and tentatively assigned to the Lanice genus, named Lanice spongicola, but its unusual anatomy left its evolutionary relationships unresolved.
paras.zh: 它在 2025 年的一篇论文中进行了描述，并暂时归属于 Lanice 属，命名为 Lanice spongicola，但其不寻常的解剖结构使其进化关系尚未解决。

paras.en: The Japanese researchers had sequenced its DNA, too. Their analysis suggested that the worm was related to members of the Lanice and Loimia genera, but they couldn't confidently place it in either.
paras.zh: 日本研究人员也对其 DNA 进行了测序。他们的分析表明，这种蠕虫与 Lanice 属和 Loimia 属的成员有关，但他们不能自信地将其归入其中任何一个属。

paras.en: They even suggested that the discovery of other worms with similar sucker-like structures might reveal an entirely new evolutionary lineage.
paras.zh: 他们甚至认为，发现具有类似吸盘状结构的其他蠕虫可能会揭示一个全新的进化谱系。

paras.en: By comparing the anatomy and DNA of the Australian specimens with the Japanese species, Kupriyanova and her colleagues were able to resolve the mystery. Lanice spongicola has now been reassigned to the new genus as Terebellosuctoria spongicola.
paras.zh: 通过比较澳大利亚样本和日本物种的解剖结构和 DNA，库普里亚诺娃和她的同事们解开了这个谜团。 Lanice spongicola 现在已被重新分配到新属，称为 Terebellosuctoria spongicola。

paras.en: And there's one more intriguing clue about those mysterious suckers.
paras.zh: 关于这些神秘的吸盘，还有一个更有趣的线索。

paras.en: The Japanese researchers observed their worm using its sucker-like structure to cling to the inside of its tube, which was attached to a deep-sea glass sponge. They suggested that it might help anchor the animal in a habitat where loose sediment is scarce.
paras.zh: 日本研究人员观察到他们的蠕虫利用其吸盘状结构粘附在其管子的内部，该管子附着在深海玻璃海绵上。他们认为，这可能有助于将动物固定在松散沉积物稀缺的栖息地。

paras.en: Whether the Australian species use their suckers in the same way remains to be seen.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚物种是否以同样的方式使用吸盘还有待观察。

paras.en: But that may have to wait for another day. The voyage yielded many potential new discoveries. This particular paper detailed seven new species – the two spaghetti worms and five other annelids.
paras.zh: 但这可能还要再等一天。这次航行产生了许多潜在的新发现。这篇特别的论文详细介绍了七个新物种——两种意大利面蠕虫和其他五种环节动物。

paras.en: There are many more to go – and that's just from a relatively small patch of the deep ocean.
paras.zh: 还有更多的地方有待探索——而这只是来自深海相对较小的一块区域。

paras.en: "An expedition may collect hundreds or thousands of specimens, but discovering what they actually are can take years," Kupriyanova says.
paras.zh: “一次探险可能会收集数百或数千个标本，但发现它们的实际情况可能需要数年时间，”库普里亚诺娃说。

paras.en: "The specimens become part of museum research collections, where taxonomists can continue studying them long after the voyage has finished. The seven species described in this paper are another step in working through that remarkable archive."
paras.zh: “这些标本成为博物馆研究收藏的一部分，分类学家可以在航行结束后很长时间内继续研究它们。本文中描述的七个物种是研究这一非凡档案的又一步。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Records of the Australian Museum.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《澳大利亚博物馆记录》上。

articles.title: Brown Fat Can Be Beneficial For The Body – And a Blood Pressure Drug Could Turn It On
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Body fat can bring health benefits as well as health problems, depending on where it is and how much of it there is.
paras.zh: 身体脂肪既可以带来健康益处，也可以带来健康问题，具体取决于它的位置和含量。

paras.en: Brown fat in particular is thought to be mostly good for us – burning up excess sugar and fat and regulating body temperature.
paras.zh: 尤其是棕色脂肪被认为对我们最有好处——燃烧多余的糖和脂肪并调节体温。

paras.en: In a new study in Nature, researchers led by a team from Rockefeller University in the US have presented more evidence for brown fat (adipose tissue) boosting not just physical health, but mental health too.
paras.zh: 在《自然》杂志上的一项新研究中，由美国洛克菲勒大学团队领导的研究人员提供了更多证据，证明棕色脂肪（脂肪组织）不仅可以促进身体健康，还可以促进心理健康。

paras.en: What's more, they've also identified a potential medication option: the blood pressure drug losartan was associated with a greater likelihood of having detectable brown fat in the study data.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，他们还确定了一种潜在的药物选择：血压药物氯沙坦在研究数据中与可检测到的棕色脂肪的可能性更大有关。

paras.en: All of these findings came from scanning the medical records of 101,243 study participants using AI to find brown fat, plus further tests in mouse models.
paras.zh: 所有这些发现都来自使用 AI 扫描 101,243 名研究参与者的医疗记录来寻找棕色脂肪，以及在小鼠模型中进行的进一步测试。

paras.en: "Our studies harnessing artificial intelligence and big data identify new clinical phenotypes linked to brown adipose tissue and serve as a platform for drug repurposing to activate this tissue in humans," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“我们利用人工智能和大数据的研究确定了与棕色脂肪组织相关的新临床表型，并作为药物再利用的平台来激活人类的这种组织。”

paras.en: The first part of the research involved identifying nearly 8,900 of the study participants with detectable amounts of brown fat.
paras.zh: 研究的第一部分涉及识别近 8,900 名研究参与者是否含有可检测到的棕色脂肪。

paras.en: It's not something we all have in very large amounts, at least compared to the more common white fat: The level declines with age, and what brown fat we do have is often dormant.
paras.zh: 至少与更常见的白色脂肪相比，我们所有人都拥有大量的棕色脂肪：其水平随着年龄的增长而下降，而我们所拥有的棕色脂肪通常处于休眠状态。

paras.en: After crunching the numbers on these participants compared to matched controls, the researchers found that those with brown fat were significantly less likely to have type 2 diabetes or heart disease.
paras.zh: 在对这些参与者与匹配对照组的数据进行比较后，研究人员发现，那些拥有棕色脂肪的人患 2 型糖尿病或心脏病的可能性明显较低。

paras.en: Then there were the mental health findings – the brown fat group was also less likely to have anxiety or depression.
paras.zh: 然后是心理健康研究结果——棕色脂肪组也不太可能出现焦虑或抑郁。

paras.en: More 'active' brown fat meant greater benefits, with armpit fat showing the biggest links. The data doesn't show direct cause and effect, but there do appear to be notable associations found here that can be followed up on in future research.
paras.zh: 更多“活跃”的棕色脂肪意味着更大的好处，其中腋窝脂肪的联系最为显着。这些数据没有显示直接的因果关系，但这里似乎确实发现了显着的关联，可以在未来的研究中进行跟进。

paras.en: The researchers then moved on to blood pressure drugs. Another pattern that emerged was that people on blood pressure pills were more likely to have detectable levels of brown fat.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后转向降血压药物。出现的另一种模式是，服用降压药的人更有可能检测到棕色脂肪水平。

paras.en: Switching to tests on mice, the team found that animals given losartan had brown fat that was more active – burning more energy and producing more heat, although any subsequent health benefits still have to be determined.
paras.zh: 研究小组转而对小鼠进行测试，发现服用氯沙坦的动物的棕色脂肪更加活跃，燃烧更多的能量并产生更多的热量，尽管随后的健康益处仍有待确定。

paras.en: This activation was backed up by an analysis of brown fat cells in mice. It also happened via a different route to the one used to lower blood pressure, the study determined, which opens up more potential for future treatments.
paras.zh: 对小鼠棕色脂肪细胞的分析支持了这种激活。研究确定，它还通过与用于降低血压的途径不同的途径发生，这为未来的治疗开辟了更多潜力。

paras.en: "The fact that its different effects are mediated by different molecular pathways is advantageous, since it means we could potentially isolate them in future therapies," says endocrinologist Nicolás Gómez-Banoy from Rockefeller University.
paras.zh: 洛克菲勒大学的内分泌学家 Nicolás Gómez-Banoy 表示：“它的不同作用是由不同的分子途径介导的，这一事实是有利的，因为这意味着我们有可能在未来的治疗中将它们分离出来。”

paras.en: "That way you would be able to stimulate brown fat in people with normal blood pressure."
paras.zh: “这样你就能够刺激血压正常的人体内的棕色脂肪。”

paras.en: There are several caveats to sift through here. The association between blood pressure drugs and brown fat was identified in people, but the drug's ability to activate brown fat was demonstrated in mice, which are more reliant on brown fat than we are.
paras.zh: 这里有几个注意事项需要仔细检查。降血压药物与棕色脂肪之间的关联已在人体中得到证实，但该药物激活棕色脂肪的能力在小鼠身上得到了证实，小鼠比我们更依赖棕色脂肪。

paras.en: When it comes to the original database of medical records, all the participants had been diagnosed with cancer, and more than three-quarters were women, so future research needs to be expanded to include other groups of people.
paras.zh: 在原始病历数据库中，所有参与者都被诊断出患有癌症，其中超过四分之三是女性，因此未来的研究需要扩大到包括其他人群。

paras.en: All that said, it's a solid step towards understanding more about the benefits of brown fat and how it could be more readily activated. Each of the findings here is a foundation that other studies can build on.
paras.zh: 话虽如此，这是朝着更多地了解棕色脂肪的好处以及如何更容易地激活它迈出的坚实一步。这里的每一项发现都是其他研究可以建立的基础。

paras.en: "The unique reverse translational approach of this study, enabled by large clinical datasets and next-generation analytical tools, provides a much-needed clinical rationale for exploring brown adipose tissue as a therapeutic target in humans across a spectrum of diseases," says Griffin Rodgers, director of the NIH's National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases, who wasn't involved in the research.
paras.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院国家糖尿病、消化和肾脏疾病研究所所长格里芬·罗杰斯（未参与这项研究）表示：“这项研究独特的反向转化方法，在大型临床数据集和下一代分析工具的支持下，为探索棕色脂肪组织作为人类多种疾病的治疗靶点提供了急需的临床原理。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然》杂志上。

articles.title: Best of Both Worlds: 'Hybrid' Quantum Computers Could Be Just Around The Corner, Researchers Say
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: For all their promise, quantum computers have a hard time modeling the interactions between the two families of building blocks that underlie our Universe – can you imagine a chef that struggles to describe how sugar and milk make cake?
paras.zh: 尽管量子计算机有很多承诺，但它很难对构成我们宇宙的两个构建模块家族之间的相互作用进行建模——你能想象一个厨师努力描述糖和牛奶如何制作蛋糕吗？

paras.en: But researchers may have found a way to overcome this challenge by modeling a theoretical 'hybrid' quantum computer that promises to combine the best of both worlds.
paras.zh: 但研究人员可能已经找到了一种方法来克服这一挑战，即对理论上的“混合”量子计算机进行建模，该计算机有望结合两个领域的优点。

paras.en: The fundamental particles that make up the cosmic cake of our existence are grouped as either fermions or bosons.
paras.zh: 构成我们存在的宇宙蛋糕的基本粒子分为费米子或玻色子。

paras.en: In simplest terms, fermions are particles of matter, including electrons and protons, and bosons include force-mediating particles, like the photons (light) that carry the electromagnetic force.
paras.zh: 简而言之，费米子是物质粒子，包括电子和质子，玻色子包括力介导粒子，例如携带电磁力的光子（光）。

paras.en: Quantum computers are great at modeling fermions, because they're more discrete, just like the qubits that power quantum computing.
paras.zh: 量子计算机非常擅长对费米子进行建模，因为它们更加离散，就像为量子计算提供动力的量子位一样。

paras.en: But bosons are tougher because they can occupy the same quantum state and 'overlap', meaning that one can have a quantum stack of infinite bosons.
paras.zh: 但玻色子更难，因为它们可以占据相同的量子态并“重叠”，这意味着人们可以拥有无​​限玻色子的量子堆栈。

paras.en: A new theoretical framework could bypass this issue and supercharge quantum computing, thanks to a new study from a team of physicists, engineers, and computer scientists, led by Eleanor Crane, a quantum computing lecturer at King's College London.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院量子计算讲师埃莉诺·克兰 (Eleanor Crane) 领导的物理学家、工程师和计算机科学家团队进行了一项新研究，一个新的理论框架可以绕过这个问题并增强量子计算的性能。

paras.en: As they describe in the journal Physical Review X, the researchers developed a hybrid quantum computing strategy that incorporates two existing technologies: the qubits that power quantum computers, and microwave cavity resonators, little boxes that contain oscillating electromagnetic fields.
paras.zh: 正如他们在《Physical Review X》杂志中所描述的那样，研究人员开发了一种混合量子计算策略，该策略结合了两种现有技术：为量子计算机提供动力的量子位和微波腔谐振器（包含振荡电磁场的小盒子）。

paras.en: The latter are already used in superconductors, but the researchers envision using them for computation to store quantum information.
paras.zh: 后者已经用于超导体，但研究人员设想将它们用于计算以存储量子信息。

paras.en: To replicate the action of bosons, quantum computers must use many qubits, which are discrete like fermions, but scaling this up also scales up the error rate. Incorporating resonators could avert this issue, providing a breakthrough:
paras.zh: 为了复制玻色子的作用，量子计算机必须使用许多量子位，这些量子位像费米子一样是离散的，但扩大规模也会增加错误率。结合谐振器可以避免这个问题，从而提供突破：

paras.en: "Because this [hybrid framework] cuts the work a thousandfold, chemistry and materials problems of practical value could come within reach of machines being built today, long before large error-corrected computers arrive," the researchers say in the popular summary of their work.
paras.zh: 研究人员在他们的工作总结中表示：“由于这种[混合框架]将工作量减少了千倍，因此，早在大型纠错计算机出现之前，今天制造的机器就可以解决具有实用价值的化学和材料问题。”

paras.en: In laying the bedrock for the hybrid system's smooth digital integration, it's a bit like introducing two Star Trek fans from disparate world regions and having them communicate through Klingon as a shared language.
paras.zh: 在为混合系统的顺利数字集成奠定基础时，这有点像引入来自世界不同地区的两个《星际迷航》粉丝，并让他们通过克林贡语作为共享语言进行交流。

paras.en: To offer a baseline for comparison between traditional and hybrid quantum computing, the researchers developed models of a beam splitter, which splits or combines light, and also a couple of super-simplified tiny min-Universes.
paras.zh: 为了提供传统量子计算和混合量子计算之间的比较基准，研究人员开发了分束器模型，该模型可以分裂或组合光，以及几个超级简化的微小宇宙。

paras.en: For example, the "notoriously challenging" (2+1)-dimensional gauge modeling comprises only two dimensions of space and the dimension of time, bringing us back to the days of Pong or Sonic.
paras.zh: 例如，“出了名的具有挑战性”的（2+1）维规范模型仅包含空间和时间两个维度，让我们回到了《Pong》或《Sonic》的时代。

paras.en: This may sound underwhelming given the pop-media hoopla about quantum computing, but it's actually a scientific sweet spot.
paras.zh: 考虑到流行媒体对量子计算的大肆宣传，这可能听起来平淡无奇，但它实际上是一个科学的最佳点。

paras.en: Modeling things in one spatial dimension is too simple, and modeling things in the three (+1) dimensions of our known Universe is hugely challenging.
paras.zh: 在一个空间维度中建模事物太简单，而在我们已知宇宙的三个 (+1) 维度中建模事物则极具挑战性。

paras.en: "Because this [hybrid framework] cuts the work a thousandfold, chemistry and materials problems of practical value could come within reach of machines being built today, long before large error-corrected computers arrive," the researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示：“由于这种[混合框架]将工作量减少了千倍，因此，早在大型纠错计算机出现之前，当今制造的机器就可以解决具有实用价值的化学和材料问题。”

paras.en: Perhaps surprisingly, (2+1) theories are relevant in the real world.
paras.zh: 也许令人惊讶的是，(2+1) 理论与现实世界相关。

paras.en: For example, the graphene that's said to be the strongest known material is effectively two-dimensional. Two-dimensional interactions are also vital in how electrons flow in superconducting materials, with significant implications for energy storage.
paras.zh: 例如，据说是已知最强材料的石墨烯实际上是二维的。二维相互作用对于电子在超导材料中的流动也至关重要，这对能量存储具有重大影响。

paras.en: Overall, the researchers suggest that hybrid quantum computing can be much more accurate, and soon.
paras.zh: 总的来说，研究人员认为混合量子计算很快就会变得更加准确。

paras.en: For example, to match qubit-boson hardware with 99.9 percent per-gate fidelity – which is the accuracy of a logic gate in modifying the quantum state of a qubit – a top-of-the-line qubit-only computer would need per-gate fidelities of at least 99.9999 percent.
paras.zh: 例如，为了将量子位玻色子硬件与 99.9% 的每门保真度（即逻辑门修改量子位的量子状态的准确性）相匹配，顶级的仅量子位计算机需要至少 99.9999% 的每门保真度。

paras.en: This many "nines" displays a difference of three orders of magnitude and is currently unattainable.
paras.zh: 如此之多的“9”显示出三个数量级的差异，目前是无法实现的。

paras.en: Qubit-boson hardware could help illuminate numerous salient mysteries, such as the interactions of phonons ( quasiparticles of vibrational energy) and electrons, providing a fundamental blueprint for high-temperature superconductors.
paras.zh: 量子比特玻色子硬件可以帮助阐明许多显着的谜团，例如声子（振动能量的准粒子）和电子的相互作用，为高温超导体提供基本蓝图。

paras.en: This work could also suppress quantum computing errors by truncating the many qubit logic gates that must be otherwise strung together, further freeing up resources by eliminating guard-dog-style "ancilla qubits" used to detect errors.
paras.zh: 这项工作还可以通过截断必须串在一起的许多量子位逻辑门来抑制量子计算错误，通过消除用于检测错误的看门狗式“辅助量子位”来进一步释放资源。

paras.en: By whatever strategy, quantum computing consequences may be world-shaping:
paras.zh: 无论采用何种策略，量子计算的后果都可能会改变世界：

paras.en: "Understanding how plants transport sunlight to turn it into energy, how some materials carry electricity without loss, or how drugs bind to their targets could bring better solar cells, power grids, and medicines," the researchers explain.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说：“了解植物如何传输阳光以将其转化为能量，某些材料如何无损地传输电力，或者药物如何与其目标结合，可以带来更好的太阳能电池、电网和药物。”

paras.en: "All are quantum problems too hard for any classical supercomputer, and all involve bosons: vibrations or particles of light."
paras.zh: “所有这些都是量子问题，对于任何经典超级计算机来说都太难了，而且都涉及玻色子：振动或光粒子。”

paras.en: Perhaps the most intriguing aspect of this work is its apparent around-the-corner availability, the researchers stress, since it's an applicable framework:
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，也许这项工作最有趣的方面是它明显的随时可用，因为它是一个适用的框架：

paras.en: If one could 'simply' combine a qubit and an oscillator, one could achieve synergistically better quantum computing results by cutting resource use.
paras.zh: 如果人们可以“简单地”组合一个量子位和一个振荡器，那么就可以通过减少资源使用来实现协同更好的量子计算结果。

paras.en: Fortunately, both qubits and oscillators are commonplace.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，量子位和振荡器都很常见。

paras.en: "In my view, the most encouraging aspect of this proposal is how modest the hardware requirements are. These requirements can be met by near-term devices without waiting for quantum error correction," says Anthony Ciavarella, a computational research scientist at Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, in California.
paras.zh: 加州劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室的计算研究科学家 Anthony Ciavarella 表示：“在我看来，该提案最令人鼓舞的方面是硬件要求非常适中。这些要求可以通过近期设备来满足，而无需等待量子纠错。”

paras.en: "This work provides a concrete target for hardware development, and the required gate fidelities are close to what existing devices already achieve."
paras.zh: “这项工作为硬件开发提供了具体目标，所需的门保真度接近现有设备已经达到的水平。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Physical Review X.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《Physical Review X》上。

articles.title: Eating blueberries every day may have a surprising effect on your mood

paras.en: Eating blueberries every day may have a surprising effect on your mood
paras.zh: 每天吃蓝莓可能会对你的情绪产生令人惊讶的影响

paras.en: A new study hints that eating blueberries daily could help improve mood in older adults, potentially through surprising effects on the gut microbiome.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，每天吃蓝莓可以帮助改善老年人的情绪，这可能是通过对肠道微生物组的惊人影响来实现的。

paras.en: - Hebrew SeniorLife Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research
paras.zh: - 希伯来 SeniorLife Hinda 和亚瑟·马库斯衰老研究所

paras.en: - Eating blueberries every day could have surprising effects on mood, according to a small study that found greater reductions in depressive symptoms among older adults who consumed the fruit for three months. Researchers also detected changes in gut microbial enzymes, suggesting a possible gut-brain connection, although the mood benefits were not statistically significant compared with a placebo.
paras.zh: - 一项小型研究表明，每天吃蓝莓可能会对情绪产生令人惊讶的影响，该研究发现连续食用蓝莓三个月的老年人的抑郁症状有更大程度的减轻。研究人员还检测到肠道微生物酶的变化，这表明肠道与大脑可能存在联系，尽管与安慰剂相比，其对情绪的益处在统计学上并不显着。

paras.en: A small pilot study suggests that eating blueberries every day may influence gut bacteria and potentially affect mood in older adults. Participants who consumed blueberries regularly experienced a greater and more consistent reduction in depressive symptoms, along with subtle changes in genes associated with gut microbial enzymes.
paras.zh: 一项小型试点研究表明，每天吃蓝莓可能会影响肠道细菌，并可能影响老年人的情绪。经常食用蓝莓的参与者的抑郁症状得到了更大、更持续的减轻，同时与肠道微生物酶相关的基因也发生了微妙的变化。

paras.en: However, the improvements in depressive symptoms were not statistically significant when compared with the placebo group. Although the findings do not establish that blueberries can relieve depression, they offer preliminary clues about a possible connection between blueberry consumption, the gut microbiome, and mental health.
paras.zh: 然而，与安慰剂组相比，抑郁症状的改善并不具有统计学意义。尽管研究结果并未证实蓝莓可以缓解抑郁症，但它们提供了有关蓝莓食用、肠道微生物组和心理健康之间可能存在联系的初步线索。

paras.en: "Fiber and anthocyanins in blueberries have potential to modify the gut microbiome and metabolites that are relevant to depression in older adults," said lead author Courtney L. Millar, PhD, assistant scientist II at Hebrew SeniorLife's Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research and assistant professor of medicine at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and Harvard Medical School. "Our objective was to preliminarily determine the effect of blueberry consumption on the gut microbiome, metabolites, and depressive symptoms."
paras.zh: “蓝莓中的纤维和花青素有可能改变与老年人抑郁症相关的肠道微生物群和代谢物，”主要作者 Courtney L. Millar 博士说，他是希伯来老年生活 Hinda 和阿瑟·马库斯衰老研究所的第二助理科学家，也是贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心和哈佛医学院的医学助理教授。 “我们的目标是初步确定食用蓝莓对肠道微生物组、代谢物和抑郁症状的影响。”

paras.en: Testing the Effects of Daily Blueberry Consumption
paras.zh: 测试每日食用蓝莓的效果

paras.en: To investigate the potential connection, researchers recruited adults aged 65 and older who were physically inactive and experiencing mild depressive symptoms. The pilot study used a randomized, double-blind, parallel-arm, placebo-controlled design to evaluate whether consuming blueberries could influence gut microbes and mood.
paras.zh: 为了调查潜在的联系，研究人员招募了 65 岁及以上、身体不活跃且有轻度抑郁症状的成年人。该试点研究采用随机、双盲、平行臂、安慰剂对照设计来评估食用蓝莓是否会影响肠道微生物和情绪。

paras.en: Over three months, participants consumed either 48 grams of blueberry powder each day (approximately two cups of fresh berries) or a matching placebo powder.
paras.zh: 三个月内，参与者每天食用 48 克蓝莓粉（约两杯新鲜浆果）或相应的安慰剂粉。

paras.en: Researchers examined the participants' gut microbiomes using metagenomic sequencing, which allowed them to measure the abundance of different microbial species and genes. They also used liquid chromatography/mass spectrometry to analyze gut-derived fecal short-chain fatty acids, compounds produced through microbial activity. Depressive symptoms were assessed using validated questionnaires administered before and after the three-month intervention.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用宏基因组测序检查了参与者的肠道微生物组，这使他们能够测量不同微生物物种和基因的丰度。他们还使用液相色谱/质谱法来分析肠道来源的粪便短链脂肪酸，这是通过微生物活动产生的化合物。使用三个月干预前后进行的经过验证的问卷来评估抑郁症状。

paras.en: Blueberries Linked to Subtle Changes in Gut Microbial Activity
paras.zh: 蓝莓与肠道微生物活性的微妙变化有关

paras.en: A total of 18 participants completed the study. Most were women, and the group was predominantly white (placebo group, n = 8; mean age: 75 ± 6; blueberry group, n = 10; mean age: 71 ± 4).
paras.zh: 共有 18 名参与者完成了这项研究。大多数是女性，并且该组主要是白人（安慰剂组，n = 8；平均年龄：75 ± 6；蓝莓组，n = 10；平均年龄：71 ± 4）。

paras.en: Despite the encouraging pattern in depressive symptoms among participants consuming blueberries, the researchers found no statistically significant difference in mood improvements between the blueberry and placebo groups.
paras.zh: 尽管食用蓝莓的参与者的抑郁症状令人鼓舞，但研究人员发现蓝莓组和安慰剂组之间的情绪改善没有统计学上的显着差异。

paras.en: The gut microbiome results also revealed a mixed picture. The overall abundance of microbial species, MetaCyc metabolic pathways, and short-chain fatty acid metabolites remained unchanged.
paras.zh: 肠道微生物组结果也显示出喜忧参半的情况。微生物物种、MetaCyc 代谢途径和短链脂肪酸代谢物的总体丰度保持不变。

paras.en: However, researchers identified statistically significant changes within the blueberry group in the abundance of genes associated with several gut microbial enzymes. One of these was EC 3.6.3.31 Polyamine Transporting ATPase, which is involved in the production of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), a neurotransmitter that plays a role in brain signaling.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员发现蓝莓组中与几种肠道微生物酶相关的基因丰度存在统计学上的显着变化。其中之一是 EC 3.6.3.31 多胺转运 ATP 酶，它参与γ-氨基丁酸 (GABA) 的产生，GABA 是一种在大脑信号传导中发挥作用的神经递质。

paras.en: These findings suggest that blueberries may influence specific aspects of gut microbial function even without producing measurable changes in the overall composition of the microbiome. Larger studies will be needed to determine whether these changes are connected to meaningful improvements in mood or depressive symptoms.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，蓝莓可能会影响肠道微生物功能的特定方面，即使不会对微生物组的整体组成产生可测量的变化。需要更大规模的研究来确定这些变化是否与情绪或抑郁症状的有意义的改善有关。

paras.en: The study, "A pilot study of daily blueberry intake modulates the gut microbiota enzyme commissions in older, sedentary adults with mild depressive symptoms," was published in the Journal of Nutrition, Health and Aging.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《营养、健康与老龄化杂志》上，“一项关于每日蓝莓摄入量的初步研究可调节患有轻度抑郁症状的久坐老年人的肠道微生物酶委员会”。

paras.en: Other contributors included Mohit P. Chopra, MD, of the Deanna and Sidney Wolk Center for Memory Health at Hebrew SeniorLife and the Department of Psychiatry at UMass Chan Medical School; Xochitl Morgan, PhD, and Emily A. Green, PhD, of the Department of Biostatistics at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health; Alex Wolfe of the Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research at Hebrew SeniorLife; Kerry A. Pierce of the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard; and Lidan Gao, PhD, and Christopher N. Blesso, PhD, of the Department of Nutritional Sciences at the University of Connecticut.
paras.zh: 其他贡献者包括希伯来高级生命中心 Deanna 和 Sidney Wolk 记忆健康中心以及麻省大学陈医学院精神病学系的 Mohit P. Chopra 医学博士；哈佛大学 T.H. 生物统计学系的 Xochitl Morgan 博士和 Emily A. Green 博士陈公共卫生学院；希伯来高级生活中心 Hinda 和 Arthur Marcus 衰老研究所的 Alex Wolfe；麻省理工学院和哈佛大学布罗德研究所的 Kerry A. Pierce；康涅狄格大学营养科学系的高立丹博士和克里斯托弗·N·布莱索博士。

paras.en: Additional contributors were Alyssa B. Dufour, PhD, of the Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research at Hebrew SeniorLife and the Department of Medicine at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center and Harvard Medical School; Douglas P. Kiel, MD, MPH, of the Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research at Hebrew SeniorLife, Harvard Medical School, and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center; and Lewis A. Lipsitz, MD, of the Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research at Hebrew SeniorLife and professor of medicine at Harvard Medical School.
paras.zh: 其他贡献者包括希伯来高级生活中心 (Hebrew SeniorLife) 的 Hinda 和阿瑟·马库斯衰老研究所 (Hinda and Arthur Marcus Institute for Aging Research) 的 Alyssa B. Lipsitz) 医学博士，希伯来高级生命中心 Hinda 和 Arthur Marcus 衰老研究所的教授，也是哈佛医学院的医学教授。

articles.title: Physicists create a bizarre new quantum state called a fractional fermi sea

paras.en: Physicists create a bizarre new quantum state called a fractional fermi sea
paras.zh: 物理学家创造了一种奇怪的新量子态，称为分数费米海

paras.en: - Physicists have discovered a strange new state of quantum matter in which ultracold atoms defy familiar organizational rules, forming a highly excited yet surprisingly orderly configuration called a "fractional Fermi sea." The discovery challenges established quantum theories and hints at exotic quasiparticles that scientists have dubbed potential "super-Fermions."
paras.zh: - 物理学家发现了一种奇怪的新量子物质状态，其中超冷原子违背了熟悉的组织规则，形成了一种高度激发但令人惊讶的有序结构，称为“分数费米海”。这一发现挑战了已建立的量子理论，并暗示了科学家们称之为潜在“超级费米子”的奇异准粒子。

paras.en: Physicists have uncovered a strange new form of quantum behavior in which particles organize themselves in ways that challenge established theories. Even more surprising, the particles maintain a remarkable hidden order despite being driven into an extremely energetic state.
paras.zh: 物理学家发现了一种奇怪的新形式的量子行为，其中粒子以挑战现有理论的方式组织自身。更令人惊讶的是，尽管粒子被驱动进入极高的能量状态，但仍保持着显着的隐藏秩序。

paras.en: In a study published in Physical Review Letters, researchers from the group led by Hanns-Christoph Nägerl, working with theoretical physicist Alvise Bastianello of the CNRS and Université Paris-Dauphine, describe how to engineer an exotic quantum state known as a "fractional Fermi sea."
paras.zh: 在《物理评论快报》上发表的一项研究中，由 Hanns-Christoph Nägerl 领导的小组的研究人员与法国国家科学研究中心和巴黎第九大学的理论物理学家阿尔维斯·巴斯蒂安内洛合作，描述了如何设计一种被称为“分数费米海”的奇特量子态。

paras.en: The breakthrough involves pushing ultracold cesium atoms far beyond their normal conditions by repeatedly changing how strongly they attract or repel one another. Rather than simply becoming disordered, the particles rearrange themselves into an unusual configuration that behaves differently from the quantum systems scientists have traditionally studied.
paras.zh: 这一突破涉及通过反复改变超冷铯原子相互吸引或排斥的强度，使它们远远超出其正常条件。这些粒子并不是简单地变得无序，而是将自身重新排列成一种不寻常的结构，其行为与科学家传统上研究的量子系统不同。

paras.en: The theoretical findings provide the foundation for recent experimental research conducted by Nägerl's team at the Department of Experimental Physics.
paras.zh: 这些理论发现为实验物理系 Nägerl 团队最近进行的实验研究奠定了基础。

paras.en: Pushing Quantum Particles Beyond Their Normal Limits
paras.zh: 推动量子粒子超越其正常极限

paras.en: Under ordinary conditions, quantum particles follow well-established rules that determine how they arrange themselves, particularly at extremely low temperatures.
paras.zh: 在普通条件下，量子粒子遵循既定的规则来决定它们如何排列自己，特别是在极低的温度下。

paras.en: One important example involves fermions, a category of particles that includes electrons. These particles cannot all occupy the same quantum state, so they fill available energy levels according to specific restrictions. At very low temperatures, this arrangement produces what physicists call a Fermi sea.
paras.zh: 一个重要的例子涉及费米子，这是一类包含电子的粒子。这些粒子不可能全部占据相同的量子态，因此它们根据特定的限制填充可用的能级。在非常低的温度下，这种排列会产生物理学家所说的费米海。

paras.en: But what happens when researchers deliberately disrupt the conditions that normally govern how particles behave?
paras.zh: 但是，当研究人员故意破坏通常控制粒子行为的条件时，会发生什么？

paras.en: As Alvise Bastianello explains: "Fermions, for instance, stack neatly into the available energy states to form the so-called 'Fermi sea'. But what happens if one forces interacting atoms to continuously cycle through extreme conditions, smoothly shifting them from strongly repelling each other to strongly attracting each other?"
paras.zh: 正如阿尔维斯·巴斯蒂安内洛（Alvise Bastianello）所解释的那样：“例如，费米子整齐地堆积成可用的能量状态，形成所谓的‘费米海’。但是，如果迫使相互作用的原子在极端条件下不断循环，顺利地将它们从相互强烈排斥转变为强烈相互吸引，会发生什么？”

paras.en: To investigate this possibility, the researchers studied ultracold cesium atoms confined to a one-dimensional system. This means the atoms are restricted to moving along a single direction, creating an environment in which their quantum interactions can be studied with exceptional control.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种可能性，研究人员研究了限制在一维系统中的超冷铯原子。这意味着原子被限制沿单一方向移动，创造了一个可以通过特殊控制来研究它们的量子相互作用的环境。

paras.en: The team examined what happens when the interactions between these atoms are repeatedly adjusted, cycling between powerful repulsion and attraction.
paras.zh: 研究小组研究了当这些原子之间的相互作用反复调整、在强大的排斥力和吸引力之间循环时会发生什么。

paras.en: Their calculations revealed something unexpected. Starting from the ground state, the lowest energy configuration available to the system, the atoms could be driven into a highly excited state without losing their underlying organization.
paras.zh: 他们的计算揭示了一些意想不到的事情。从基态（系统可用的最低能量配置）开始，原子可以被驱动到高度激发态，而不会失去其底层组织。

paras.en: The researchers call this unusual arrangement a fractional Fermi sea because its particles appear to obey a modified rule governing how quantum states are occupied.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种不寻常的排列称为分数费米海，因为它的粒子似乎遵守控制量子态如何占据的修改规则。

paras.en: "Instead of simply heating the system, the interaction cycle reorganizes the atoms into a new many-body state," says Yi Zeng, the leading author of this study. "This gives us a controlled way to explore quantum matter beyond the usual equilibrium paradigms."
paras.zh: 这项研究的主要作者 Yi Zeng 表示：“相互作用循环不是简单地加热系统，而是将原子重新组织成新的多体状态。” “这为我们提供了一种超越通常平衡范式探索量子物质的受控方法。”

paras.en: A Strange New Quantum State With Hidden Order
paras.zh: 具有隐藏秩序的奇怪的新量子态

paras.en: One of the most intriguing features of the fractional Fermi sea is that its particles remain organized even though the system has been pushed far from equilibrium.
paras.zh: 分数费米海最有趣的特征之一是，即使系统已远离平衡，其粒子仍保持有序。

paras.en: In physics, equilibrium describes a condition in which a system's overall properties have settled into a stable balance. Systems driven far from equilibrium can behave in complicated and unexpected ways, making them particularly challenging to understand.
paras.zh: 在物理学中，平衡描述了系统的整体属性达到稳定平衡的状态。远离平衡的系统可能会以复杂且意想不到的方式运行，这使得它们特别难以理解。

paras.en: Yet the fractional Fermi sea is not simply a collection of excited particles behaving randomly. Instead, it contains distinctive mathematical patterns that reveal a deeper structure.
paras.zh: 然而，分数费米海不仅仅是随机行为的受激粒子的集合。相反，它包含揭示更深层次结构的独特数学模式。

paras.en: Among these patterns are pronounced ripples called Friedel oscillations. These are wave-like variations associated with the way quantum particles influence one another. The researchers also identified unusual patterns in how correlations between particles weaken with increasing distance, even when the repulsive interactions are relatively weak.
paras.zh: 在这些模式中，有一种明显的波纹，称为弗里德尔振荡。这些是与量子粒子相互影响的方式相关的波状变化。研究人员还发现了粒子之间的相关性随着距离的增加而减弱的不寻常模式，即使排斥相互作用相对较弱。

paras.en: These signatures are important because they differ from predictions associated with Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid theory, a long-established framework for describing how interacting quantum particles behave in one-dimensional systems.
paras.zh: 这些特征很重要，因为它们与 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体理论相关的预测不同，这是一个长期建立的框架，用于描述相互作用的量子粒子在一维系统中的行为方式。

paras.en: The findings therefore point toward a previously unexplored type of quantum behavior that cannot be fully described using this familiar theoretical picture.
paras.zh: 因此，这些发现指向了一种以前未探索过的量子行为类型，这种行为无法使用这种熟悉的理论图景来完全描述。

paras.en: "This state is highly excited, but it is not random," says Hanns-Christoph Nägerl, the group leader. "It has a hidden order that becomes visible in its correlations."
paras.zh: “这种状态是高度兴奋的，但它不是随机的，”小组负责人汉斯-克里斯托夫·纳格尔 (Hanns-Christoph Nägerl) 说。 “它有一个隐藏的顺序，在其相关性中变得可见。”

paras.en: The strange behavior also raises questions about the effective particles that emerge within the system. Physicists call these collective excitations quasiparticles because they can behave like individual particles even though they arise from the coordinated motion of many interacting particles.
paras.zh: 这种奇怪的行为也引发了人们对系统内出现的有效粒子的疑问。物理学家将这些集体激发称为准粒子，因为它们的行为可以像单个粒子一样，尽管它们是由许多相互作用的粒子的协调运动产生的。

paras.en: Nägerl suggests that the unusual excitations might eventually deserve a name of their own.
paras.zh: 纳格尔认为，这种不寻常的兴奋最终可能值得拥有自己的名字。

paras.en: "We are not yet sure how we should name these new quasiparticles. Perhaps 'super-Fermions'?"
paras.zh: “我们还不确定应该如何命名这些新的准粒子。也许是‘超级费米子’？”

paras.en: Opening a New Frontier in Quantum Physics
paras.zh: 开辟量子物理新领域

paras.en: The discovery suggests that fractional Fermi seas represent an exotic critical phase of quantum matter, with characteristic patterns of particle correlations that extend beyond existing descriptions of one-dimensional quantum systems.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，分数费米海代表了量子物质的一种奇异的临界相，其粒子相关性的特征模式超出了对一维量子系统的现有描述。

paras.en: It also demonstrates the growing power of quantum simulation, a technique that allows scientists to use carefully controlled quantum systems to investigate physical behavior that would otherwise be difficult to reproduce or study.
paras.zh: 它还展示了量子模拟日益强大的力量，这种技术使科学家能够使用精心控制的量子系统来研究否则难以重现或研究的物理行为。

paras.en: Ultracold atoms are particularly useful for this purpose because researchers can precisely adjust their interactions and observe how the resulting quantum states change.
paras.zh: 超冷原子对于此目的特别有用，因为研究人员可以精确调整它们的相互作用并观察由此产生的量子态如何变化。

paras.en: Rather than limiting these experiments to recreating phenomena already understood through established theories, scientists can now explore deliberately engineered states that reveal entirely new possibilities.
paras.zh: 科学家们现在可以探索故意设计的状态，揭示全新的可能性，而不是将这些实验限制在重现通过既定理论已经理解的现象。

paras.en: As Hanns-Christoph Nägerl says: "The discovery of fractional Fermi seas shows how far we can push quantum simulation: not only reproducing known models, but creating and probing states that go beyond established paradigms."
paras.zh: 正如 Hanns-Christoph Nägerl 所说：“分数费米海的发现表明我们可以将量子模拟推向多远：不仅复制已知模型，而且创建和探索超越既定范式的状态。”

paras.en: The current publication establishes the theoretical framework for fractional Fermi seas. A companion study describing their experimental realization through quantum simulation is undergoing peer review.
paras.zh: 当前出版物建立了分数费米海的理论框架。一项描述他们通过量子模拟实现实验的配套研究正在接受同行评审。

paras.en: Together, the research points toward new ways of investigating the fundamental behavior of quantum matter, including unusual collective excitations and hidden forms of order that emerge only when particles are pushed far outside their normal conditions.
paras.zh: 总之，这些研究指出了研究量子物质基本行为的新方法，包括不寻常的集体激发和隐藏的秩序形式，这些秩序只有当粒子被远远超出其正常条件时才会出现。

articles.title: Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt

paras.en: Scientists discover a natural compound that could protect the brain from too much salt
paras.zh: 科学家发现一种天然化合物可以保护大脑免受过多盐的影响

paras.en: A soy-derived compound protected mice from high blood pressure and memory problems linked to excessive salt consumption, offering a promising new avenue for research.
paras.zh: 一种源自大豆的化合物可以保护小鼠免受与过量盐摄入有关的高血压和记忆问题的影响，为研究提供了一个有希望的新途径。

paras.en: - Eating too much salt may do more than raise blood pressure. It could also harm memory and social behavior. In a new study, Japanese researchers discovered that a soy-derived compound called LPC70 helped protect mice from several damaging effects of a high-salt diet. Mice given the supplement had lower blood pressure, better memory, and improved social interactions compared with mice consuming excess salt alone.
paras.zh: - 吃太多盐不仅会导致血压升高。它还可能损害记忆和社交行为。在一项新研究中，日本研究人员发现，一种名为 LPC70 的大豆衍生化合物有助于保护小鼠免受高盐饮食的多种破坏性影响。与单独摄入过量盐的小鼠相比，服用补充剂的小鼠血压更低，记忆力更好，社交互动也得到改善。

paras.en: Consuming too much salt can affect more than blood pressure. Growing evidence suggests that excessive salt intake may also interfere with memory, thinking, and emotional well-being. High salt (HS) consumption is already a major public health concern because of its connection to hypertension, but its potential effects on the brain make finding ways to reduce the damage even more important.
paras.zh: 摄入过多的盐不仅会影响血压。越来越多的证据表明，摄入过多的盐还可能会干扰记忆、思维和情绪健康。高盐 (HS) 摄入量由于与高血压有关，已经成为一个主要的公共卫生问题，但它对大脑的潜在影响使得寻找减少损害的方法变得更加重要。

paras.en: Researchers in Japan have identified a promising possibility in LPC70, a compound derived from soy. Previous research found that this ingredient could reduce high blood pressure and cognitive problems associated with a high-salt diet (HSD) in mice. The latest study takes a closer look at how it works, revealing that the compound influences important chemical signals in the brain and kidneys.
paras.zh: 日本研究人员在 LPC70（一种从大豆中提取的化合物）中发现了一种有希望的可能性。先前的研究发现，这种成分可以降低小鼠的高血压和与高盐饮食 (HSD) 相关的认知问题。最新的研究仔细研究了它的工作原理，揭示了该化合物影响大脑和肾脏中的重要化学信号。

paras.en: How a Soy Compound May Counter the Effects of Excess Salt
paras.zh: 大豆化合物如何对抗过量盐的影响

paras.en: The research centers on prostaglandins (PGs), signaling molecules made from a fatty acid called arachidonic acid (AA). These substances act much like local hormones, helping regulate essential functions throughout the body.
paras.zh: 该研究的重点是前列腺素（PG），这是一种由花生四烯酸（AA）脂肪酸制成的信号分子。这些物质的作用很像局部激素，有助于调节整个身体的基本功能。

paras.en: In the cardiovascular system, prostaglandins help control blood pressure by balancing the widening and narrowing of blood vessels. Their effects in the brain are more complicated. Depending on which receptors they activate, they can trigger signals that either protect nerve cells or contribute to harmful processes, potentially affecting memory, thinking, and emotional responses.
paras.zh: 在心血管系统中，前列腺素通过平衡血管的扩张和狭窄来帮助控制血压。它们对大脑的影响更为复杂。根据它们激活的受体，它们可以触发保护神经细胞或促进有害过程的信号，从而可能影响记忆、思维和情绪反应。

paras.en: LPC70 is a form of soy lysolecithin in which lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC) accounts for more than 70% of the phospholipids. Although earlier experiments showed that LPC70 could ease salt-related hypertension and cognitive difficulties, scientists had not fully understood the mechanisms responsible, particularly its influence on prostaglandin signaling.
paras.zh: LPC70 是大豆溶血卵磷脂的一种形式，其中溶血磷脂酰胆碱 (LPC) 占磷脂的 70% 以上。尽管早期的实验表明 LPC70 可以缓解与盐相关的高血压和认知困难，但科学家们尚未完全了解其机制，特别是它对前列腺素信号传导的影响。

paras.en: To investigate, a research team led by Professor Akihiro Mouri and Dr. Hisayoshi Kubota, working with Dr. Kazuhiro Kagotani, examined how LPC70 affected these signaling pathways in mice consuming a high-salt diet.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，由 Akihiro Mouri 教授和 Hisayoshi Kubota 博士领导的研究小组与 Kazuhiro Kagotani 博士合作，研究了 LPC70 如何影响高盐饮食小鼠的这些信号通路。

paras.en: Dr. Kubota, the study's first author, played a central role in the experiments. He assessed blood pressure, monitored behavioral changes, and analyzed molecular activity associated with prostaglandins. His work helped clarify how LPC70 produces different effects in the organs involved in salt-related cardiovascular and cognitive problems.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者久保田博士在实验中发挥了核心作用。他评估了血压，监测了行为变化，并分析了与前列腺素相关的分子活性。他的工作有助于阐明 LPC70 如何对涉及盐相关心血管和认知问题的器官产生不同的影响。

paras.en: Prof. Mouri and Dr. Kubota are affiliated with the Department of Regulatory Science for Evaluation and Development of Pharmaceuticals & Devices at Fujita Health University Graduate School of Medical Science, as well as the International Center for Brain Science (ICBS) at Fujita Health University in Japan. Dr. Kagotani is affiliated with Tsuji Oil Mills Co., Ltd, in Japan and the Tsuji Health and Beauty Science Laboratory at Mie University, Japan.
paras.zh: Mouri 教授和 Kubota 博士隶属于藤田保健大学医学研究生院药品与器械评估和开发监管科学系以及日本藤田保健大学国际脑科学中心 (ICBS)。 Kagotani 博士隶属于日本辻制油有限公司和日本三重大学辻健康与美容科学实验室。

paras.en: The findings were released online on May 14, 2026, and published in Volume 197 of Neurochemistry International on July 1, 2026.
paras.zh: 研究结果于2026年5月14日在线发布，并于2026年7月1日发表在《神经化学国际》第197卷上。

paras.en: "We wanted to understand the role of LPC70 in coordinating changes in PG signaling across organ systems," mentioned Prof. Mouri. "Our study originated from a collaborative research project with Tsuji Oil Mills Co., Ltd, a company that develops naturally derived food ingredients," he added.
paras.zh: “我们想了解 LPC70 在协调跨器官系统 PG 信号传导变化中的作用，”Mouri 教授说道。 “我们的研究源于与辻油磨株式会社的合作研究项目，这是一家开发天然食品成分的公司，”他补充道。

paras.en: Soy Compound Improves Blood Pressure and Memory in Mice
paras.zh: 大豆化合物可改善小鼠的血压和记忆力

paras.en: As expected, mice that consumed a high-salt diet developed elevated blood pressure. However, the consequences extended beyond their cardiovascular health.
paras.zh: 正如预期的那样，食用高盐饮食的小鼠血压升高。然而，其后果超出了心血管健康的范围。

paras.en: The animals also became less socially interactive and had difficulty recognizing objects they had encountered before, indicating problems with memory. Interestingly, their general movement and anxiety-like behavior showed no substantial changes. This pattern suggests that excessive salt selectively disrupted more complex cognitive and social functions rather than causing widespread behavioral impairment.
paras.zh: 这些动物的社交互动也变得更少，并且难以识别它们以前遇到过的物体，这表明它们存在记忆问题。有趣的是，他们的一般运动和焦虑样行为没有表现出实质性变化。这种模式表明，过量的盐选择性地破坏了更复杂的认知和社会功能，而不是造成广泛的行为障碍。

paras.en: When researchers supplemented the animals' diets with LPC70, several of these effects were reduced. Blood pressure improved, and the mice performed better on tests of social interaction and object recognition memory.
paras.zh: 当研究人员在动物的饮食中添加 LPC70 时，其中一些影响会减弱。血压有所改善，小鼠在社交互动和物体识别记忆测试中表现更好。

paras.en: These improvements prompted the researchers to examine what was happening inside the animals' kidneys and brains.
paras.zh: 这些改进促使研究人员检查动物肾脏和大脑内部发生的情况。

paras.en: Different Protective Effects in the Kidneys and Brain
paras.zh: 对肾脏和大脑的不同保护作用

paras.en: In the kidneys, a high-salt diet increased the expression of two components involved in prostaglandin signaling: cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and the PGE2 receptor EP3. Both may contribute to the development of high blood pressure associated with excessive salt consumption.
paras.zh: 在肾脏中，高盐饮食增加了参与前列腺素信号转导的两种成分的表达：环氧合酶-2 (COX-2) 和 PGE2 受体 EP3。两者都可能导致与过量食盐相关的高血压的发生。

paras.en: LPC70 reduced these salt-related increases, suggesting that the compound helps correct changes in kidney signaling that can interfere with normal blood pressure regulation.
paras.zh: LPC70 减少了这些与盐相关的增加，表明该化合物有助于纠正可能干扰正常血压调节的肾脏信号传导的变化。

paras.en: The researchers found a different response in the prefrontal cortex, a brain region essential for thinking, memory, and social behavior.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现前额叶皮层有不同的反应，前额叶皮层是思考、记忆和社会行为所必需的大脑区域。

paras.en: Excess salt reduced the expression of the PGD2 receptor DP1, which plays a role in protective and anti-inflammatory signaling in the brain. LPC70 restored expression of this receptor without changing DP2, another receptor associated with potentially harmful effects on nerve cells.
paras.zh: 过量的盐会降低 PGD2 受体 DP1 的表达，该受体在大脑中的保护和抗炎信号传导中发挥作用。 LPC70 在不改变 DP2 的情况下恢复了该受体的表达，DP2 是另一种与神经细胞潜在有害影响相关的受体。

paras.en: This distinction is important because it suggests that LPC70 does not simply increase or suppress all prostaglandin activity. Instead, it may selectively favor signaling pathways that help protect the brain, potentially explaining the improvements in memory and social behavior observed in the mice.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为它表明 LPC70 不仅仅增加或抑制所有前列腺素活性。相反，它可能选择性地支持有助于保护大脑的信号通路，这可能解释了在小鼠中观察到的记忆力和社会行为的改善。

paras.en: A Surprising Change in Chemical Signaling
paras.zh: 化学信号的惊人变化

paras.en: The team also discovered an unexpected change involving arachidonic acid, the fatty acid the body uses to produce prostaglandins.
paras.zh: 研究小组还发现了与花生四烯酸有关的意外变化，花生四烯酸是人体用来产生前列腺素的脂肪酸。

paras.en: Mice consuming excess salt had lower levels of circulating arachidonic acid. Yet when they received LPC70, levels of prostaglandins derived from this fatty acid, including PGE2 and PGD2, increased.
paras.zh: 摄入过量盐的小鼠循环花生四烯酸水平较低。然而，当他们接受 LPC70 时，源自这种脂肪酸的前列腺素（包括 PGE2 和 PGD2）的水平增加。

paras.en: This seemingly contradictory result suggests that LPC70 may help the body use available arachidonic acid more efficiently to produce prostaglandins under high-salt conditions.
paras.zh: 这一看似矛盾的结果表明，LPC70 可能有助于身体在高盐条件下更有效地利用可用的花生四烯酸来产生前列腺素。

paras.en: Taken together, the findings reveal a coordinated but highly selective response. In the kidneys, LPC70 appears to suppress signaling changes associated with hypertension. In the brain, it restores signaling linked to protection against inflammation and damage.
paras.zh: 总而言之，这些发现揭示了一种协调但高度选择性的反应。在肾脏中，LPC70 似乎可以抑制与高血压相关的信号传导变化。在大脑中，它恢复与防止炎症和损伤相关的信号传导。

paras.en: The compound's effects therefore depend on both the organ involved and the specific prostaglandin receptors being regulated.
paras.zh: 因此，该化合物的作用取决于所涉及的器官和所调节的特定前列腺素受体。

paras.en: Could Soy-Based Ingredients Help Protect Against Excess Salt?
paras.zh: 大豆成分可以帮助防止过量的盐吗？

paras.en: The results suggest that LPC70 could eventually become a useful functional food ingredient for reducing some of the health consequences of excessive salt intake.
paras.zh: 结果表明，LPC70 最终可能成为一种有用的功能性食品成分，用于减少过量盐摄入对健康的一些影响。

paras.en: Its ability to improve blood pressure and cognitive performance in mice raises the possibility that it could support cardiovascular and brain health, particularly among people whose diets contain high amounts of salt.
paras.zh: 它改善小鼠血压和认知能力的能力增加了它支持心血管和大脑健康的可能性，特别是对于饮食中含有大量盐的人来说。

paras.en: However, the findings come from animal experiments, and further clinical studies are needed to determine whether the same benefits occur in humans.
paras.zh: 然而，这些发现来自动物实验，还需要进一步的临床研究来确定是否对人类也有同样的好处。

paras.en: "Our study elucidates LPC70's role in PG signaling, laying the groundwork for future clinical research and dietary interventions aimed at reducing hypertension-related cognitive decline and promoting healthy aging globally," concluded Prof. Mouri.
paras.zh: Mouri 教授总结道：“我们的研究阐明了 LPC70 在 PG 信号传导中的作用，为未来的临床研究和饮食干预奠定了基础，旨在减少高血压相关的认知能力下降并促进全球健康老龄化。”

paras.en: The research provides a clearer picture of how a soy-derived compound can influence the body's response to excessive salt, opening new possibilities for nutritional approaches to protecting long-term health.
paras.zh: 该研究更清楚地揭示了大豆衍生化合物如何影响身体对过量盐的反应，为保护长期健康的营养方法开辟了新的可能性。

paras.en: The study received support through Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS: 20K07931, 22K07606, 22K11891, and 23H02843).
paras.zh: 该研究得到了日本学术振兴会科学研究补助金的支持（JSPS：20K07931、22K07606、22K11891 和 23H02843）。

paras.en: Additional support came from the Fujita Mind-Brain Research & Innovation Center for Drug Generation (Fujita Mind-BRIDGe) through Japan's Peak Research Universities (J-PEAKS) Program (JPJS00420240019), along with the Japan Science and Technology Agency FOREST Program (JPMJFR215H).
paras.zh: 藤田药物生成心脑研究与创新中心 (Fujita Mind-BRIDGe) 通过日本顶尖研究大学 (J-PEAKS) 计划 (JPJS00420240019) 以及日本科学技术振兴机构森林计划 (JPMJFR215H) 提供了额外的支持。

paras.en: Tsuji Oil Mills Co., Ltd. provided funding for the research. Grants and other support were also supplied by the Education and Research Facility of Animal Models for Human Diseases at Fujita Health University, the Smoking Research Foundation, and the Takeda Science Foundation.
paras.zh: 辻制油株式会社为这项研究提供了资金。藤田保健大学人类疾病动物模型教育和研究机构、吸烟研究基金会和武田科学基金会也提供了赠款和其他支持。

articles.title: Astronomers want your help finding 'missing' black holes in the Milky Way
articles.author: Sharmila Kuthunur

paras.en: Astronomers estimate that our home galaxy, the Milky Way, has churned out more than 10 million black holes over its 13-billion-year history. Yet so far, they have found only 70.
paras.zh: 天文学家估计，我们的家乡银河系在其 130 亿年的历史中已经产生了超过 1000 万个黑洞。但到目前为止，他们只发现了 70 个。

paras.en: Now, a group of astronomers in the U.K. is trying to close that vast gap by enlisting the public. Their project, called Black Hole Hunters, is looking for volunteers with a computer and a few spare minutes to sift through troves of data gathered by a NASA space telescope. By flagging recognizable patterns that could point to a "missing" black hole, volunteers can help fast-track a search that would otherwise take years, the team says.
paras.zh: 现在，英国的一群天文学家正试图通过招募公众来缩小这一巨大差距。他们的项目名为“黑洞猎人”，正在寻找拥有计算机和几分钟空闲时间的志愿者来筛选美国宇航局太空望远镜收集的大量数据。研究小组表示，通过标记可能指向“失踪”黑洞的可识别模式，志愿者可以帮助快速进行搜索，否则可能需要数年时间。

paras.en: "You'll be narrowing down precisely where we need to point our telescopes next," project co-lead Adam McMaster, an astronomer at the University of Southampton in the U.K., said in a statement, "and you might be the one to discover a black hole."
paras.zh: 项目联合负责人、英国南安普顿大学天文学家亚当·麦克马斯特在一份声明中表示：“你将精确地缩小我们接下来需要将望远镜瞄准的位置，而你可能就是那个发现黑洞的人。”

paras.en: Black holes form when massive stars roughly 20 times heavier than our sun run out of fuel and collapse, leaving behind an abyss with gravity so immense that even light cannot escape. While invisible themselves, these cosmic behemoths reveal their presence by bending the light of nearby objects, and the Black Hole Hunters project is searching for one specific manifestation of this effect.
paras.zh: 当比太阳重大约 20 倍的大质量恒星耗​​尽燃料并坍塌时，黑洞就会形成，留下一个引力巨大的深渊，甚至连光也无法逃脱。虽然这些宇宙庞然大物本身是隐形的，但它们通过弯曲附近物体的光线来揭示它们的存在，黑洞猎人项目正在寻找这种效应的一种具体表现。

paras.en: It happens thanks to the fact that massive stars often form in pairs, and a star can sometimes survive the violent supernova explosion that turns its companion into a black hole. When that happens, the two bodies continue to orbit each other. If such a duo aligns just right with Earth, the black hole will periodically pass directly between its companion star and our planet. And when it does, the black hole's gravity acts like a cosmic magnifying glass, bending and magnifying the star's light, causing it to briefly appear brighter to watchful telescopes.
paras.zh: 这种情况的发生要归功于大质量恒星通常成对形成，并且恒星有时能够在猛烈的超新星爆炸中幸存下来，将其伴星变成黑洞。当这种情况发生时，两个物体继续绕彼此运行。如果这样的二重奏与地球恰好对齐，那么黑洞将定期直接从其伴星和我们的星球之间经过。当它发生时，黑洞的引力就像一个宇宙放大镜，弯曲和放大恒星的光线，使其在观察望远镜中短暂地显得更亮。

paras.en: To find these hidden giants, the project relies on data from NASA's Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite, or TESS. Although the satellite's primary mission is to hunt for planets beyond our solar system, its method of data collection — tracking tiny, continuous changes in a star's brightness over time — is ideally suited for identifying black hole magnification events, the project description notes.
paras.zh: 为了找到这些隐藏的巨人，该项目依赖于美国宇航局凌日系外行星勘测卫星（TESS）的数据。项目描述指出，尽管这颗卫星的主要任务是寻找太阳系以外的行星，但其数据收集方法——跟踪恒星亮度随时间的微小、连续变化——非常适合识别黑洞放大事件。

paras.en: "It's a simple task with no expertise required," McMaster said in the statement. "We will show volunteers examples of what to look for so all they have to do is recognise the right patterns."
paras.zh: 麦克马斯特在声明中说：“这是一项简单的任务，不需要专业知识。” “我们将向志愿者展示要寻找什么的示例，这样他们所要做的就是识别正确的模式。”

paras.en: Automated algorithms conduct a preliminary sweep of the TESS data, screening millions of potential stars for the most obvious black hole candidate locations, according to the project description. But, the researchers say, artificial intelligence struggles with the messy realities of the cosmos, such as stellar flares and the natural pulsations of stars that can trick the algorithms into false positives.
paras.zh: 根据项目描述，自动化算法对 TESS 数据进行初步扫描，筛选数百万颗潜在恒星，寻找最明显的黑洞候选位置。但是，研究人员表示，人工智能与宇宙的混乱现实作斗争，例如恒星耀斑和恒星的自然脉动，这些可能会欺骗算法产生误报。

paras.en: That makes human volunteers a key part of the search. To keep errors in check, each graph is shown to multiple volunteers, and their answers are combined so that individual mistakes average out, according to the project's website.
paras.zh: 这使得人类志愿者成为搜索的关键部分。据该项目的网站称，为了控制错误，每个图表都会向多名志愿者展示，并将他们的答案合并起来，以便平均个别错误。

paras.en: "I can search for black holes on my laptop from my bedroom — and could make a real impact on real space science," Grace Clarke, an undergraduate student of physics and astronomy at the University of Southampton who's involved with the project, said in the same statement. "The data's easy to understand — it's just pattern recognition — and you don't need a degree in astronomy to read it."
paras.zh: 参与该项目的南安普顿大学物理和天文学本科生格蕾丝·克拉克在同一份声明中表示：“我可以在卧室里用笔记本电脑搜索黑洞，这可能会对真正的空间科学产生真正的影响。” “这些数据很容易理解——这只是模式识别——而且你不需要天文学学位来阅读它。”

paras.en: The crowdsourced shortlist of promising signals lets astronomers aim follow-up observations at specific stars, such as precise measurements of whether a star is being tugged at by an unseen companion. Those measurements take time and are expensive, so a good shortlist helps researchers spend scarce telescope time wisely, the team says.
paras.zh: 众包的有希望信号的候选名单让天文学家可以针对特定恒星进行后续观测，例如精确测量恒星是否被看不见的伴星牵引。研究小组表示，这些测量需要时间且成本高昂，因此一份好的候选名单可以帮助研究人员明智地利用有限的望远镜时间。

paras.en: Since launching on the Zooniverse platform in October 2021, the project has attracted nearly 23,000 volunteers, who have completed more than 12 million classifications, according to its website.
paras.zh: 据其网站称，自 2021 年 10 月在 Zooniverse 平台上线以来，该项目已吸引了近 23,000 名志愿者，已完成超过 1200 万个分类。

paras.en: Before turning to TESS, the team ran a similar search using data from SuperWASP, a ground-based survey that, like TESS, monitored stars for signs of planets from 2004 to 2016. Those results are still being analyzed and are expected to be published soon.
paras.zh: 在转向 TESS 之前，该团队使用 SuperWASP 的数据进行了类似的搜索，SuperWASP 是一项地面调查，与 TESS 一样，从 2004 年到 2016 年监测恒星是否有行星迹象。这些结果仍在分析中，预计很快就会发布。

paras.en: The team also plans to widen its search with observations from other instruments, including the European Space Agency's Euclid mission and NASA's recently launched Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.
paras.zh: 该团队还计划利用其他仪器的观测来扩大搜索范围，包括欧洲航天局的欧几里得任务和美国宇航局最近发射的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜。

paras.en: "With potentially thousands of new discoveries, we need all the help we can get," McMaster said in the statement.
paras.zh: 麦克马斯特在声明中说：“可能有数千个新发现，我们需要尽可能获得的所有帮助。”

paras.en: Sharmila Kuthunur is an independent space journalist based in Bengaluru, India. Her work has also appeared in Scientific American, Science, Astronomy and Live Science, among other publications. She holds a master's degree in journalism from Northeastern University in Boston.
paras.zh: Sharmila Kuthunur 是一位驻印度班加罗尔的独立太空记者。她的作品还发表在《科学美国人》、《科学》、《天文学》和《生活科学》等出版物上。她拥有波士顿东北大学新闻学硕士学位。
