paras.en: Zelenskyy told moderator Kristen Welker that Ukrainian officials believe the decision to limit Starlink, imposed by Elon Musk’s SpaceX, came in response to a “message from American government.”
paras.zh: 泽连斯基告诉主持人克里斯汀·韦尔克，乌克兰官员认为，埃隆·马斯克的 SpaceX 实施的限制星链的决定是对“美国政府的信息”的回应。

paras.en: The U.S. has been Ukraine’s most significant backer across four and a half years of war, but personal relations between Trump and Zelenskyy have appeared severely strained in recent weeks, with each offering public criticisms of the other.
paras.zh: 在四年半的战争中，美国一直是乌克兰最重要的支持者，但特朗普和泽连斯基之间的个人关系最近几周似乎严重紧张，双方都公开批评对方。

paras.en: Asked about Trump’s remark this week that the Ukrainian leader was “more difficult to deal with than Putin,” Zelenskyy said he was “very honest” with Trump.
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普本周表示乌克兰领导人“比普京更难对付”时，泽连斯基表示他对特朗普“非常诚实”。

paras.en: “Maybe it’s not very polite,” he said, but it is “better to have partners who are very open and clear than to have those who are killers, even with a smile on their face.”
paras.zh: “也许这不太礼貌，”他说，但“拥有非常开放和清晰的合作伙伴比拥有那些脸上挂着微笑的杀手要好。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy, who accused the U.S. of betraying Kyiv last week, said that his feelings have not changed. He warned that Trump’s diesel deal with Russia “will strengthen Putin in his will to occupy us.”
paras.zh: 上周指责美国背叛基辅的泽连斯基表示，他的感受没有改变。他警告说，特朗普与俄罗斯的柴油协议“将增强普京占领我们的意志”。

paras.en: Announcing the deal week, Trump expressed hopes that it would go some way to address soaring fuel costs.
paras.zh: 特朗普在本周宣布该协议时表示，希望该协议能在某种程度上解决不断飙升的燃料成本问题。

paras.en: But Zelenskyy said the deal wouldn’t have “a real influence” on the price of oil in the U.S. because the rising prices were due to the blockage of the Strait of Hormuz, not Ukraine.
paras.zh: 但泽伦斯基表示，该协议不会对美国石油价格产生“真正影响”，因为价格上涨是由于霍尔木兹海峡的封锁，而不是乌克兰。

paras.en: “I don’t know all the reasons why President Trump makes such deals,” he said.
paras.zh: “我不知道特朗普总统做出此类交易的所有原因，”他说。

paras.en: Of the prospect of the U.S. more formally siding with Russia, he said: “If these two countries will be together ... we will not prevail, and we will not be able to stand.”
paras.zh: 在谈到美国更正式地站在俄罗斯一边的前景时，他说：“如果这两个国家在一起……我们就不会获胜，我们也将无法站立。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said it was a “pity” Trump had waived the sanctions in a bill named for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., who he said was “a great supporter of peace and of Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，“遗憾的是”特朗普在一项以已故南卡罗来纳州参议员林赛·格雷厄姆 (Lindsey Graham) 命名的法案中放弃了制裁，他称格雷厄姆是“和平与乌克兰的伟大支持者”。

paras.en: “He invested his life and time because he really believed in Ukraine,” he said.
paras.zh: “他投入了生命和时间，因为他真的相信乌克兰，”他说。

paras.en: In a separate interview on “Meet the Press,” Sen. James Lankford, R-Okla., defended Trump’s decision to lift the Russia sanctions.
paras.zh: 在接受媒体采访时，俄克拉荷马州共和党参议员詹姆斯·兰克福德为特朗普取消对俄罗斯制裁的决定进行了辩护。

paras.en: “He’s trying to walk this fine balance between trying to be able to put pressure on Russia, but also to be able to help the American people, so he is choosing the American people first is what he’s doing,” Lankford said, pointing to high gas prices.
paras.zh: 兰克福德表示，“他试图在向俄罗斯施加压力和帮助美国人民之间取得良好的平衡，因此他首先选择美国人民，这就是他所做的。”他指的是高油价。

paras.en: Asked whether Trump’s moves indicate the president is siding with Putin, Lankford said that Trump was “siding with the free people of Ukraine,” adding later that Trump was working to get the two countries “to the table to be able to negotiate.”
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普的举动是否表明总统站在普京一边时，兰克福德表示，特朗普“站在乌克兰自由人民一边”，后来又补充说，特朗普正在努力让两国“坐到谈判桌前”。

paras.en: The war has seen little recent movement on the frontline, with Russia continuing to occupy around a fifth of Ukraine. Trump had vowed to end the conflict within days of his second term, but peace talks have effectively stalled, with Ukraine saying that Russia has rejected a short-term ceasefire and that Putin’s terms for peace are tantamount to a full surrender.
paras.zh: 战争前线最近几乎没有动静，俄罗斯继续占领着乌克兰约五分之一的领土。特朗普发誓要在他的第二个任期内结束冲突，但和平谈判实际上已经陷入僵局，乌克兰表示俄罗斯拒绝短期停火，而普京的和平条件相当于全面投降。

paras.en: Meanwhile, another difficult winter looms for Ukrainian civilians, with a critical munitions shortage limiting Zelenskyy’s ability to defend infrastructure against Russian strikes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰平民又将迎来一个艰难的冬天，严重的弹药短缺限制了泽连斯基保卫基础设施免受俄罗斯袭击的能力。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said he was due to speak to U.S. negotiators by phone later Sunday and was still hopeful of a meeting in the days ahead. “I’m very open for this, even with all the difficult circumstances,” he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，他定于周日晚些时候与美国谈判代表通电话，并仍对未来几天的会面抱有希望。 “即使在困难的情况下，我对此也持开放态度，”他说。

paras.en: He cited some progress after a multiday interruption to U.S. intelligence about incoming Russian ballistic missiles, which he said has now been “deblocked.”
paras.zh: 他列举了美国有关俄罗斯弹道导弹来袭的情报经过多日中断后取得的一些进展，他说这些情报现在已经“解除封锁”。

paras.en: “We are very thankful for this,” he said. “Now it works.”
paras.zh: “我们对此非常感激，”他说。 “现在可以了。”

paras.en: European and Ukrainian officials previously told NBC News they believed that a move to limit sharing intelligence, coming only days after Trump eased sanctions on Russia, were most likely aimed at pressuring Kyiv into making concessions at the negotiating table amid a stalemate in peace talks.
paras.zh: 欧洲和乌克兰官员此前告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他们认为，在特朗普放松对俄罗斯制裁几天后采取的限制情报共享的举措很可能是为了迫使基辅在和平谈判陷入僵局的情况下在谈判桌上做出让步。

paras.en: While Zelenskyy indicated that the intelligence problem has been resolved, he said that Ukraine was still facing an ongoing speed restriction on its use of Starshield, the military version of the Starlink service.
paras.zh: 虽然泽伦斯基表示情报问题已经解决，但他表示乌克兰在使用星盾（星链服务的军用版本）方面仍面临持续的速度限制。

paras.en: Asked if he thought Trump or Musk had directly made the decision to limit Starlink, Zelenskyy said that he didn’t know but thought “both” were involved. He said that if Trump decided tomorrow to lift the restriction, “it will immediately work as it was before.”
paras.zh: 当被问及他是否认为特朗普或马斯克直接做出了限制星链的决定时，泽连斯基表示他不知道，但认为“两者”都参与其中。他说，如果特朗普明天决定取消限制，“它将立即像以前一样发挥作用。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: Aussies survives dramatic collapse to beat New Zealand in first women's T20

paras.en: Sat, 22 Aug, 11:00 pm, Final score, AUS 210, BAN 64 & 95
paras.zh: 8 月 22 日星期六，晚上 11:00，最终成绩，AUS 210，BAN 64 和 95

paras.en: Australia survives dramatic collapse to beat New Zealand by two wickets in first women's T20
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在首场女子 T20 比赛中以两个三柱门击败新西兰队，从戏剧性的崩溃中幸存下来

paras.en: Australia has beaten New Zealand by two wickets in the first ODI at North Sydney Oval.
paras.zh: 在北悉尼椭圆形球场举行的首场 ODI 比赛中，澳大利亚以两个三柱门的优势击败了新西兰。

paras.en: The hosts survived a dramatic late collapse to get home with seven balls to spare.
paras.zh: 主队在最后时刻的戏剧性崩溃中幸存下来，带着七个球回到家。

paras.en: The series continues at the same venue on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 该系列赛将于周二在同一地点继续进行。

articles.title: Jordon Steele-John says he has been falsely accused of inappropriate conduct
articles.author: Cason Ho

paras.en: Greens senator Jordan Steele-John has addressed allegations of inappropriate conduct towards women.
paras.zh: 绿党参议员乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰回应了针对女性的不当行为的指控。

paras.en: In a public statement on social media, he denied any wrongdoing and blamed the public fallout from the allegations against him on party "factionalism".
paras.zh: 在社交媒体上的公开声明中，他否认有任何不当行为，并将针对他的指控造成的公众影响归咎于政党“派系主义”。

paras.en: Senator Steele-John says he is not on leave and the matter is now subject to an internal Greens investigation.
paras.zh: 参议员斯蒂尔-约翰表示，他并没有休假，此事目前正在接受绿党内部调查。

paras.en: Greens senator Jordon Steele-John has denied allegations of inappropriate conduct raised in a letter to the Greens, which he says included false allegations of sexual assault, and blamed the public fallout from the allegations against him on party "factionalism".
paras.zh: 绿党参议员乔丹·斯蒂尔-约翰否认了在给绿党的一封信中提出的不当行为指控，他说其中包括虚假的性侵犯指控，并将针对他的指控造成的公众影响归咎于政党的“派系主义”。

paras.en: The Greens have been in crisis management since the existence of a 47-page dossier surfaced about how the WA Greens would manage media coverage of allegations made about Senator Steele-John.
paras.zh: 自从一份长达 47 页的档案浮出水面以来，绿党一直在进行危机管理，该档案涉及西澳绿党将如何应对媒体对参议员斯蒂尔-约翰的指控的报道。

paras.en: It was previously reported Senator Steele-John had taken leave from the party room last week after a letter from seven party members was sent to the office of Greens leader David Shoebridge.
paras.zh: 此前有报道称，参议员斯蒂尔-约翰上周在七名党员的一封信被送到绿党领袖大卫·舒布里奇的办公室后离开了党室。

paras.en: According to media reports the letter alleged the writers were aware of "multiple allegations" about his behaviour in the presence of women, although none of the writers was said to have direct knowledge of "the matters involved", according to Senator Shoebridge.
paras.zh: 据媒体报道，这封信称，作者们知道有关他在女性面前的行为的“多项指控”，但参议员舒布里奇表示，尽管据说没有一位作者直接了解“所涉及的事项”。

paras.en: In a public statement on social media, Senator Steele-John said, among the false allegations made against him, was an allegation of sexual assault, which police had investigated and made no adverse findings against him, with a finding of no charges.
paras.zh: 参议员斯蒂尔-约翰在社交媒体上发表的公开声明中表示，在针对他的虚假指控中，有一项是性侵犯指控，警方已经对此进行了调查，没有对他做出不利的调查结果，没有发现任何指控。

paras.en: He said that, with respect to that complaint, he had faced abuse and threats before the original complaint to police was made.
paras.zh: 他说，就该投诉而言，在向警方提出最初的投诉之前，他曾面临虐待和威胁。

paras.en: Senator Steele-John addressed several other allegations which he said were put to him by a journalist, which are now the subject of an internal Greens investigation.
paras.zh: 参议员斯蒂尔-约翰谈到了其他几项指控，他说这些指控是一名记者向他提出的，这些指控现在是绿党内部调查的主题。

paras.en: He said a nickname others used to refer to him, "Feels on wheels", had grown from its original meaning to something "more sinister".
paras.zh: 他说，其他人用来称呼他的绰号“感觉在轮子上”，已经从原来的含义变成了“更险恶的”。

paras.en: "Other parties started using [the name] to refer to me after I became emotional early in my career while giving speeches about the Royal Commission into Violence, Abuse, Neglect and Exploitation of Disabled People," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在我职业生涯早期发表有关暴力、虐待、忽视和剥削皇家委员会的演讲时，我变得情绪化，其他政党开始使用[这个名字]来称呼我。”

paras.en: "This phrase, which mocked my disability and my emotions, had taken on a new, more sinister meaning: that I had treated women inappropriately."
paras.zh: “这句话嘲笑了我的残疾和我的情绪，现在有了新的、更险恶的含义：我对待女性的方式不当。”

paras.en: The senator said his experience as a victim of abuse had collided with "political games", and denied he had taken leave after the allegations surfaced.
paras.zh: 这位参议员表示，他作为虐待受害者的经历与“政治游戏”相冲突，并否认指控浮出水面后他已休假。

paras.en: "I had hoped to be able to share all of this when I was ready, but because of a political clique in Greens WA and a leader facing his first serious test of leadership, I feel that the silence of self-protection will be [and has been] perceived as the silence of guilt," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我本来希望在准备好时能够分享这一切，但由于西澳绿党的一个政治派系和一位领导人面临着第一次严峻的领导力考验，我觉得自我保护的沉默将被视为内疚的沉默。”

paras.en: The senator claimed an "unofficial faction" of the Greens WA branch had released a letter detailing the allegations against him.
paras.zh: 这位参议员声称，绿党西澳分部的一个“非官方派别”发布了一封信，详细说明了针对他的指控。

paras.en: "This is not accountability. It is factionalism, and it has no place in the Greens," he said.
paras.zh: “这不是问责制。这是派系主义，绿党不允许这样做，”他说。

paras.en: In a statement, a Greens WA party spokesperson said they were "putting together an independent process to assess the allegations".
paras.zh: 西澳绿党发言人在一份声明中表示，他们正在“制定一个独立的程序来评估这些指控”。

paras.en: "To ensure the integrity of that process, we will not be commenting further at this time," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“为了确保该流程的完整性，我们目前不会进一步发表评论。”

paras.en: Senator Steele-John said he had asked Senator Shoebridge "not to announce that I had requested leave" as it would appear to validate the allegations against him.
paras.zh: 斯蒂尔-约翰参议员表示，他已要求舒布里奇参议员“不要宣布我已请求休假”，因为这似乎证实了对他的指控。

paras.en: "I had expected him to recognise that absent any specific allegations, there was no procedural need for me to take leave of any kind," Senator Steele-John said.
paras.zh: “我原以为他会认识到，如果没有任何具体指控，我就没有任何程序上的必要请假，”参议员斯蒂尔-约翰说。

paras.en: "It was a bad call from David. We've all made those in politics.
paras.zh: “大卫的决定很糟糕。我们在政界都曾做出过这样的决定。

paras.en: "So, to be clear, I am not on leave and did not agree to the inclusion of that line within David's statement."
paras.zh: “所以，需要明确的是，我没有休假，也不同意将这句话纳入大卫的声明中。”

paras.en: Senator Shoebridge's office has been contacted for comment.
paras.zh: 已联系参议员舒布里奇的办公室征求意见。

articles.title: French police arrest 1,800 after violent clashes and looting mar protests

paras.en: Approximately 1,800 people were arrested in France over the weekend as protests turned violent.
paras.zh: 周末，随着抗议活动演变成暴力活动，法国约有 1,800 人被捕。

paras.en: Hundreds of shops were looted in Paris and other cities and losses are estimated to be in the hundreds of millions of euros.
paras.zh: 巴黎和其他城市数百家商店遭到抢劫，损失估计达数亿欧元。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said investigations are underway and President Macron is expected to address the nation.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，调查正在进行中，预计马克龙总统将向全国发表讲话。

paras.en: France is reeling from widespread damage caused by violent protests that saw 1,800 people arrested, a historic town hall torched and widespread looting.
paras.zh: 法国正遭受暴力抗议造成的广泛破坏，1,800 人被捕，历史悠久的市政厅被纵火，还有大范围的抢劫。

paras.en: "It's like we had a war," a 78-year-old resident in central Paris, Mehmet Ozeden, said amid burnt street barricades from the protests.
paras.zh: “这就像我们经历了一场战争，”巴黎市中心 78 岁的居民穆罕默德·奥泽登 (Mehmet Ozeden) 在抗议活动烧毁的街道路障中说道。

paras.en: The convulsion raised the stakes for President Emmanuel Macron, who is in his final months in power before elections to replace him in six months' time.
paras.zh: 这次骚乱增加了总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)的赌注，他现在正处于执政的最后几个月，六个月后将举行接替他的选举。

paras.en: It followed weeks of student protests that had also turned violent at times.
paras.zh: 在此之前，学生抗议活动已持续数周，有时甚至演变成暴力事件。

paras.en: President Macron was to address the nation Sunday evening at 1800 GMT, his office said, after meeting key ministers.
paras.zh: 马克龙总统办公室表示，在与重要部长会面后，马克龙总统将于格林威治标准时间周日晚上 1800 点向全国发表讲话。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said 1,800 people were arrested over the protests and looting, with investigations under way "to identify the perpetrators of these acts so they can be brought to justice".
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，有 1,800 人因抗议和抢劫而被捕，调查正在进行中，“以查明这些行为的肇事者，以便将他们绳之以法”。

paras.en: Torched cars, smashed shopfronts and burnt debris scarred numerous streets in Paris, where officials said 557 people were in custody after a "record" number of arrests.
paras.zh: 巴黎多条街道上被烧毁的汽车、被砸毁的店面和烧焦的碎片造成伤痕累累，官员称，逮捕人数创“创纪录”，目前有 557 人被拘留。

paras.en: The capital experienced "a level of violence that we have never, I believe, seen before", said Paris deputy mayor Lamia El Aaraje.
paras.zh: 巴黎副市长拉米亚·埃尔·阿拉杰 (Lamia El Aaraje) 表示，首都经历了“我相信我们以前从未见过的暴力程度”。

paras.en: Hundreds of shops were looted in Paris and other cities, including Marseille, Bordeaux, Nice and Strasbourg, during the protests over the cost of living.
paras.zh: 在针对生活成本的抗议活动中，巴黎和马赛、波尔多、尼斯和斯特拉斯堡等其他城市的数百家商店遭到抢劫。

paras.en: One person died during the main march in Paris, but officials said it was health-related and not linked to the protest violence.
paras.zh: 巴黎主要游行期间有一人死亡，但官员表示，这与健康有关，与抗议暴力无关。

paras.en: Around 1,500 businesses were damaged, causing losses estimated in the hundreds of millions of euros, according to the Retail and Trade Federation.
paras.zh: 据零售和贸易联合会称，大约 1,500 家企业遭到破坏，造成的损失估计达数亿欧元。

paras.en: One Paris resident, Anita Gras, out for a jog between the debris, said she saw young men loot a sports shoe retailer.
paras.zh: 一位巴黎居民安妮塔·格拉斯(Anita Gras)在废墟之间慢跑时说，她看到年轻人抢劫一家运动鞋零售商。

paras.en: "They stayed until 1:00 am, we were afraid they were going to throw things at us," she said.
paras.zh: “他们一直呆到凌晨 1:00，我们担心他们会向我们扔东西，”她说。

paras.en: "It's appalling, terrifying — groups of young people came here yesterday (Saturday), looting, smashing everything, with total impunity," said another resident, 57-year-old Cecile Rogue, surveying a pile of charred bicycles.
paras.zh: 另一位居民、57 岁的塞西尔·罗格 (Cecile Rogue) 在检查一堆烧焦的自行车时说：“这令人震惊、可怕——昨天（周六）一群年轻人来到这里，抢劫、砸毁一切，却完全不受惩罚。”

paras.en: The city of Limoges lost its 19th-century town hall to a fire. The local prefect, Maurice Barate, told news channel LCI it had been deliberately set by "a wild horde" and was only brought under control early Sunday.
paras.zh: 利摩日市 19 世纪的市政厅因一场大火而被烧毁。当地省长莫里斯·巴拉特 (Maurice Barate) 告诉新闻频道 LCI，这是“一群狂野的部落”故意策划的，直到周日早些时候才得到控制。

paras.en: The mayor of Lyon, Gregory Doucet, said "the chaos that reigned in the city for several hours was abominable".
paras.zh: 里昂市长格雷戈里·杜塞特(Gregory Doucet)表示，“该市持续几个小时的混乱令人憎恶”。

paras.en: A tourist office in the centre of Lyon was set ablaze during the protests, which saw multiple clashes and looting.
paras.zh: 抗议活动期间，里昂市中心的一家旅游办公室被纵火，引发多起冲突和抢劫。

paras.en: Political recriminations have followed, with the government and far-right leader Marine Le Pen blaming ultra-left groups, while far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon accused authorities of inflaming tensions.
paras.zh: 政治指责接踵而至，政府和极右翼领导人马琳·勒庞指责极左团体，而极左翼领导人让-吕克·梅朗雄则指责当局加剧紧张局势。

paras.en: Paris's Socialist deputy mayor El Aaraje accused Ms Le Pen's party of "acting like a pyromaniac firefighter", using the protests to further her presidential ambitions.
paras.zh: 巴黎社会党副市长阿拉杰指责勒庞的政党“表现得像纵火狂消防员”，利用抗议活动来进一步实现她的总统野心。

paras.en: In Paris, startled tourists were seen Saturday running with suitcases along streets filled with tear gas and protesters.
paras.zh: 在巴黎，周六，人们看到惊慌失措的游客提着行李箱沿着充满催泪瓦斯和抗议者的街道奔跑。

paras.en: A Danish tourist, Soren Petersen, said it was "sad" to see damage to Paris buildings.
paras.zh: 丹麦游客索伦·彼得森 (Soren Petersen) 表示，看到巴黎建筑物遭到破坏，感到“悲伤”。

paras.en: "It is not a protest, it's far beyond a normal protest,"
paras.zh: “这不是抗议，这远远超出了正常的抗议，”

paras.en: An American tourist, Jill Burns, said "we were scared".
paras.zh: 一位美国游客吉尔伯恩斯说“我们很害怕”。

paras.en: Around 500 police, firefighters and paramedics were hurt in the protests, the interior minister said.
paras.zh: 内政部长表示，约 500 名警察、消防员和护理人员在抗议活动中受伤。

paras.en: The violence took place on the sidelines of nationwide protests that the interior ministry said were attended by 550,000 people.
paras.zh: 暴力事件发生在全国范围内的抗议活动期间，内政部称有 55 万人参加了抗议活动。

paras.en: The CGT union said 800,000 people participated.
paras.zh: CGT工会称有80万人参加。

paras.en: A 17-year-old boy had his right hand blown off by a crowd-control grenade in the southern city of Saint-Etienne.
paras.zh: 在南部城市圣艾蒂安，一名 17 岁男孩的右手被人群控制手榴弹炸掉。

paras.en: Analyst Mujtaba Rahman of the Eurasia Group think tank said on X that most of the demonstrations were peaceful, and "the violence came from a fringe of the ultra left" with looting "by opportunistic gangs from the poor suburbs".
paras.zh: 欧亚集团智库分析师穆吉塔巴·拉赫曼 (Mujtaba Rahman) 在 X 上表示，大多数示威活动都是和平的，“暴力来自极左翼边缘”，“来自贫困郊区的机会主义团伙”进行抢劫。

paras.en: France's Yellow Vest movement, which staged street protests eight years ago against President Macron's government over planned fuel-tax hikes, had called Saturday's "yellow and youth" demonstrations.
paras.zh: 法国的黄背心运动八年前就因计划提高燃油税而举行街头抗议活动，抗议马克龙总统的政府，并称周六的示威活动为“黄色和青年”。

paras.en: The principal grievance was the cost of living, pushed up in part by the war in the Middle East, which has helped send inflation soaring in Europe as elsewhere.
paras.zh: 主要的不满是生活成本，部分原因是中东战争推高了生活成本，这导致欧洲和其他地方的通货膨胀飙升。

articles.title: Three Italian ‘hobbits’ flew to Ireland to return this man’s ring — and it was precious
articles.author: Catherine Zhu

paras.en: Three Italian ‘hobbits’ flew to Ireland to return this man’s ring — and it was precious
paras.zh: 三名意大利“霍比特人”飞往爱尔兰归还这名男子的戒指——它很珍贵

paras.en: The unlikely quest, a testament to the power of kindness, forged an extraordinary friendship
paras.zh: 这个看似不可能的任务证明了善良的力量，并结成了非凡的友谊

paras.en: On vacation in Italy this summer, Patrick Mohr was enjoying a carefree time in a beautiful mountain stream, catching his children as they leapt from a boulder, and then one of them grabbed his hand.
paras.zh: 今年夏天，帕特里克·莫尔在意大利度假时，在美丽的山涧里享受着无忧无虑的时光，他接住孩子们从一块巨石上跳下来，然后其中一个孩子抓住了他的手。

paras.en: In an instant, Mohr’s gold wedding ring slipped off and disappeared in the fast-moving water.
paras.zh: 刹那间，莫尔的金婚戒滑落，消失在湍急的水中。

paras.en: “I just stood there a little bit paralyzed with instant knowledge it's gone,” Mohr, who is from Ireland, told As It Happens guest host Dave Seglins. “I didn't see much hope in it.”
paras.zh: “我只是站在那儿，有点不知所措，立刻就知道它已经消失了，”来自爱尔兰的莫尔告诉《发生的事》客座主持人戴夫·塞格林斯。 “我没有看到太大的希望。”

paras.en: Mohr, who has been married to his wife for 16 years, says the loss went far beyond the value of the 18-carat gold. The ring carried years of memories and sentimental meaning, making its sudden disappearance all the more devastating.
paras.zh: 与妻子结婚 16 年的莫尔表示，损失远远超出了 18 克拉黄金的价值。这枚戒指承载着多年的记忆和感伤的意义，让它的突然消失更加具有毁灭性。

paras.en: 'It's not about the gold ring, it's about the sentimental value of what it means,' said Mohr. (Submitted by Patrick Mohr)
paras.zh: 莫尔说：“这与金戒指无关，而与它所代表的情感价值有关。” （帕特里克·莫尔提交）

paras.en: His wife, meanwhile, wasn't ready to give up.
paras.zh: 与此同时，他的妻子还不准备放弃。

paras.en: She approached the only other people at the river — three Italian men — and asked if they had any swimming goggles she could borrow to search for the ring.
paras.zh: 她走近河边唯一的其他人——三名意大利男子——询问他们是否有泳镜，她可以借来寻找戒指。

paras.en: Dejected and “a bit grumpy,” Mohr says he was consumed by disappointment and had little appetite for talking to strangers.
paras.zh: 莫尔表示，他很沮丧，而且“有点脾气暴躁”，他被失望所吞噬，几乎没有兴趣与陌生人交谈。

paras.en: Still, his wife remained hopeful. She asked the other men if they would help search for the ring and exchanged phone numbers with them in case it turned up.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，他的妻子仍然充满希望。她询问其他男子是否愿意帮忙寻找戒指，并与他们交换了电话号码，以防戒指被发现。

paras.en: Filippo Palagi, one of the three friends, along with Nicola Malloggi and Edoardo Poggi, says they weren't particularly optimistic. Like Mohr, they assumed the ring was gone for good.
paras.zh: 三位朋友之一菲利波·帕拉吉 (Filippo Palagi) 以及尼古拉·马洛吉 (Nicola Malloggi) 和爱德华多·波吉 (Edoardo Poggi) 表示，他们并不是特别乐观。和莫尔一样，他们认为戒指已经永远消失了。

paras.en: But hoping to lift Mohr’s spirits, the three men conjured up a legend of their own: they would find the golden ring and return it to its rightful owner in a Lord of the Rings-style quest — an epic journey that, they joked, would take more than a thousand years.
paras.zh: 但为了振奋莫尔的精神，这三个人创造了一个属于他们自己的传奇：他们会找到金戒指，并以《指环王》式的探索将其归还给它的合法主人——他们开玩笑说，这是一段史诗般的旅程，需要一千多年的时间。

paras.en: Eager to pull off the seemingly impossible, Palagi told As It Happens the three friends threw themselves into the search, first looking for the ring from a kayak.
paras.zh: 帕拉吉告诉《As It Happens》，由于渴望完成看似不可能的任务，三个朋友投入了搜寻工作，首先是在皮划艇上寻找戒指。

paras.en: After two days without success, they decided to change their approach. They used ropes to anchor themselves to boulders and dived into the water wearing scuba masks, eventually focusing their efforts on a stretch of rapids where the current was particularly strong.
paras.zh: 两天没有成功后，他们决定改变做法。他们用绳索将自己固定在巨石上，然后戴着潜水面罩潜入水中，最终集中精力在水流特别强劲的一段急流上。

paras.en: Then, in what Palagi described as an "unbelievable" moment, Malloggi spotted a glint of light on the riverbed. Without hesitation, he reached out and grabbed the gleaming object.
paras.zh: 然后，在帕拉吉描述的“令人难以置信”的时刻，马洛吉在河床上发现了一道闪光。他毫不犹豫地伸出手，抓住了那个闪闪发光的物体。

paras.en: The gold wedding ring was recovered after a difficult search. (Submitted by Patrick Mohr)
paras.zh: 经过艰苦的搜寻，金结婚戒指被找回。 （帕特里克·莫尔提交）

paras.en: Nine days after losing his wedding band, Mohr was still vacationing in Tuscany and preparing dinner when a text arrived from an unfamiliar Italian number.
paras.zh: 失去结婚戒指九天后，莫尔仍在托斯卡纳度假并准备晚餐，这时一条陌生的意大利号码发来了短信。

paras.en: Attached was a photograph of the ring, accompanied by a message that read: “Hi Sméagol, look what we found” — a reference to a character in The Lord of the Rings.
paras.zh: 随附一张戒指的照片，并附有一条信息，上面写着：“嗨，斯麦戈，看看我们发现了什么”——指的是《指环王》中的一个角色。

paras.en: “I put the phone back in my pocket and kept stirring the pasta pot in shock,” said Mohr. “My wife looked at my expression on my face and asked me what happened.”
paras.zh: “我把手机放回口袋，震惊地不停搅拌意大利面锅，”莫尔说。 “我的妻子看着我脸上的表情，问我发生了什么事。”

paras.en: When he showed his wife and daughters the message, disbelief quickly turned to elation, and “chaos ensued.”
paras.zh: 当他向妻子和女儿们展示这一信息时，难以置信很快变成了兴高采烈，“混乱随之而来”。

paras.en: “It’s such an improbable story,” he said. “The guys most certainly didn’t have to look for us, and when they found it, they wanted to get in touch with me to tell me.”
paras.zh: “这真是一个不可能的故事，”他说。 “这些人肯定不必寻找我们，当他们找到我们时，他们想与我联系并告诉我。”

paras.en: To mark the unlikely turn of events, the three friends suggested that instead of returning it in Italy, they would return it in the quest-like fashion they embarked on their search: they would travel to Ireland.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一不太可能发生的事情，三位朋友建议他们不要在意大利归还它，而是以他们开始寻找时的探索方式归还它：他们将前往爱尔兰。

paras.en: And they decided to stay in character, casting themselves as three of the legendary hobbits: Frodo, Merry and Sam.
paras.zh: 他们决定保留角色，将自己塑造成三个传奇霍比特人：佛罗多、梅里和山姆。

paras.en: Not only did Mohr agree, but he welcomed them into his home.
paras.zh: 莫尔不仅同意了，而且还欢迎他们来到他的家。

paras.en: “They approached me, all three dressed like hobbits, playing music from the Lord of the Rings to hand me back the ring,” Mohr said. “We made friends that evening.”
paras.zh: “他们走近我，三个人都打扮得像霍比特人，播放着《指环王》中的音乐，把戒指还给我，”莫尔说。 “那天晚上我们交了朋友。”

paras.en: Mohr had planned a day of activities for the Italian hobbits, taking them to Glendalough, a famous lake and monastic site dating back more than 1,000 years, and the neighbouring valley of Glenmalure.
paras.zh: 莫尔为意大利霍比特人计划了一天的活动，带他们前往格兰达洛（Glendalough）和附近的格伦马卢尔山谷（Glendalough），这是一个著名的湖泊和修道院遗址，其历史可以追溯到 1000 多年前。

paras.en: The three Italian friends were treated to a traditional Irish meal with Mohr and his family. (Submitted by Patrick Mohr)
paras.zh: 三位意大利朋友与莫尔及其家人一起享用了传统的爱尔兰餐。 （帕特里克·莫尔提交）

paras.en: They also stopped at his local pub for a pint of Guinness before heading back to his home to meet his family over a traditional Irish meal.
paras.zh: 他们还在他当地的酒吧停下来喝了一品脱吉尼斯黑啤酒，然后返回他的家与家人一起享用传统的爱尔兰餐。

paras.en: Palagi is amazed that a chance encounter has turned into an extraordinary friendship.
paras.zh: 帕拉吉惊讶地发现，一次偶然的邂逅竟然变成了一段非凡的友谊。

paras.en: “Before that, we never knew each other, [but] now, we have a family in Ireland,” he said.
paras.zh: “在此之前，我们素不相识，但现在，我们在爱尔兰有了一个家庭，”他说。

paras.en: And Mohr said he’s gained a new belief in human kindness.
paras.zh: 莫尔说，他对人类的善良有了新的信念。

paras.en: “Sometimes you have to let go of control, sometimes you have to put things out into the universe and ask for help,” he said “And sometimes, you get an answer.”
paras.zh: “有时你必须放弃控制，有时你必须把事情放到宇宙中并寻求帮助，”他说，“有时，你会得到答案。”

articles.title: Doing the dishes and riding the subway? Why the royals keep trying to look relatable
articles.author: Janet Davison

paras.en: Doing the dishes and riding the subway? Why the royals keep trying to look relatable
paras.zh: 洗碗、坐地铁？为什么王室成员一直试图让自己看起来有亲和力

paras.en: Relatability has become a longstanding priority and challenge for monarchies
paras.zh: 相关性已成为君主制的长期优先事项和挑战

paras.en: It all seemed a bit prosaic, really, chatting about doing the dishes with her husband or riding on the subway with her daughter.
paras.zh: 真的，和丈夫一起洗碗，或者和女儿一起坐地铁，这一切似乎都有点平淡无奇。

paras.en: But there was Catherine, Princess of Wales, telling seniors how she and Prince William share the washing-up duties, and a few days later, taking a trip on the London Underground with Princess Charlotte.
paras.zh: 但威尔士王妃凯瑟琳告诉老年人她和威廉王子如何分担洗碗任务，几天后，她和夏洛特公主一起乘坐伦敦地铁。

paras.en: Beyond that glimpse into their everyday lives, though, these recent moments reflect an attempt to deal with a longstanding and more fundamental challenge that is a priority for the monarchy: how to appear relatable to a public that lives far beyond royal walls.
paras.zh: 然而，除了对他们日常生活的一瞥之外，最近的这些时刻还反映出他们试图应对一个长期存在的、更根本的挑战，这是君主制的首要任务：如何与生活在王室墙外的公众产生共鸣。

paras.en: "The monarchy isn't trying to convince us that William and Catherine are ordinary people," royal historian Justin Vovk said in an interview.
paras.zh: 皇家历史学家贾斯汀·沃克在接受采访时表示：“君主制并不是想让我们相信威廉和凯瑟琳是普通人。”

paras.en: "It's about trying to convince us that despite extraordinary circumstances, they experience the same human concerns as everybody else."
paras.zh: “这是为了让我们相信，尽管情况特殊，但他们和其他人一样经历着同样的人类担忧。”

paras.en: Efforts to do that convincing have long been a priority for monarchies throughout Europe.
paras.zh: 长期以来，努力做到这一点令人信服一直是整个欧洲君主政体的首要任务。

paras.en: Catherine, Princess of Wales, right, sits with residents onboard a West Sussex Minibus, a volunteer-led community transport group, during a visit to Pulborough, southern England, on Sept. 30. (Arthur Edwards/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 9月30日，威尔士王妃凯瑟琳（右）在访问英格兰南部普尔伯勒期间，与居民坐在西萨塞克斯小巴上，这是一个志愿者领导的社区交通组织。（亚瑟·爱德华兹/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: "Since … the political upheavals of the 19th century, which saw various monarchs … losing their thrones … there was a real consciousness that you no longer needed just the support of the elite, you needed to be relatable," said Judith Rowbotham, a social and cultural scholar and visiting research professor at the University of Plymouth in southwestern England, in an interview.
paras.zh: 英格兰西南部普利茅斯大学社会与文化学者、客座研究教授朱迪思·罗博瑟姆在接受采访时表示：“自……19世纪的政治动荡以来，多位君主……失去了王位……人们真正意识到，你不再需要精英的支持，你需要与人产生共鸣。”

paras.en: "Queen Victoria writes her highland journal — suitably sanitized — but that's an attempt to make herself relatable."
paras.zh: “维多利亚女王写她的高地日记——经过适当的消毒——但这是为了让自己与人产生共鸣。”

paras.en: What's thought of as relatable nearly 200 years ago differs from what William and Catherine and other working royals may try to do or show today. But the overall significance is the same, Rowbotham suggests.
paras.zh: 近 200 年前被认为具有相关性的事情与威廉和凯瑟琳以及其他在职王室成员今天可能尝试做或展示的事情不同。但罗博瑟姆表示，总体意义是相同的。

paras.en: "Relatability is something that modern monarchies, certainly modern European monarchies, see as genuinely important," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“现代君主国，尤其是现代欧洲君主国，认为相关性确实很重要。”

paras.en: "Particularly at a time when people are worried about money, when people are questioning government actions over taxes … the fact that yes, they live in a lavish house, but they live ordinary lives in a lavish house … that's the impression they want to give, that they don't have live-in staff, they're not surrounded by flunkies and footmen."
paras.zh: “特别是在人们担心金钱的时候，当人们质疑政府在税收方面的行动时……事实上，是的，他们住在豪华的房子里，但他们在豪华的房子里过着普通的生活……这就是他们想要给人的印象，他们没有住家员工，他们周围没有奴才和男仆。”

paras.en: As much as there is that desire to appear relatable, there is little to suggest it can ultimately eliminate the actual separation between the monarchy and the public.
paras.zh: 尽管人们希望显得有亲和力，但几乎没有迹象表明它能最终消除君主制与公众之间的实际分离。

paras.en: This 1969 photo is one of a series taken to show the informal life of Prince Charles, centre, as he sits with Queen Elizabeth, background centre, Prince Philip, second from left, Prince Edward, left, Princess Anne, background, and then Prince Andrew, right, at Sandringham House, in Sandringham, England. (The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 这张 1969 年的照片是一系列照片中的一张，展示了查尔斯王子（中）的非正式生活，当时他与伊丽莎白女王（背景中）、菲利普亲王（左二）、爱德华王子（左）、安妮公主（背景）以及安德鲁王子（右）坐在英国桑德灵厄姆宫。 （美联社）

paras.en: "There will always be distance between the monarchy and the people," said Vovk.
paras.zh: “君主政体和人民之间永远存在距离，”沃克说。

paras.en: "But all of [it], stretching from Queen Victoria up to William and Catherine is about trying to close as much of the distance as they can that is within their control."
paras.zh: “但是，从维多利亚女王到威廉和凯瑟琳，所有这一切都是为了在他们的控制范围内尽可能地拉近距离。”

paras.en: And there's a basic reason behind that, Vovk suggests.
paras.zh: 沃克表示，这背后有一个基本原因。

paras.en: "The monarchy's relevance, its viability, is now predicated on its perceived relatability and accessibility," he said.
paras.zh: “君主制的相关性和生存能力现在取决于其感知的相关性和可及性，”他说。

paras.en: "People don't want a Royal Family that is distant and isolated and feels unfamiliar. They want a Royal Family that they feel they can connect with, that they feel like if they were to bump into them on the street, they could just go up to them and talk to them."
paras.zh: “人们不想要一个遥远、孤立、陌生的王室。他们想要一个让他们觉得可以联系的王室，让他们觉得如果他们在街上碰到他们，他们可以走上前去和他们交谈。”

paras.en: That, however, creates something of a paradox.
paras.zh: 然而，这造成了一些悖论。

paras.en: "If you strip away all of the pomp and the pageantry and some of the mystique around royalty, it raises the question of what makes it so special, anyway? Why have it at all?" Vovk said. "So it is a balancing act."
paras.zh: “如果你剥去所有的排场、盛况和一些关于皇室的神秘感，就会提出一个问题：到底是什么让它如此特别？为什么要拥有它？”沃夫克说道。 “所以这是一个平衡的行为。”

paras.en: Pomp and pageantry are on full display as King Charles, left, and Queen Camilla, right, make their way along the Mall following their coronation on May 6, 2023, in London, England. (Charles McQuillan/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2023 年 5 月 6 日在英国伦敦加冕后，查尔斯国王（左）和卡米拉王后（右）沿着林荫大道行进，盛况和盛况尽收眼底。 （查尔斯·麦克奎伦/美联社）

paras.en: Other factors can play into the monarchy's focus on relatability at any given time.
paras.zh: 其他因素也会影响君主制在任何特定时间对相关性的关注。

paras.en: Queen Victoria's seclusion, particularly after the death of her husband, Prince Albert, drove concerns about relatability during her reign. Rowbotham sees another circumstance closely connected to the monarch at play right now.
paras.zh: 维多利亚女王的隐居，特别是在她的丈夫阿尔伯特亲王去世后，引发了人们对她统治期间的相关性的担忧。罗博瑟姆看到了另一个与目前正在发挥作用的君主密切相关的情况。

paras.en: "We don't know how long Charles is going to be around, given that he's in his 70s, given that he is still being treated for cancer," she said.
paras.zh: “我们不知道查尔斯还能活多久，因为他已经 70 多岁了，而且仍在接受癌症治疗，”她说。

paras.en: "This time, it's a question of assuring the monarchy's survival by making it clear that there is an heir who is well-prepared and ready to take over the duty.
paras.zh: “这一次，问题是要确保君主制的生存，明确有一个已经做好充分准备并准备好接管职责的继承人。

paras.en: "That's why I think … they're paying so much attention to the whole issue" of relatability, Rowbotham said.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我认为……他们非常关注”相关性的整个问题，罗博瑟姆说。

paras.en: Vovk sees a greater level of transparency from the current royals compared to previous generations when it comes to relatability.
paras.zh: 沃克认为，在相关性方面，现任王室成员比前几代王室成员的透明度更高。

paras.en: "We're seeing the curtain being pulled back on the aspects of royal life that are no different or at least have minimal difference from the average person — so, you know, siblings bickering, not liking doing chores, spouses sharing domestic responsibilities."
paras.zh: “我们看到皇室生活的一些方面被拉开了，这些方面与普通人没有什么不同，或者至少没有什么不同——所以，你知道，兄弟姐妹争吵，不喜欢做家务，配偶分担家庭责任。”

paras.en: On the constitutional or political side of the monarchy, however, he sees less revelation.
paras.zh: 然而，在君主制的宪法或政治方面，他看到的启示较少。

paras.en: "There's still some degree of gatekeeping going on here with what amount of royal life is being disclosed and what isn't. That will always be the case with something that is connected with the political life of the nation."
paras.zh: “对于王室生活的多少被披露，哪些没有被披露，这里仍然存在一定程度的把关。与国家政治生活相关的事情总是如此。”

paras.en: Benjamin Santiago, left, teaches Prince Edward, right, how to drive a robot using a controller at Queen's Park in Toronto on Oct. 2. (Grant and Martin Curtis/Duke of Edinburgh's International Award — Canada)
paras.zh: 10 月 2 日，本杰明·圣地亚哥（左）在多伦多皇后公园教爱德华王子（右）如何使用控制器驾驶机器人。（格兰特和马丁·柯蒂斯/爱丁堡公爵国际奖 — 加拿大）

paras.en: Benjamin Santiago had never had an experience like it.
paras.zh: 本杰明·圣地亚哥从未有过这样的经历。

paras.en: "It's not every day that you get to give a robot controller to royalty and teach them how to drive it," the Grade 12 student at St. Joseph's Catholic High School in London, Ont., said in an interview.
paras.zh: “不是每天都能向皇室赠送机器人控制器并教他们如何驾驶它，”安大略省伦敦圣约瑟夫天主教高中 12 年级的学生在接受采访时说道。

paras.en: Benjamin, a 17-year-old member of the school robotics team, had that opportunity earlier this month when he passed the controller to Prince Edward, the Duke of Edinburgh, at an event in Toronto.
paras.zh: 本杰明是学校机器人团队的一名 17 岁成员，本月早些时候，他在多伦多的一次活动中将控制器交给了爱丁堡公爵爱德华王子。

paras.en: The gathering that drew education leaders, school board representatives, industry partners and students to Queen's Park highlighted the recent announcement by the provincial Ministry of Education to expand access to the Duke of Edinburgh Award program to schools across Ontario. That comes as the award, founded by Edward's late father, Prince Philip, is evolving and working to blend trades and skills-based experiences into public education to boost opportunities for young Canadians.
paras.zh: 这次聚会吸引了教育界领袖、学校董事会代表、行业合作伙伴和学生来到女王公园，突显了省教育部最近宣布将爱丁堡公爵奖计划扩大到安大略省各地的学校。该奖项由爱德华已故的父亲菲利普亲王创立，正在不断发展，致力于将行业和基于技能的经验融入公共教育，以增加加拿大年轻人的机会。

paras.en: "It was amazing. I'm super grateful," Benjamin said of his opportunity to meet Edward. "The prince was super enthusiastic and really just interested about who we are and what our goals were as Ontario students."
paras.zh: “这太棒了。我非常感激，”本杰明谈到他有机会见到爱德华时说道。 “王子非常热情，真的只是对我们是谁以及我们作为安大略省学生的目标感兴趣。”

paras.en: In the royal encounter, Benjamin saw the potential to boost support for an area of education close to his heart.
paras.zh: 在与王室的会面中，本杰明看到了加强对他所关心的教育领域的支持的潜力。

paras.en: Benjamin says Prince Edward was 'super enthusiastic and really just interested about who we are and what our goals were as Ontario students.' (Grant and Martin Curtis/Duke of Edinburgh's International Award — Canada)
paras.zh: 本杰明说，爱德华王子“非常热情，对我们是谁以及我们作为安大略省学生的目标是什么感兴趣。” （格兰特和马丁·柯蒂斯/爱丁堡公爵国际奖——加拿大）

paras.en: "If someone like the prince can feel the controller and feel how it is to be an engineer in high school and then later on become an engineer in post-secondary … the funding towards programs like robotics may increase."
paras.zh: “如果像王子这样的人能够感受到控制器，感受到在高中成为一名工程师，然后在高等教育中成为一名工程师的感觉……对机器人等项目的资助可能会增加。”

paras.en: Edward has had a longstanding interest in youth and promoting opportunities for them, something that has been a frequent focus on his visits to Canada.
paras.zh: 爱德华长期以来一直对年轻人和为他们提供机会感兴趣，这也是他访问加拿大时经常关注的焦点。

paras.en: "He really took the time to really focus his attention on the students, which is something that I really personally admired about this, but also to make sure that every student felt seen and heard," Laura Briscoe, senior director for business development, communications and experiential education for the Duke of Edinburgh's International Award — Canada, said in an interview.
paras.zh: 加拿大爱丁堡公爵国际奖业务发展、传播和体验式教育高级总监劳拉·布里斯科 (Laura Briscoe) 在接受采访时表示：“他确实花时间将注意力集中在学生身上，这是我个人非常钦佩的一点，同时也确保每个学生都感到被看到和听到。”

paras.en: "He wants to know the realities of youth in Canada and how the award can support their lifelong learning and development, and I found him to be very responsive and open to hearing feedback, whether it's constructive feedback, what are the barriers, where are the gaps, what are we missing?"
paras.zh: “他想了解加拿大年轻人的现实，以及该奖项如何支持他们的终身学习和发展，我发现他非常敏感，愿意听取反馈，无论是建设性的反馈，障碍是什么，差距在哪里，我们缺少什么？”

paras.en: - Royal Fascinator More 'soft power signals': On heels of King's visit, Prince Edward takes week-long trip to P.E.I., Ontario
paras.zh: - Royal Fascinator 更多“软实力信号”：国王访问后，爱德华王子对安大略省爱德华王子岛进行了为期一周的访问

paras.en: - Royal Fascinator Prince Edward makes royal visit to Canada — pandemic-style
paras.zh: - 皇家迷惑者爱德华王子对加拿大进行皇室访问——流行病风格

paras.en: The Queen's Park gathering was a "wonderful experience" for everyone there, said Kathy Cepo, Benjamin's chemistry teacher and one of his robotics coaches.
paras.zh: 本杰明的化学老师、机器人教练之一凯西·塞波 (Kathy Cepo) 表示，女王公园的聚会对在场的每个人来说都是一次“美妙的经历”。

paras.en: "The prince was so engaged with these students and they felt like they were the only people in the room," she said in an interview.
paras.zh: “王子与这些学生非常互动，他们感觉自己是房间里唯一的人，”她在接受采访时说。

paras.en: "He was praising them the entire time and so proud of them."
paras.zh: “他一直在赞扬他们，并为他们感到骄傲。”

paras.en: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, left, speaks with King Charles, right, during an audience at Buckingham Palace in London on Wednesday. (Aaron Chown/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周三，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基（左）在伦敦白金汉宫接见时与查理国王（右）交谈。 （亚伦·乔恩/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Few world leaders have shaken hands with King Charles as often as the president of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 很少有世界领导人像乌克兰总统那样频繁地与查理国王握手。

paras.en: Volodymyr Zelenskyy was back in the U.K. this week, meeting Charles at Buckingham Palace on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基本周回到英国，周三在白金汉宫会见了查尔斯。

paras.en: "I thank His Majesty King Charles III for the audience," Zelenskyy posted afterward on X.
paras.zh: “我感谢查理三世国王陛下的观众，”泽连斯基随后在 X 上发帖称。

paras.en: "It is important for me to have the opportunity to personally thank him for his unwavering support for Ukraine. We appreciate all the assistance provided by the United Kingdom."
paras.zh: “对我来说，有机会亲自感谢他对乌克兰坚定不移的支持非常重要。我们感谢英国提供的所有援助。”

paras.en: It was his third meeting with the King this year, and came as the U.K. doubled down on support for Ukraine and called for its international partners to increase pressure on Russian President Vladimir Putin to respect the U.S. call for an energy ceasefire.
paras.zh: 这是他今年第三次与国王会面，此时英国加大了对乌克兰的支持，并呼吁其国际伙伴加大对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的压力，要求其尊重美国关于能源停火的呼吁。

paras.en: The King meeting with Zelenskyy "on a bit of a consistent basis is a way of … reaffirming Britain's overall support for Ukraine, even though governments are changing," said Vovk.
paras.zh: 沃夫克表示，国王与泽伦斯基的会面“在一定程度上一致的基础上是……重申英国对乌克兰的总体支持的一种方式，尽管政府正在发生变化”。

paras.en: "It's a way to reassure President Zelenskyy that the United Kingdom stands with Ukraine."
paras.zh: “这是向泽伦斯基总统保证英国与乌克兰站在一起的一种方式。”

paras.en: While a monarch is meant to be above politics, meeting with Zelenskyy would also come at the request of the U.K. government.
paras.zh: 虽然君主应该凌驾于政治之上，但与泽伦斯基的会面也是应英国政府的要求而进行的。

paras.en: "The King isn't being party political, taking sides. He's doing his constitutional duty," said Rowbotham.
paras.zh: 罗博瑟姆说：“国王并没有参与政党政治、选边站队。他正在履行宪法赋予的职责。”

paras.en: Prince Harry and Meghan step out in Nottingham
paras.zh: 哈里王子和梅根在诺丁汉外出

paras.en: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, left, and Prince Harry, right, greet well-wishers as they arrive at the Community Recording Studio, a youth and community charity that offers a wide range of creative activities, sports, mentoring and youth development programs, in Nottingham, England, on Thursday. (Christopher Furlong/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周四，苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根（左）和哈里王子（右）在抵达英国诺丁汉的社区录音室时向祝福者致意，这是一个青年和社区慈善机构，提供广泛的创意活动、体育、指导和青年发展项目。 （克里斯托弗·弗隆/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: They aren't official working members of the Royal Family anymore.
paras.zh: 他们不再是王室的正式工作成员。

paras.en: But the casual passerby could be forgiven for being a bit confused Thursday as Prince Harry and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, carried out events connected with their private charitable interests in the city where they did their first public outing as an engaged couple nearly a decade ago. It was their first joint appearance in public since they returned to the U.K. from California in late August.
paras.zh: 但周四，当哈里王子和苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根在这座城市举办与他们的私人慈善利益相关的活动时，路人的困惑是可以原谅的，近十年前，他们作为订婚夫妇第一次公开郊游。这是他们自八月下旬从加利福尼亚返回英国以来首次联合亮相。

paras.en: "It's great to be back," Harry said. "Wonderful and great to be back in Nottingham, too."
paras.zh: “很高兴回来，”哈利说。 “回到诺丁汉也很棒。”

paras.en: They began by visiting a recording studio run by a youth and community charity that has received support from a 1.1-million-pound ($2.1-million Cdn) donation announced by Harry last year.
paras.zh: 他们首先参观了一家由青年和社区慈善机构运营的录音室，该慈善机构得到了哈利去年宣布的 110 万英镑（210 万加元）捐款的支持。

paras.en: At their next stop at the Himmah charity, which tackles food poverty, Meghan was reunited with four contributors to a charity cookbook released to raise funds in the wake of London's 2017 Grenfell Tower fire disaster. She had donated 10,000 pounds ($18,800 Cdn) from the book's proceeds to help the Himmah hub.
paras.zh: 在下一站前往解决粮食贫困问题的 Himmah 慈善机构时，梅根与四位撰稿人重聚，共同编写了一本慈善食谱，该书旨在在 2017 年伦敦格伦菲尔大厦火灾后筹集资金。她从这本书的收益中捐赠了 10,000 英镑（18,800 加元）来帮助 Himmah 中心。

paras.en: Thursday's visit was the first pre-arranged and advertised occasion since their return, Rowbotham said, but it was not an official royal event.
paras.zh: 罗博瑟姆说，周四的访问是他们回国后第一次预先安排和宣传的活动，但这不是官方的王室活动。

paras.en: "However, it was carefully arranged to ensure media reportage and a suitable turnout of sympathetic public by choosing a location — Nottingham — which was … where they were for their first post engagement royal visit."
paras.zh: “然而，这是经过精心安排的，以确保媒体报道和同情公众的适当参与，选择了一个地点——诺丁汉——这是他们订婚后第一次王室访问的地方。”

paras.en: But it was on a much different scale, she said.
paras.zh: 但她说，规模却大不相同。

paras.en: "No local dignitaries were there in official capacity."
paras.zh: “没有当地政要以官方身份出席。”

paras.en: Vovk saw the visit as their first outing as part of "the new Sussex court."
paras.zh: 沃夫克将这次访问视为他们作为“新苏塞克斯法庭”一部分的第一次出访。

paras.en: He also sees the potential of a "problem of optics" for the monarchy where "Harry and Meghan are engaging in activities that to the average observer look really more or less the same [as] what the monarchy does."
paras.zh: 他还看到了王室潜在的“光学问题”，“哈里和梅根所从事的活动对于普通观察者来说实际上或多或少与王室所做的事情相同。”

paras.en: Prince Harry and Meghan, Duke and Duchess of Sussex, visit the Himmah Hub in Nottingham, England, on Thursday. (Annabel Lee-Ellis/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 哈里王子和梅根、苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人周四参观了位于英国诺丁汉的 Himmah Hub。 （安娜贝尔·李-埃利斯/美联社）

paras.en: Vovk expects to see an escalation in public appearances and informal events from the senior working royals.
paras.zh: 沃夫克预计高级王室成员的公开露面和非正式活动将会升级。

paras.en: "I think the monarchy is now going to have to pick up the pace in terms of the kinds of engagements and public accessibility they're doing just in order to keep that clear distinction between Harry and Meghan [having] titles but they are technically private individuals from a legal, constitutional perspective," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我认为，王室现在必须在参与活动和公众参与方面加快步伐，以保持哈里和梅根之间的明确区别，他们虽然拥有头衔，但从法律和宪法的角度来看，严格来说他们是私人个体。”

paras.en: - THE ROYAL FASCINATOR Why Prince Harry and Meghan face more challenges after their return to the U.K.
paras.zh: - 王室风云人物 为什么哈里王子和梅根返回英国后面临更多挑战

paras.en: - THE ROYAL FASCINATOR The 'shockwaves' of Prince Harry and Meghan's return to the U.K.
paras.zh: - 皇家迷人 哈里王子和梅根返回英国的“冲击波”

paras.en: The biggest danger and concern for the royals, he said, is "that the brand itself could be misappropriated, misrepresented, in a way that has never really been a factor before."
paras.zh: 他说，王室面临的最大危险和担忧是“品牌本身可能被盗用、歪曲，而这种方式以前从未真正成为一个因素。”

paras.en: Rowbotham doesn't see a threat to the institution itself, although she expects it will be discussed as such.
paras.zh: 罗博瑟姆并不认为该机构本身受到威胁，尽管她预计这一问题将会得到讨论。

paras.en: "We like sitting quietly and reading. Occasionally, when I'm deep in a book, I'll hear him roaring with laughter about something."
paras.zh: “我们喜欢安静地坐着看书。有时候，当我沉浸在书本中时，我会听到他因某件事而哈哈大笑。”

paras.en: — Queen Camilla, in a television documentary, offering some insight into the reading habits of her and her husband, King Charles.
paras.zh: ——卡米拉王后在一部电视纪录片中深入了解了她和她的丈夫查尔斯国王的阅读习惯。

paras.en: Catherine, Princess of Wales, third from left, and Prince William, third from right, help behind the till during a visit to an Ikea store in Belfast, Northern Ireland, on Oct. 9. (Phil Noble/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日，威尔士王妃凯瑟琳（左三）和威廉王子（右三）在参观北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特的宜家商场时在收银台后面帮忙。（Phil Noble/Getty Images）

paras.en: British police say search warrants they secured to search properties linked to Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor had been issued unlawfully and must be quashed, but said the investigation into King Charles's younger brother was ongoing. [CBC]
paras.zh: 英国警方表示，他们为搜查与安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎有关的财产而获得的搜查令是非法发出的，必须撤销，但表示对查尔斯国王弟弟的调查仍在进行中。 [加拿大广播公司]

paras.en: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor faced a 1.8-million-pound ($3.4-million Cdn) bill to cover repair and restoration of his former Royal Lodge home in Windsor after the lease was officially surrendered. King Charles reportedly covered some of the costs. [The Guardian]
paras.zh: 正式放弃租约后，安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎 (Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor) 面临 180 万英镑（340 万加元）的账单，用于维修和恢复他在温莎的前皇家别墅 (Royal Lodge) 住宅。据报道，查尔斯国王承担了部分费用。 [卫报]

paras.en: King Charles spoke of his "special connection" to Wales while delivering an address to the Welsh Parliament. [The Independent]
paras.zh: 查尔斯国王在向威尔士议会发表讲话时谈到了他与威尔士的“特殊联系”。 [独立报]

paras.en: Zara Tindall has opened up about the tough-love upbringing she received from Princess Anne and Mark Phillips — including being told she would get no help when she decided to follow her parents into top-level equestrian sport. [Daily Mail]
paras.zh: 扎拉·廷德尔公开了安妮公主和马克·菲利普斯对她的严厉教育，包括当她决定追随父母进入顶级马术运动时，她被告知不会得到任何帮助。 [每日邮报]

paras.en: The Prince and Princess of Wales met hundreds of royal fans in south Belfast as part of a surprise visit to Northern Ireland. [Belfast Telegraph]
paras.zh: 作为对北爱尔兰的意外访问的一部分，威尔士王子和王妃在贝尔法斯特南部会见了数百名王室粉丝。 [贝尔法斯特电讯报]

paras.en: Prince William brought traffic to a halt just down the road from Buckingham Palace to play cricket with some of the game's biggest names. [The Independent]
paras.zh: 威廉王子在白金汉宫附近的道路上堵塞了交通，以便与一些板球界的大牌明星一起打板球。 [独立报]

paras.en: Prince William joins cricket stars for an informal game on The Mall in London, England, on Tuesday, in the leadup to the annual Earthshot Prize awards in Mumbai next month. (Isabel Infantes/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周二，威廉王子与板球明星一起在英国伦敦购物中心参加了一场非正式比赛，为下个月在孟买举行的年度“地球射击奖”颁奖典礼做准备。 （伊莎贝尔·因方特斯/路透社）

articles.title: St. Petersburg oil facilities ablaze as Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia

paras.en: St. Petersburg oil facilities ablaze as Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia
paras.zh: 乌克兰向俄罗斯发射1000多架无人机，圣彼得堡石油设施起火

paras.en: Ukraine targets Russian oil sites, while Russia launches attacks on Zaporizhzhia
paras.zh: 乌克兰瞄准俄罗斯石油基地，俄罗斯则对扎波罗热发动袭击

paras.en: Ukrainian strikes set an oil export terminal and a depot ablaze in St. Petersburg on Sunday as Kyiv launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia in one of its largest aerial attacks of the war.
paras.zh: 周日，乌克兰的空袭导致圣彼得堡的一个石油出口码头和一个仓库着火，基辅向俄罗斯发射了 1000 多架无人机，这是其战争中最大规模的空袭之一。

paras.en: The strikes came as tensions between Ukraine and Washington deepened, with U.S. President Donald Trump criticizing Kyiv's attacks on Russian oil infrastructure and the prospect of further U.S. sanctions against Moscow still uncertain.
paras.zh: 此次袭击发生之际，乌克兰和华盛顿之间的紧张局势加剧，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普批评基辅对俄罗斯石油基础设施的袭击，并且美国对莫斯科进一步制裁的前景仍不确定。

paras.en: One person was killed and five others were wounded in the St. Petersburg attack, which sparked fires at the Petersburg Oil Terminal and the city's Ruchi oil depot, local Gov. Alexander Beglov said. A logistics centre belonging to Russian retailer Ozon and a data centre operated by Russian tech giant VK were also targeted, the companies confirmed.
paras.zh: 当地州长亚历山大·贝格洛夫表示，圣彼得堡袭击事件导致彼得堡石油码头和该市鲁奇油库起火，造成 1 人死亡、5 人受伤。两家公司证实，俄罗斯零售商 Ozon 旗下的一个物流中心和俄罗斯科技巨头 VK 运营的一个数据中心也成为目标。

paras.en: Russia's Defence Ministry said Sunday that its forces had destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 Russian regions, the annexed Ukrainian peninsula of Crimea and the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周日表示，俄罗斯军队在俄罗斯 15 个地区、被吞并的乌克兰克里米亚半岛和黑海地区摧毁了 1,015 架乌克兰无人机。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov told Russian state news agency Tass that Kyiv was "resisting" Moscow's invasion but could not "change the current course of events."
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫告诉俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社，基辅正在“抵抗”莫斯科的入侵，但无法“改变目前的事态发展”。

paras.en: The strikes came after Trump told reporters that they did not know what his decision on further sanctions against Russia would be, despite signing an executive order Friday night waiving planned restrictions, citing U.S. national interests.
paras.zh: 袭击发生之前，特朗普告诉记者，尽管周五晚上签署了一项行政命令，以美国国家利益为由，放弃了计划中的限制，但他们不知道他对俄罗斯进一步制裁的决定是什么。

paras.en: Speaking on NBC's Meet the Press on Sunday, Zelenskyy said waiving sanctions against Russia would strengthen Putin's war effort. He also said U.S.-Ukraine intelligence sharing had resumed after being "blocked for some period of time."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周日在美国全国广播公司（NBC）的会见媒体节目中表示，放弃对俄罗斯的制裁将加强普京的战争努力。他还表示，美国与乌克兰的情报共享在“被封锁一段时间”后已恢复。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said that while he trusted Trump, siding with Moscow would be a tragedy and a "historic mistake" for Washington.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，虽然他信任特朗普，但与莫斯科站在一起将是一场悲剧，对华盛顿来说将是一个“历史性错误”。

paras.en: A local man carries carries buckets of broken glass in front a residential building damaged by a Russian airstrike in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine, on Oct. 17, 2026. (Kateryna Klochko/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 17 日，乌克兰扎波罗热，一名当地男子在一座因俄罗斯空袭而受损的住宅楼前搬运着几桶碎玻璃。（Kateryna Klochko/美联社）

paras.en: "People want to forget what's going on. But we can't give this possibility to forget, or to change reality, or to change the truth," Zelenskyy said. "We can't compare me and Putin. He's [the] aggressor. He occupied us. He killed adults and children, his soldiers. He's a terrorist. And that's why I hope that President Trump will be very clear with this position."
paras.zh: “人们想要忘记正在发生的事情。但我们不能提供这种忘记、改变现实或改变真相的可能性，”泽伦斯基说。 “我们不能将我和普京进行比较。他是侵略者。他占领了我们。他杀害了成年人和儿童，他的士兵。他是恐怖分子。这就是为什么我希望特朗普总统能够非常明确地表达这一立场。”

paras.en: A woman was killed and a six-year-old girl was among at least two other people wounded in two Russian attacks on the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia, local officials said Sunday.
paras.zh: 当地官员周日表示，在俄罗斯对乌克兰南部城市扎波罗热的两起袭击中，一名妇女被杀，一名六岁女孩和至少两人受伤。

paras.en: Russia continues energy attacks, Kyiv says
paras.zh: 基辅称俄罗斯继续进行能源袭击

paras.en: Trump announced on Oct. 11 that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire" in the 4½-year-old war, but offered no details. Kyiv reported Russian attacks on energy sites continued after Trump's announcement, and on Thursday said it had resumed strikes on Russian oil facilities after a three-day pause.
paras.zh: 特朗普于 10 月 11 日宣布，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意在长达 4.5 年的战争中实现“能源停火”，但没有提供任何细节。基辅报道称，特朗普宣布这一消息后，俄罗斯对能源设施的袭击仍在继续，并于周四表示，在暂停三天后，已恢复对俄罗斯石油设施的袭击。

paras.en: Zelenskyy wrote on X Sunday that Russia had attacked Ukraine's energy, oil and gas sectors 76 times in the week since Trump's announcement. The Ukrainian government initially said it was observing the ceasefire.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在X周日写道，自特朗普宣布这一消息以来，俄罗斯在一周内对乌克兰的能源、石油和天然气部门进行了76次袭击。乌克兰政府最初表示正在遵守停火协议。

paras.en: Energy facilities in four Ukrainian regions were struck overnight, leaving tens of thousands of families without power, he said, accusing Russia of trying to cause a blackout.
paras.zh: 他说，乌克兰四个地区的能源设施一夜之间遭到袭击，导致数以万计的家庭断电，并指责俄罗斯试图造成停电。

paras.en: "America should see that Russia is not taking any reciprocal steps in response to sanctions relief or agreements. On the contrary, they take every signal of an opportunity to make money as proof that their bet on war is paying off and they can keep fighting," he wrote.
paras.zh: 他写道：“美国应该看到，俄罗斯没有采取任何对等措施来回应制裁解除或协议。相反，他们将每一个赚钱机会的信号都视为他们对战争的赌注正在获得回报并且他们可以继续战斗的证据。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy also stressed that the war was continuing because of Russia's invasion, not Ukraine's efforts to defend itself. "It is Russia that must face pressure for peace to have a chance."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基还强调，战争之所以持续，是因为俄罗斯的入侵，而不是乌克兰的自卫努力。 “俄罗斯必须面对和平压力，才有机会。”

paras.en: Ukraine apologizes to Lithuania over drone alert
paras.zh: 乌克兰就无人机警报向立陶宛道歉

paras.en: Ukrainian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Heorhii Tykhyi apologized in a statement Sunday after a drone flew into Lithuania's airspace, prompting authorities to issue an air raid warning.
paras.zh: 一架无人机飞入立陶宛领空，促使当局发出空袭警告后，乌克兰外交部发言人赫奥希·蒂赫伊周日在一份声明中道歉。

paras.en: Tykhyi said that the incident may have resulted from Russian electronic diversion of drones during an operation against legitimate military targets in Russia.
paras.zh: 蒂赫伊表示，这起事件可能是俄罗斯在针对俄罗斯境内合法军事目标的行动中对无人机进行电子转移所致。

paras.en: Lithuanian authorities warned residents in two northern counties along the Latvian border to take cover due to a possible drone incursion early Sunday, public broadcaster LRT reported. A drone flew into Lithuania's northern Pasvalys region, damaging a moving car, the broadcaster said, citing Lithuania's National Crisis Management Centre. There were no injuries.
paras.zh: 据公共广播公司 LRT 报道，立陶宛当局警告拉脱维亚边境沿线两个北部县的居民注意躲避，因为周日早些时候可能有无人机入侵。该广播公司援引立陶宛国家危机管理中心的话说，一架无人机飞入立陶宛北部帕斯瓦利斯地区，损坏了一辆行驶中的汽车。没有人受伤。

articles.title: Populist Czech PM Babis goes empty-handed in Senate elections

paras.en: The ruling coalition of populist billionaire Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis has failed to win a single seat in elections in the Senate.
paras.zh: 民粹主义亿万富翁捷克总理安德烈·巴比斯的执政联盟未能在参议院选举中赢得一个席位。

paras.en: The result means pro-Western opposition parties control the chamber, the upper house of parliament.
paras.zh: 结果意味着亲西方的反对党控制了议会上院。

paras.en: The election on Saturday was the first electoral test for Babis after he won parliamentary elections in October 2025 that returned him to power after a break of four years since his first term as premier.
paras.zh: 周六的选举是巴比斯在 2025 年 10 月赢得议会选举后的首次选举考验，这次选举使他在首次担任总理任期四年后重新掌权。

paras.en: What happened in the Czech Senate elections?
paras.zh: 捷克参议院选举发生了什么？

paras.en: Final results from the two-day ballot showed that candidates directly linked to the opposition parties won 22 of the 27 seats up for grabs in the 81-member Senate, retaining a previous opposition majority.
paras.zh: 为期两天的投票最终结果显示，与反对党有直接关系的候选人赢得了参议院 81 名席位中的 27 个席位中的 22 个，保持了此前反对党的多数席位。

paras.en: The centrist ANO (or YES) movement led by Babis failed to win any more seats, leaving it with 14 Senate lawmakers.
paras.zh: 巴比斯领导的中间派 ANO（或 YES）运动未能赢得更多席位，只剩下 14 名参议院议员。

paras.en: "We certainly didn't expect that we wouldn't win a single Senate seat in this election," he said, but vowed to nonetheless go ahead with his government's agenda.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们当然没想到我们在这次选举中不会赢得一个参议院席位。”但他发誓仍将继续推进政府的议程。

paras.en: That includes an unpopular plan to revamp funding for the country’s public broadcasters.
paras.zh: 其中包括一项不受欢迎的改革该国公共广播公司资金的计划。

paras.en: His euroskeptic coalition has also ended direct military support for Ukraine as it defends itself against a Russian invasion, and opposed European Union policies to combat global warming.
paras.zh: 他的欧洲怀疑论联盟还结束了对乌克兰的直接军事支持，以抵御俄罗斯的入侵，并反对欧盟应对全球变暖的政策。

paras.en: Although the lower house of the Czech parliament plays the main legislative role, the Senate has a big say in passing constitutional amendments and approving Constitutional Court judges.
paras.zh: 尽管捷克议会下院发挥着主要立法作用，但参议院在通过宪法修正案和批准宪法法院法官方面拥有很大发言权。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: How reliant is Ukraine on the US-controlled Starlink internet service?

paras.en: Few technological systems have played such an important role in the war in Ukraine as Starlink, central to the communications, reconnaissance and drone operations of the Ukrainian armed forces. There are currently widespread concerns that Elon Musk's satellite internet service in Ukraine may be restricted or even switched off. In recent days, Kyiv has repeatedly reported disruptions and restrictions affecting its use.
paras.zh: 很少有技术系统像星链一样在乌克兰战争中发挥如此重要的作用，它是乌克兰武装部队通信、侦察和无人机行动的核心。目前人们普遍担心埃隆·马斯克在乌克兰的卫星互联网服务可能会受到限制甚至关闭。最近几天，基辅多次报告影响其使用的中断和限制。

paras.en: Since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022, Ukraine has made extensive use of the satellite internet service, which is operated by the US company SpaceX. With it, military personell can continue to communicate and exchange data, even when infrastructure has been destroyed or cellphone networks are down.
paras.zh: 自2022年俄罗斯开始全面入侵以来，乌克兰广泛使用了由美国SpaceX公司运营的卫星互联网服务。有了它，即使基础设施遭到破坏或手机网络瘫痪，军事人员也可以继续通信和交换数据。

paras.en: According to the Center for Security Studies (CSS) at ETH Zurich, around 50,000 Starlink terminals were in use in Ukraine in 2025. These are the system's specialised receiving and transmitting devices, which enable communications on the battlefield. They are also used to relay orders between command levels and receive drone footage.
paras.zh: 据苏黎世联邦理工学院安全研究中心 (CSS) 称，到 2025 年，乌克兰将使用约 50,000 个星链终端。这些是该系统的专用接收和传输设备，可实现战场上的通信。它们还用于在指挥级别之间传递命令并接收无人机镜头。

paras.en: The importance of the Starlink network can in part be explained by events at the beginning of the war. According to a CSS analysis, the KA-SAT satellite system previously favored by Ukraine was targeted in a cyberattack just hours before Russia's invasion. Starlink quickly became a vital alternative.
paras.zh: 战争初期发生的事件可以部分解释星链网络的重要性。 CSS 分析显示，乌克兰之前青睐的 KA-SAT 卫星系统在俄罗斯入侵前几小时遭到网络攻击。星链很快成为一个重要的替代方案。

paras.en: Starlink and Starshield: civilian versus military use
paras.zh: 星链和星盾：民用与军用

paras.en: When discussing current affairs, the terms "Starlink" and "Starshield" are often used interchangeably.
paras.zh: 在讨论时事时，“星链”和“星盾”这两个术语经常互换使用。

paras.en: However, Starlink is SpaceX's commercial satellite internet service, whereas Starshield is specifically designed for governmental and military use. While based on the same technological infrastructure, it is designed for security and defense applications.
paras.zh: 然而，Starlink 是 SpaceX 的商业卫星互联网服务，而 Starshield 是专门为政府和军事用途而设计的。虽然基于相同的技术基础设施，但它是专为安全和国防应用而设计的。

paras.en: This distinction matters, because the latest reports of restrictions seem to primarily concern systems used for military purposes. Elon Musk recently stated that Starshield systems are controlled by the US government, whereas Starlink is a commercial service operated by SpaceX.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为最新的限制报告似乎主要涉及用于军事目的的系统。埃隆·马斯克最近表示，Starshield系统由美国政府控制，而Starlink是由SpaceX运营的商业服务。

paras.en: Alongside communications, Starlink is mainly used for drone operations. The system provides an internet connection for ground, naval and aerial drones.
paras.zh: 除了通信之外，星链主要用于无人机操作。该系统为地面、海军和空中无人机提供互联网连接。

paras.en: This connection means video footage can be transmitted almost in real time, while drones can be controlled over long distances. Ukraine uses these systems for reconnaissance and attacks deep behind enemy lines.
paras.zh: 这种连接意味着视频片段几乎可以实时传输，而无人机可以远距离控制。乌克兰利用这些系统深入敌后进行侦察和攻击。

paras.en: According to ETH Zurich, images and GPS coordinates of Russian positions are also transmitted via these communication channels. The data is sent to artillery units and used to coordinate operations.
paras.zh: 据苏黎世联邦理工学院称，俄罗斯位置的图像和 GPS 坐标也通过这些通信渠道传输。数据被发送到炮兵部队并用于协调作战。

paras.en: According to Ukrainian media reports, on Tuesday night, SpaceX temporarily introduced a speed restriction for Starlink terminals in Ukraine, limiting terminals in motion to a speed of about 160 kilometers per hour (100 mph).
paras.zh: 据乌克兰媒体报道，周二晚间，SpaceX 暂时对乌克兰境内的星链终端实行速度限制，将移动中的终端速度限制在约 160 公里每小时（100 英里每小时）。

paras.en: Such a restriction has direct consequences for fast-moving Ukrainian drones, some of which travel at speeds of up to 300 kilometers per hour (186 mph). If the connection to the drone is lost, live video footage can no longer be transmitted, and the systems can no longer be controlled in real time. The drones effectively have to continue their mission while flying blind.
paras.zh: 这种限制对快速移动的乌克兰无人机有直接影响，其中一些无人机的飞行速度高达每小时 300 公里（186 英里/小时）。如果与无人机的连接丢失，则无法再传输实时视频片段，并且无法再对系统进行实时控制。无人机实际上必须在盲目飞行的情况下继续执行任务。

paras.en: Restricting or even shutting down a Starlink network would therefore not only make communication more difficult. It would also affect Ukrainian drone operations, and other military activities.
paras.zh: 因此，限制甚至关闭星链网络不仅会使通信变得更加困难。它还将影响乌克兰的无人机行动和其他军事活动。

paras.en: However, Starlink and its military counterpart, Starshield, are only one essential component of Ukraine's defense system. Ukraine also receives reconnaissance data from western partners, including information about Russian air attacks, missile launches, troop movements and anti-aircraft positions, as well as potential routes to avoid them.
paras.zh: 然而，“星链”及其军事对应物“星盾”只是乌克兰防御系统的重要组成部分。乌克兰还收到来自西方伙伴的侦察数据，包括有关俄罗斯空袭、导弹发射、部队调动和防空阵地的信息，以及避开这些袭击的潜在路线。

paras.en: This information helps with air defense and offensive operations. Without this intelligence, it would be significantly harder for Ukraine to carry out long-range drone operations against targets in Russian territory.
paras.zh: 这些信息有助于防空和进攻行动。如果没有这些情报，乌克兰将很难对俄罗斯境内的目标进行远程无人机行动。

paras.en: The two elements are particularly effective when combined. Reconnaissance data provides information about potential targets and routes, while Starlink ensures that this data can be quickly relayed to units.
paras.zh: 这两个要素结合起来特别有效。侦察数据提供有关潜在目标和路线的信息，而星链确保这些数据可以快速转发给部队。

paras.en: This is why reports that the US is limiting access to its reconnaissance data are as worrying as the possibility that Starlink might be throttled. Other NATO countries, such as the United Kingdom and France, can also provide reconnaissance data, but not to the extent as the United States.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么有关美国限制对其侦察数据的访问的报道与星链可能受到限制的可能性一样令人担忧。英国和法国等其他北约国家也可以提供侦察数据，但程度不如美国。

paras.en: Europe has several alternatives to Starlink, including Eutelsat/OneWeb. However, their ability to match Starlink's performance in wartime conditions has not yet been tested on a large scale.
paras.zh: 欧洲有多种星链替代方案，包括欧洲通信卫星公司/OneWeb。然而，它们在战时条件下与星链性能相匹配的能力尚未经过大规模测试。

paras.en: The recurrent concern about possible restrictions makes clear that satellite communications have become a central component of Ukrainian defense. And while relying on a single provider simplifies operations, it also shows how dependent modern armed forces have become on private technology companies. Experts say this marks a fundamental change in warfare.
paras.zh: 对可能的限制的反复担忧清楚地表明，卫星通信已成为乌克兰国防的核心组成部分。虽然依赖单一供应商简化了行动，但它也显示了现代武装部队对私营科技公司的依赖程度。专家表示，这标志着战争的根本变化。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ukraine's successful use of Starlink has helped the system to achieve global recognition.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰对星链的成功使用帮助该系统获得了全球认可。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: France: Young voters blase about Glucksmann's Socialists

paras.en: The historically working-class Parisian neighborhood of Belleville has gentrified in recent years. It was here that Raphael Glucksmann, a member of the European Parliament for France's center-left Socialists, celebrated his victory in the party's presidential primary on October 11.
paras.zh: 历史上巴黎工人阶级居住的贝尔维尔社区近年来已经高档化。 10 月 11 日，法国中左翼社会党欧洲议会议员拉斐尔·格鲁克斯曼 (Raphael Glucksmann) 正是在这里庆祝了他在该党总统初选中的胜利。

paras.en: Two rounds of voting had been anticipated, but the 46-year-old son of philosopher and essayist Andre Glucksmann triumphed in the first round with a convincing 66% of the vote and will be the Socialist candidate in France's 2027 presidential election.
paras.zh: 原本预计将进行两轮投票，但哲学家兼散文家安德烈·格鲁克斯曼 (Andre Glucksmann) 46 岁的儿子在第一轮投票中以令人信服的 66% 选票获胜，成为法国 2027 年总统选举的社会党候选人。

paras.en: As he left the Cantine de Belleville restaurant, Glucksmann was flour-bombed by an unidentified assailant. The following morning, he called on his rival, the left-wing French populist Jean-Luc Melenchon, to condemn attacks carried out by his supporters, though it is not clear that the attacker was indeed a supporter of Melenchon's La France Insoumise (LFI).
paras.zh: 当格鲁克斯曼离开 Cantine de Belleville 餐厅时，遭到一名身份不明的袭击者的面粉炸弹袭击。第二天早上，他呼吁他的对手、法国左翼民粹主义者让-吕克·梅朗雄谴责他的支持者发动的袭击，尽管目前尚不清楚袭击者确实是梅朗雄的“无敌法兰西”（LFI）的支持者。

paras.en: The incident has highlighted the issue set to dog Glucksmann's presidential candidacy over the coming weeks: How can he win over Melenchon's supporters if he refuses to work with their candidate?
paras.zh: 这一事件凸显了未来几周困扰格鲁克斯曼总统候选人的问题：如果他拒绝与梅朗雄的候选人合作，他如何才能赢得梅朗雄的支持者？

paras.en: "Where do you stand on Melenchon?" That was the question that dominated much of the Socialists' primary campaign. Party leader Olivier Faure spoke in favor of leaving the door open for cooperation with the LFI, but Glucksmann called for a clear break with the far left. His decisive victory is therefore also seen as a vote in favor of a clear demarcation.
paras.zh: “你在梅朗雄的立场如何？”这是主导社会党初选大部分内容的问题。该党领导人奥利维尔·福雷表示支持与LFI合作敞开大门，但格鲁克斯曼则呼吁与极左翼明确决裂。因此，他的决定性胜利也被视为对明确划界的投票。

paras.en: The other primary candidates questioned Glucksmann's political experience. Segolene Royal, a previous presidential candidate, compared his bid for the Elysee with that of an "intern" wanting to take charge of a company. She said Glucksmann had no experience in government or even running a local authority.
paras.zh: 其他初选候选人质疑格鲁克斯曼的政治经验。前总统候选人塞戈莱娜·罗亚尔(Segolene Royal)将自己对爱丽舍宫的竞购比作“实习生”想要掌管一家公司。她说格鲁克斯曼没有政府工作经验，甚至没有管理地方当局的经验。

paras.en: Despite Glucksmann's victory in the primary, his starting position is a difficult one. A poll by Toluna Harris Interactive, published the day after his win, projects that he would win 10–11% of the vote. The same poll put Melenchon on 18%, meaning the far-left man would be much more likely to reach the runoff. But the survey was conducted before Glucksmann won the primary, and so does not take into account any potential boost the nomination may give him. Still, 10% would be an improvement on the Socialists' performance in the last presidential election in 2022, when their candidate Anne Hidalgo won just 1.75% of the national vote.
paras.zh: 尽管格鲁克斯曼在初选中获胜，但他的首发位置却很困难。 Toluna Harris Interactive 在他获胜后的第二天发布了一项民意调查，预计他将赢得 10-11% 的选票。同一项民意调查显示，梅朗雄的支持率为 18%，这意味着这位极左翼人士进入决选的可能性要大得多。但这项调查是在格鲁克斯曼赢得初选之前进行的，因此没有考虑到提名可能给他带来的任何潜在推动。尽管如此，10% 仍比社会党在 2022 年上次总统选举中的表现有所改善，当时社会党候选人安妮·伊达尔戈 (Anne Hidalgo) 仅赢得了 1.75% 的全国选票。

paras.en: There is also the complication that the Socialists are banking on a man who is not even a party member to lead them from irrelevance. Raphael Glucksmann actually belongs to a small center-left party called Place Publique.
paras.zh: 还有一个复杂的问题是，社会党指望一个甚至不是党员的人来领导他们摆脱无关紧要的局面。拉斐尔·格鲁克斯曼实际上属于一个名为“公共广场”的小型中左翼政党。

paras.en: Glucksmann has his work cut out for him — especially with young people. In an Ipsos survey in September, which posited Glucksmann as the social-democratic candidate and Edouard Philippe as the only candidate from the political center, Melenchon scored 41% among the under-25s. Meanwhile, 20% of this age group supported the far-right nationalist Marine Le Pen. France's young electorate is politically divided, but Melenchon still dominates on the left.
paras.zh: 格鲁克斯曼的工作任务艰巨，尤其是针对年轻人。益普索 (Ipsos) 9 月份的一项调查显示，格鲁克斯曼 (Glucksmann) 为社会民主党候选人，爱德华·菲利普 (Edouard Philippe) 为唯一来自政治中间派的候选人，梅朗雄在 25 岁以下人群中的支持率为 41%。与此同时，这个年龄段的人有 20% 支持极右民族主义者马琳·勒庞。法国的年轻选民在政治上存在分歧，但梅朗雄仍然在左翼中占主导地位。

paras.en: The 75-year-old is currently rallying alongside the students whose protests have drawn international attention. At a rally near Clermont-Ferrand in central France , he expressed solidarity with their movement and reiterated his calls for lowering the voting age to 16 and abolishing Parcoursup, France's national admissions procedure for higher education.
paras.zh: 这位 75 岁的老人目前正与抗议活动引起国际关注的学生一起集会。在法国中部克莱蒙费朗附近的一次集会上，他表达了对他们运动的声援，并再次呼吁将投票年龄降低至 16 岁，并废除法国国家高等教育招生程序 Parcoursup。

paras.en: In an analysis for the Fondation Jean-Jaures, a Socialist-aligned think tank, the political scientist Antoine Bristielle distinguishes between a core group of committed LFI voters and the broader left. Melenchon's most loyal supporters, he says, are often young, educated city-dwellers, and many are under a lot of financial pressure. Four in ten households in this group live on a net monthly income of less than €2,000 ($2,200).
paras.zh: 在为与社会主义结盟的智库 Jean-Jaures 基金会进行的分析中，政治学家 Antoine Bristielle 将忠诚的 LFI 选民的核心群体与更广泛的左派区分开来。他说，梅朗雄最忠实的支持者往往是受过教育的年轻城市居民，其中许多人承受着巨大的经济压力。该群体中十分之四的家庭每月净收入低于 2,000 欧元（2,200 美元）。

paras.en: Bristielle estimates that just under a third of the left-wing electorate in his study care more about a left-wing victory than their allegiance to any particular party. Almost half of the people in this group are younger than 35, and would consider voting for the Socialists, the Greens, or LFI. Redistribution and an active government are important to them, but most would prefer politicians who are willing to compromise.
paras.zh: 布里斯蒂尔估计，在他的研究中，不到三分之一的左翼选民更关心左翼的胜利，而不是对任何特定政党的忠诚。该群体中几乎一半的人年龄在 35 岁以下，并且会考虑投票给社会党、绿党或 LFI。重新分配和积极的政府对他们来说很重要，但大多数人更喜欢愿意妥协的政客。

paras.en: The pattern recently observed in Germany, where young women are more likely to vote for the left and young men for the right, does not apply in France. Political scientists Anja Durovic, Nonna Mayer and Noemie Piolat found that in the 2024 European and parliamentary elections, young French women were not significantly more likely to vote for the left, or less likely to vote for the far right, than men of the same age. It remains to be seen whether this pattern will be replicated in the 2027 presidential election.
paras.zh: 最近在德国观察到的模式，即年轻女性更有可能投票支持左翼，而年轻男性则更有可能投票支持右翼，但这并不适用于法国。政治学家 Anja Durovic、Nonna Mayer 和 Noemie Piolat 发现，在 2024 年欧洲和议会选举中，法国年轻女性与同龄男性相比，投票给左翼的可能性并没有显着增加，或者投票给极右翼的可能性也没有显着降低。这种模式是否会在 2027 年总统选举中复制还有待观察。

paras.en: Glucksmann says he would ease the burden on earned income by reducing France's CSG social security tax while increasing taxes on inheritances worth more than €2 million. He also presents himself as a committed supporter of European integration, while Melenchon has called the EU a neoliberal institution. Glucksmann's political profile combines social policy demands with foreign policy positions that could also appeal to voters from the camp of the current president, Emmanuel Macron.
paras.zh: 格鲁克斯曼表示，他将通过减少法国的CSG社会保障税，同时增加价值超过200万欧元的遗产税来减轻收入负担。他还将自己描述为欧洲一体化的坚定支持者，而梅朗雄则称欧盟为新自由主义机构。格鲁克斯曼的政治形象将社会政策要求与外交政策立场结合起来，这也可能吸引现任总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙阵营的选民。

paras.en: France's Ukraine policy is one such issue. Glucksmann favors decisive support for Kyiv. Manon Aubry, a member of the European Parliament for Melenchon's LFI, says her party supports military assistance only under certain conditions, namely: The provision of aid to Ukraine must first be subject to democratic debate; it must not enable attacks deep inside Russian territory; and it must not weaken France's own defense capabilities. In 2024, LFI MPs voted against the French–Ukrainian security agreement.
paras.zh: 法国的乌克兰政策就是这样的问题之一。格鲁克斯曼赞成对基辅给予决定性支持。梅朗雄自由党的欧洲议会议员马农·奥布里表示，她的政党只有在某些条件下才支持军事援助，即：向乌克兰提供援助必须首先经过民主辩论；不得发动深入俄罗斯境内的攻击；并且不能削弱法国自身的防御能力。 2024 年，LFI 议员投票反对法国-乌克兰安全协议。

paras.en: The tension between the parties of the left was once again apparent in the aftermath of the flour attack in Belleville. The LFI MP Sebastien Delogu posted a declaration of support on X for the taxi driver who was going to have to clean his car.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尔面粉袭击事件后，左翼政党之间的紧张关系再次显现出来。 LFI 议员塞巴斯蒂安·德洛古 (Sebastien Delogu) 在 X 上发布了一份声明，支持即将不得不清洁汽车的出租车司机。

paras.en: Glucksmann must win over a lot of voters from Melenchon's camp if he is to have a chance of winning the presidency. This is likely to prove a much more difficult task than simply distancing himself from Melenchon.
paras.zh: 如果格鲁克斯曼想要有机会赢得总统宝座，他就必须赢得梅朗雄阵营的大量选民。事实证明，这可能是一项比简单地远离梅朗雄要困难得多的任务。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: EU condemns Israeli settler attack on diplomats in occupied West Bank

paras.en: The European Union has condemned an attack by Israeli settlers on a convoy carrying European diplomats in the occupied West Bank and called for action to stop the pogroms.
paras.zh: 欧盟谴责以色列定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸袭击载有欧洲外交官的车队，并呼吁采取行动制止大屠杀。

paras.en: The 27-member bloc issued its statement on Sunday, the day after masked settlers attacked a visiting delegation near the Palestinian village of Taybeh.
paras.zh: 这个由 27 个成员国组成的集团于周日发表声明，此前一天，蒙面定居者袭击了巴勒斯坦 Taybeh 村附近的一个来访代表团。

paras.en: The assault has intensified diplomatic pressure on Israel as attacks on Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest increasingly threaten journalists and foreign visitors accompanying them.
paras.zh: 这次袭击加剧了以色列面临的外交压力，因为在橄榄收获期间对巴勒斯坦农民的袭击越来越威胁到随行记者和外国游客。

paras.en: Diplomats from France, Belgium and Poland, along with representatives of the Catholic Church, were visiting the predominantly Christian village east of Ramallah to show support for Palestinian olive growers when masked men attacked them.
paras.zh: 来自法国、比利时和波兰的外交官以及天主教会的代表正在访问拉马拉以东的一个以基督教为主的村庄，以表达对巴勒斯坦橄榄种植者的支持，但蒙面男子袭击了他们。

paras.en: They threatened members of the delegation and smashed a window of a Belgian diplomatic vehicle.
paras.zh: 他们威胁代表团成员，并砸碎了比利时外交车辆的车窗。

paras.en: Bernard Baudoux, the 78-year-old mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries in northern France, said he was kicked and beaten, despite wearing the ceremonial sash identifying him as a French official.
paras.zh: 法国北部奥尔诺耶-艾梅里市 78 岁的市长伯纳德·博杜 (Bernard Baudoux) 表示，尽管他佩戴着法国官员的礼仪腰带，但他还是遭到了拳打脚踢。

paras.en: “I was thrown to the ground,” Baudoux told the Reuters news agency on Saturday.
paras.zh: “我被扔到了地上，”博杜周六告诉路透社。

paras.en: The EU said on Sunday it welcomed statements by Israeli officials condemning the attacks but expected “full accountability” and measures to prevent further violence against Palestinians and journalists.
paras.zh: 欧盟周日表示，欢迎以色列官员谴责袭击事件的声明，但期望“全面问责”并采取措施防止针对巴勒斯坦人和记者的进一步暴力行为。

paras.en: It also called on Israel to respect international law and stop expanding settlements in the occupied territory.
paras.zh: 它还呼吁以色列尊重国际法，停止在被占领土扩大定居点。

paras.en: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot called on Israel on Saturday to arrest those responsible and protect civilians.
paras.zh: 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗周六呼吁以色列逮捕肇事者并保护平民。

paras.en: Prevot said Belgian personnel were safe, although their vehicle had been damaged.
paras.zh: 普雷沃特说，比利时人员虽然车辆受损，但很安全。

paras.en: Poland’s Foreign Ministry said in a statement posted on X on Saturday evening that its diplomats were unharmed and there was no indication they had been specifically targeted.
paras.zh: 波兰外交部在周六晚间发布的一份声明中表示，该国外交官没有受伤，也没有迹象表明他们遭到了专门针对。

paras.en: Warsaw demanded an explanation from Israel and action against the attackers.
paras.zh: 华沙要求以色列做出解释并对袭击者采取行动。

paras.en: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the violence on Saturday, describing the perpetrators as rioters and said that police had opened an investigation.
paras.zh: 以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔谴责了周六的暴力事件，称肇事者是骚乱者，并表示警方已展开调查。

paras.en: He also criticised the delegation for failing to coordinate its visit with the Israeli military, arguing that advance arrangements could have helped protect the visitors.
paras.zh: 他还批评代表团未能与以色列军方协调访问，认为提前安排可能有助于保护访客。

paras.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office said violence against diplomats was unacceptable but questioned whether video circulating online provided enough evidence to establish exactly what happened.
paras.zh: 总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的办公室表示，针对外交官的暴力行为是不可接受的，但质疑网上流传的视频是否提供了足够的证据来确定到底发生了什么。

paras.en: The diplomatic incident followed another attack on Friday in the village of Abu Falah, near Ramallah. Masked settlers assaulted Palestinians harvesting olives and severely injured US photojournalist Heidi Levine, who was covering the farmers for The Washington Post.
paras.zh: 这起外交事件是在周五拉马拉附近的阿布法拉赫村发生另一起袭击事件之后发生的。蒙面定居者袭击了正在收割橄榄的巴勒斯坦人，并严重伤害了为《华盛顿邮报》报道农民的美国摄影记者海蒂·莱文 (Heidi Levine)。

paras.en: Levine said she was beaten for more than 10 minutes, despite wearing protective clothing identifying her as a journalist.
paras.zh: 莱文说，尽管她穿着表明自己是记者的防护服，但她仍遭到殴打十多分钟。

paras.en: She suffered broken ribs and underwent surgery on her hand. Her camera, phone and passport were stolen.
paras.zh: 她的肋骨骨折，手部接受了手术。她的相机、手机和护照都被偷了。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, speaking to reporters in Maryland on Saturday, urged Israel to crack down on settler pogroms and warned that President Donald Trump did not want another crisis in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周六在马里兰州对记者发表讲话，敦促以色列打击对定居者的屠杀，并警告唐纳德·特朗普总统不希望约旦河西岸再次发生危机。

paras.en: In a statement on X on Saturday evening, the US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee described Levine’s assault as a “despicable act of terror” and demanded prosecutions.
paras.zh: 在周六晚间的一份声明中，美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比（Mike Huckabee）将莱文的袭击描述为“卑鄙的恐怖行为”，并要求起诉。

paras.en: The attacks have disrupted an olive harvest that provides income for tens of thousands of Palestinian families.
paras.zh: 这些袭击扰乱了为数万巴勒斯坦家庭提供收入的橄榄收成。

paras.en: On Sunday, Israeli settlers cut down 120 olive trees on Palestinian-owned land in the village of Kisan, southeast of Bethlehem, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa.
paras.zh: 据巴勒斯坦瓦法通讯社报道，周日，以色列定居者在伯利恒东南部基桑村巴勒斯坦人拥有的土地上砍伐了 120 棵橄榄树。

paras.en: Farmers have reported assaults, stolen crops, damaged trees and restrictions preventing them from reaching their land.
paras.zh: 农民们报告了袭击、农作物被盗、树木受损以及阻止他们到达自己土地的限制。

paras.en: The United Nations humanitarian office said last week that nearly 200 settler attacks linked to this year’s harvest had caused casualties or property damage, already exceeding the 185 incidents recorded throughout last year’s season.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义办公室上周表示，近 200 起与今年收成有关的定居者袭击事件造成人员伤亡或财产损失，已超过去年整个季节记录的 185 起事件。

articles.title: Manchester United held at Leeds despite improved performance for Carrick
