paras.en: Manchester United ended a turbulent week with a frustrating 1-1 draw at Leeds on Sunday that does little to ease the pressure on beleaguered manager Michael Carrick.
paras.zh: 周日，曼联以 1-1 战平利兹联，结束了动荡的一周，但这并没有缓解陷入困境的主教练迈克尔·卡里克的压力。

paras.en: The Red Devils travelled to the Yorkshire home of their bitter rivals desperate to find a spark after just two wins in nine games in all competitions this season.
paras.zh: 红魔队在本赛季所有比赛的九场比赛中仅取得两场胜利后，来到了死敌约克郡的主场，迫切希望找到火花。

paras.en: The sense of a growing crisis at the club was exacerbated in midweek by an outburst from defender Lisandro Martinez, who took aim at the United hierarchy after a 2-0 defeat at Atletico Madrid in the Champions League.
paras.zh: 周中，后卫利桑德罗·马丁内斯的爆发加剧了俱乐部日益严重的危机感，他在冠军联赛0-2输给马德里竞技队后将目标瞄准了曼联的高层。

paras.en: The Argentina centre-back said Carrick, in his first full season in charge at Old Trafford, had been left with an under-strength squad after an underwhelming summer transfer window.
paras.zh: 这位阿根廷中后卫表示，卡里克在老特拉福德执教的第一个完整赛季在夏季转会窗口表现不佳后，球队实力不足。

paras.en: The United boss insisted on Friday that the club had “moved on” from the incident and Martinez was named in the starting lineup at Elland Road.
paras.zh: 曼联主帅周五坚称俱乐部已经从这起事件中“继续前进”，马丁内斯被任命为埃兰路的首发阵容。

paras.en: Both teams were fully committed in a feisty start to the match in Leeds but there was little goalmouth action.
paras.zh: 两支球队在利兹的比赛开局都全力以赴，但几乎没有在球门处做出任何动作。

paras.en: The first effort on target came in the 26th minute when United goalkeeper Senne Lammens clawed away a Nico Elvedi header destined for the top corner after bouncing up off the turf.
paras.zh: 第 26 分钟，曼联门将塞内·拉门斯 (Senne Lammens) 的尼科·埃尔维迪 (Nico Elvedi) 头球从草皮上弹起，球飞向球顶角，首次射门成功。

paras.en: Bryan Mbeumo, playing as United’s target man, headed wastefully wide a minute later after a fine cross from Youri Tielemans and then shot tamely at Leeds goalkeeper James Trafford.
paras.zh: 一分钟后，作为曼联门将的布莱恩·姆博莫(Bryan Mbeumo)在接到尤里·蒂莱曼斯(Youri Tielemans)的漂亮传中后头球浪费地偏出，然后温和地射向利兹联门将詹姆斯·特拉福德(James Trafford)。

paras.en: But he finally broke the deadlock in the 35th minute when Tielemans again delivered a low ball from the right which Mbeumo guided into the bottom corner for his fourth Premier League goal of the season.
paras.zh: 但他终于在第35分钟打破了僵局，蒂莱曼斯再次从右路传出一脚低传，姆贝乌莫将球送入球门底角，打进了他本赛季的第四个英超进球。

paras.en: Martinez went off at half-time as Morocco’s Noussair Mazraoui was brought into the action.
paras.zh: 半场结束时，马丁内斯下场，摩洛哥球员努塞尔·马兹拉维上场。

paras.en: Leeds started strongly after the break and were level in the 51st minute when Dominic Calvert-Lewin controlled the ball on his chest and finished at full stretch after Tarik Muharemovic got his head to the ball following a corner.
paras.zh: 中场休息后，利兹联队开局强劲，第51分钟扳平比分，多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温将球控制在胸前，塔里克·穆哈雷莫维奇开出角球后头球攻门，利兹联队全力完成比赛。

paras.en: The home team were now well on top, largely limiting Carrick’s team to counter-attacks.
paras.zh: 主队现在处于领先地位，很大程度上限制了卡里克球队的反击。

paras.en: The Man United boss made attacking substitutions in the search for a winner, bringing on Mason Mount and Matheus Cunha, but neither team could force a winner.
paras.zh: 曼联主帅在进攻上进行了换人，换上了梅森·芒特和马修斯·库尼亚，但两支球队都无法逼出制胜球。

paras.en: The point left 20-time English champions Manchester United in 13th place in the table with just one win in seven games while Leeds are seventh.
paras.zh: 这一分使得20届英格兰冠军曼联在七场比赛中只赢了一场，在积分榜上排名第13位，而利兹联则排名第七。

paras.en: Brighton stun Crystal Palace with five-star display
paras.zh: 布莱顿五星级表现击败水晶宫

paras.en: Elsewhere on Sunday, Brighton leapfrogged Arsenal into second place, at least temporarily, after humbling Crystal Palace 5-0, including a sensational Diego Gomez effort from the halfway line.
paras.zh: 周日的其他比赛中，布莱顿以 5-0 击败水晶宫，其中包括迭戈·戈麦斯在中场线的精彩射门，从而超越阿森纳跃居第二位，至少是暂时的。

paras.en: Fabian Hurzeler’s team were three goals up inside 10 minutes after an own goal from Palace defender Jaydee Canvot, Gomez’s spectacular effort and a strike from Yasin Ayari.
paras.zh: 水晶宫后卫贾迪·坎沃特的乌龙球、戈麦斯的精彩射门以及亚辛·阿亚里的进球，法比安·胡尔泽勒的球队在 ​​10 分钟内就领先三球。

paras.en: Further goals from Charalampos Kostoulas and substitute Jack Hinshelwood in the second half deepened Palace’s pain.
paras.zh: 查拉兰波斯·科斯托拉斯和替补出场的杰克·欣谢尔伍德在下半场的进一步进球加深了水晶宫的痛苦。

paras.en: The Gunners, six points behind Manchester City, are in action at Nottingham Forest in the late-afternoon kickoff.
paras.zh: 枪手队在下午晚些时候对阵诺丁汉森林队，落后曼城队六分。

paras.en: Arsenal need a win to rein in City, who have won all seven of their league games this season.
paras.zh: 阿森纳需要一场胜利来遏制曼城，曼城本赛季已经赢得了全部七场联赛。

paras.en: Enzo Maresca’s men have put together their impressive run despite off-field distractions after the club was charged with multiple breaches of Premier League financial rules.
paras.zh: 在俱乐部被指控多次违反英超联赛财务规则后，恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队尽管受到场外干扰，但仍取得了令人印象深刻的成绩。

paras.en: Bournemouth beat 10-man Sunderland 2-0 with goals from Marcus Tavernier and Evanilson for their first league win of the season.
paras.zh: 凭借马库斯·塔维尼尔和埃文尼尔森的进球，伯恩茅斯以 2-0 击败了 10 人应战的桑德兰，取得了本赛季的首场联赛胜利。

articles.title: Photos: Antigovernment protesters clash with police in Albania’s capital

paras.en: Protesters have clashed with riot police in Albania’s capital, as antigovernment demonstrations escalated into violent unrest.
paras.zh: 随着反政府示威活动升级为暴力骚乱，抗议者在阿尔巴尼亚首都与防暴警察发生冲突。

paras.en: Demonstrations have shaken Tirana since Tuesday, with thousands of protesters calling for Prime Minister Edi Rama to step down as they rally against poor university conditions, high tuition fees and corruption.
paras.zh: 自周二以来，示威活动震动了地拉那，数千名抗议者呼吁总理埃迪·拉马下台，因为他们集会反对恶劣的大学条件、高昂的学费和腐败。

paras.en: This week’s unrest follows months of antigovernment protests in the Balkan nation, initially prompted by a controversial resort development linked to United States President Donald Trump’s family.
paras.zh: 本周的骚乱是在这个巴尔干国家持续数月的反政府抗议活动之后发生的，抗议活动最初是由与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普家族有关的一个有争议的度假村开发引发的。

articles.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
articles.author: Sajad Hameed

paras.en: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
paras.zh: 路边露宿者：当亲人住院时，他们无处可住

paras.en: DELHI, India — At 2 a.m. on the sidewalk outside one of Delhi's best-known public hospitals, Shabana Kumar gently wakes her husband. They sleep in shifts of about an hour at a time because their 6-year-old son is a patient in the oncology ward, being treated for leukemia, a cancer of the blood and bone marrow. They are afraid that if they are both asleep, an urgent call could come about their son's condition and they might miss it.
paras.zh: 印度德里——凌晨 2 点，在德里最著名的公立医院之一外的人行道上，沙巴娜·库马尔轻轻地叫醒了她的丈夫。他们轮流睡觉，每次大约一个小时，因为他们 6 岁的儿子是肿瘤病房的病人，正在接受白血病（一种血液和骨髓癌症）的治疗。他们担心，如果他们都睡着了，可能会接到关于儿子病情的紧急电话，而他们可能会错过。

paras.en: The Kumar family lives more than 600 miles from Delhi in the state of Bihar. Arun, 32, works as a farmer. Shabana, 30, is a homemaker caring for their only son.
paras.zh: 库马尔一家住在距离德里 600 多英里的比哈尔邦。阿伦，32 岁，是一名农民。 30 岁的沙巴纳 (Shabana) 是一名家庭主妇，照顾唯一的儿子。

paras.en: They made the trip to Delhi because they could not afford the cost of their child's cancer treatment in Bihar. The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, or AIIMS, subsidizes expenses for families in need.
paras.zh: 他们之所以前往德里，是因为他们无力承担孩子在比哈尔邦的癌症治疗费用。全印度医学科学研究所（AIIMS）为有需要的家庭提供费用补贴。

paras.en: But for many families, there is one challenge they must bear on their own — finding a place to live in Delhi during the days, weeks, even months of treatment. Like the Kumars, families who can't afford to rent lodging often set up a temporary dwelling on the sidewalk.
paras.zh: 但对于许多家庭来说，他们必须独自承担一个挑战——在治疗的几天、几周甚至几个月期间在德里找到一个住处。和库马尔一家一样，无力租房的家庭经常在人行道上搭建临时住所。

paras.en: On a night in August, dozens of families were sleeping on blankets or sheets spread directly on the sidewalk. Some tie mosquito nets to railings to protect themselves and their kids. They keep their bags and other belongings beside them as they sleep.
paras.zh: 八月的一个晚上，几十个家庭睡在直接铺在人行道上的毯子或床单上。有些人将蚊帐绑在栏杆上以保护自己和孩子。他们睡觉时将包和其他物品放在身边。

paras.en: During the day, families move between the sidewalk and the hospital for appointments, tests, medicines and consultations. They carry their most important belongings with them while leaving less valuable items at their sleeping spot. One family member often stays behind to keep an eye on their things.
paras.zh: 白天，家人在人行道和医院之间来回走动，进行预约、检查、药物和咨询。他们随身携带最重要的物品，而将不太贵重的物品留在睡觉的地方。一名家庭成员经常留下来照看他们的东西。

paras.en: Like the family from Bihar, people who've accompanied a patient may sleep outside while the patient is housed in the hospital. In other cases, the person receiving care is seen during the day but does not have a bed, so they sleep on the sidewalk as well.
paras.zh: 就像比哈尔邦的家人一样，陪伴病人的人可能会在病人住院期间睡在外面。在其他情况下，白天会看到接受护理的人，但没有床，所以他们也睡在人行道上。

paras.en: At night, the sidewalk dwellers return to the pavement, where a small ecosystem has grown around the families. Women cook rice over makeshift brick stoves. Volunteers distribute food. Nearby shops sell medicines and other necessities. Nearby tea stalls not only serve beverages but let families charge their phones.
paras.zh: 晚上，人行道上的居民回到人行道上，在家庭周围形成了一个小型生态系统。妇女们在临时砖炉上煮饭。志愿者分发食物。附近的商店出售药品和其他必需品。附近的茶摊不仅提供饮料，还可以让家人为手机充电。

paras.en: Once strangers, they exchange information about doctors, tests and where to find a free meal or, when none is available, an affordable one they can pay for.
paras.zh: 一旦成为陌生人，他们就会交换有关医生、检查以及在哪里可以找到免费餐食的信息，或者在没有餐食的情况下，交换他们可以支付得起的餐食。

paras.en: Vishnu Singh, 38, runs a tea stall outside AIIMS.
paras.zh: 38 岁的 Vishnu Singh 在 AIIMS 外经营一个茶摊。

paras.en: "I see poor people sleeping here every day, so many that I cannot even count them," he said.
paras.zh: “我每天都看到穷人睡在这里，数量多到我都数不过来，”他说。

paras.en: At AIIMS and Safdarjung Hospital, which is associated with Vardhman Mahavir Medical College, we interviewed families who had traveled from across India, often hundreds of miles from home, to seek medical care. The two hospitals stand opposite each other, treating patients with illnesses ranging from cancer and heart conditions to intestinal disorders and other serious ailments.
paras.zh: 在 AIIMS 和与 Vardhman Mahavir 医学院相关的 Safdarjung 医院，我们采访了从印度各地（通常距离家乡数百英里）前来寻求医疗护理的家庭。两家医院相对而立，治疗从癌症、心脏病到肠道疾病和其他严重疾病的患者。

paras.en: Some families had been there for a week, others for a month or longer. For many, returning home between hospital visits was impractical, so patients and the relatives accompanying them stayed in Delhi for the duration of their care.
paras.zh: 有些家庭已经在那里呆了一周，有些则呆了一个月或更长时间。对于许多人来说，在医院就诊之间回家是不切实际的，因此患者和陪伴他们的亲属在治疗期间留在德里。

paras.en: The families we spoke with described their experiences spending days or weeks in Delhi while navigating appointments, tests, consultations and treatment.
paras.zh: 我们采访的家庭描述了他们在德里度过几天或几周的经历，同时进行预约、检查、咨询和治疗。

paras.en: It is a startling contrast — a hospital that provides critical care, that, according to its annual report, gives subsidies to thousands of poor families for treatment — and that is ringed by folks who traveled great distances to find care for a loved one and who cannot afford a place to stay.
paras.zh: 这是一个惊人的对比——一家提供重症监护的医院，根据其年度报告，为数千个贫困家庭提供治疗补贴——而医院周围都是长途跋涉为亲人寻求护理却买不起住处的人们。

paras.en: NPR reached out to the hospital by email to ask about the issue of accommodations and the community of sidewalk dwellers. The hospital did not respond.
paras.zh: NPR 通过电子邮件联系医院，询问住宿和人行道居民社区的问题。医院没有回应。

paras.en: AIIMS' website notes that its Medical Social Service Unit provides financial assistance for medical treatment and travel costs for some patients coming from outside Delhi. It also states that the unit helps arrange accommodation for out-of-town patients and their family members and caregivers at dharamshalas, traditional charitable lodging facilities affiliated with AIIMS, or other low-cost accommodation.
paras.zh: AIIMS 网站指出，其医疗社会服务部门为一些来自德里以外的患者提供医疗和旅行费用的财政援助。它还指出，该部门帮助外地患者及其家人和护理人员安排达兰萨拉的住宿、AIIMS 附属的传统慈善住宿设施或其他低成本住宿。

paras.en: The website does not say whether AIIMS pays for those accommodations or provides financial assistance specifically for the lodging costs. Shalini Yadav is one of the patients who sleeps on the sidewalk with her parents.
paras.zh: 该网站没有说明 AIIMS 是否支付这些住宿费用或专门为住宿费用提供财务援助。沙利尼·亚达夫 (Shalini Yadav) 是与父母一起睡在人行道上的患者之一。

paras.en: Yadav is a second-year college student from Piprat village in Tikamgarh district, Madhya Pradesh, in central India. She had been preparing for the state civil service examination. Her plan was to become a government officer.
paras.zh: 亚达夫是印度中部中央邦蒂卡姆加尔区皮普拉特村的一名大学生二年级学生。她一直在准备国家公务员考试。她的计划是成为一名政府官员。

paras.en: Now she is spending her days reading Gunahon Ka Devta (The God of Sins), a famous 1949 Hindi tragic romance novel written by Dharamvir Bharati, on the pavement outside AIIMS, waiting to find out when her treatment will begin and when she can go home.
paras.zh: 现在，她每天都在 AIIMS 外的人行道上阅读达拉姆维尔·巴拉蒂 (Dharamvir Bharati) 于 1949 年创作的著名印地语悲剧浪漫小说 Gunahon Ka Devta（《罪恶之神》），等待了解治疗何时开始以及何时可以回家。

paras.en: Yadav says she has been dealing with an intestinal illness for five or six years and has already undergone two operations. Her family had sought treatment elsewhere before relatives and neighbors advised them to travel to Delhi in search of better treatment at AIIMS — a trip of roughly 370 miles. "We thought AIIMS was the best hospital in India," she said. The cost of staying in Delhi was also a burden: Her family could not afford a room and had already spent thousands of rupees on travel and other expenses.
paras.zh: 亚达夫说，她患有肠道疾病已经有五六年了，并且已经接受了两次手术。她的家人曾在其他地方寻求治疗，后来亲戚和邻居建议他们前往德里，在 AIIMS 寻求更好的治疗——行程大约 370 英里。 “我们认为 AIIMS 是印度最好的医院，”她说。在德里的住宿费用也是一个负担：她的家人买不起房间，并且已经在旅行和其他费用上花费了数千卢比。

paras.en: When we interviewed her on Aug. 3, she had been there for about three weeks with her parents, Surendra Singh Yadav, 47, a farmer, and Kalpana Yadav, 45.
paras.zh: 当我们于 8 月 3 日采访她时，她已经和她的父母（47 岁的农民苏伦德拉·辛格·亚达夫 (Surendra Singh Yadav)）和 45 岁的卡尔帕纳·亚达夫 (Kalpana Yadav) 一起在那里待了大约三周。

paras.en: "We thought the facilities would be good, the doctors would be good, and everything would happen quickly. We never imagined that we would have to sleep on the road," she said.
paras.zh: “我们以为设施会很好，医生会很好，一切都会很快发生。我们从未想过我们要睡在路上，”她说。

paras.en: For her, the pavement is not just uncomfortable, it is also frightening. During the day, she says, she can manage. At night, she worries about the people around her.
paras.zh: 对她来说，人行道不仅不舒服，而且令人恐惧。她说，白天她可以应付。到了晚上，她会担心周围的人。

paras.en: "There are all kinds of people here," she says. "Some are good, but some drink or use drugs. There is shouting and fighting. As a girl, I feel very uncomfortable here at night."
paras.zh: “这里有各种各样的人，”她说。 “有些很好，但有些喝酒或吸毒。有喊叫和打架。作为一个女孩，我晚上在这里感觉很不舒服。”

paras.en: But the family has little choice. They cannot afford a room in Delhi, she says. "We have decided that we have to sleep on the road because there is no other option."
paras.zh: 但家人别无选择。她说，他们在德里买不起房间。 “我们决定必须睡在路上，因为没有其他选择。”

paras.en: During the day, Yadav goes into the hospital for appointments, tests and checkups, then returns to the pavement while waiting for the next step in her treatment. Everything is on hold — her college education, her hopes of qualifying for a government job, her father's farming work.
paras.zh: 白天，亚达夫去医院进行预约、检查和检查，然后回到人行道上等待下一步的治疗。一切都被搁置了——她的大学教育、她获得政府工作资格的希望、她父亲的农业工作。

paras.en: "It feels like we are being forced to live like this," she says.
paras.zh: “感觉就像我们被迫这样生活，”她说。

paras.en: Lakhi Bai, 62, from Ramnagar in Maihar district, Madhya Pradesh, in central India, about 500 miles away, came to Delhi seeking treatment for diabetes and a condition that she says causes numbness and a loss of sensation in parts of her body.
paras.zh: 62 岁的拉基·拜 (Lakhi Bai) 来自印度中部中央邦迈哈尔区的拉姆纳加尔 (距此约 500 英里)，她来到德里寻求糖尿病治疗，她说这种疾病导致她身体某些部位麻木和失去知觉。

paras.en: She says she could sometimes sustain an injury without feeling pain. When we met her, she had been sleeping outside Safdarjung Hospital for about 20 days. During that time, she says, she had been going to different doctors and departments for consultations and tests but had not yet received a treatment plan.
paras.zh: 她说，有时她可能会受伤而不会感到疼痛。当我们见到她时，她已经在 Safdarjung 医院外面睡了大约 20 天。她说，那段时间她曾到不同的医生和科室咨询和检查，但尚未得到治疗方案。

paras.en: Bai is a farmer and describes herself as a homemaker. She said she has three sons but is no longer in contact with them. She came to Delhi alone.
paras.zh: 白是一名农民，自称是一名家庭主妇。她说她有三个儿子，但已不再与他们联系。她独自一人来到德里。

paras.en: "I cannot afford to bring someone with me," she says. "If I bring someone, I have to pay for their food and accommodation, too."
paras.zh: “我负担不起带人一起去，”她说。 “如果我带人来，我也必须支付他们的食物和住宿费用。”

paras.en: It's been a difficult period. "Sometimes I don't even get food," she says. "I sleep with an empty stomach."
paras.zh: 这是一段艰难的时期。 “有时我什至买不到食物，”她说。 “我是空着肚子睡觉的。”

paras.en: Sleeping outside is also stressful. The heat is hard to endure, she said, as is rainwater.
paras.zh: 睡在外面也有压力。她说，炎热的天气让人难以忍受，雨水也是如此。

paras.en: "When it rains, water comes here," she said. "There is nowhere to go."
paras.zh: “下雨的时候，水就会流到这里，”她说。 “无处可去。”

paras.en: AIIMS did not respond to requests for comment about her account or the experiences described by other families interviewed for this story.
paras.zh: AIIMS 没有回应对她的账户或接受本文采访的其他家庭所描述的经历发表评论的请求。

paras.en: Bai did not know how much longer she would have to remain in Delhi. "I have no place to stay," she says. "I just pray that I can get the treatment I need and something can be done."
paras.zh: 白不知道自己还要在德里待多久。 “我没有地方住，”她说。 “我只是祈祷我能得到我需要的治疗，并且能做点什么。”

paras.en: A month outside awaiting a child's heart treatment
paras.zh: 孩子在外面等待心脏治疗一个月

paras.en: In August, Balraam Singh, 35, a brick-kiln worker from Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, had been sleeping outside Safdarjung Hospital for about a month with his wife and their 7-year-old son, Munna Singh.
paras.zh: 8 月，来自北方邦密拉特的 35 岁砖窑工人巴尔拉姆·辛格 (Balraam Singh) 与妻子和 7 岁的儿子穆纳·辛格 (Munna Singh) 在萨夫达容医院外睡了大约一个月。

paras.en: Munna has a heart condition that his father describes as a "hole in the heart."
paras.zh: 穆纳患有心脏病，他的父亲将其描述为“心中有一个洞”。

paras.en: They had come from about 50 miles away seeking further medical evaluation and treatment at Safdarjung Hospital.
paras.zh: 他们从大约 50 英里外来到萨夫达容医院寻求进一步的医疗评估和治疗。

paras.en: "We came with a lot of hope that we would find a doctor and my son would be treated," he says. "But now it feels like we may have to go back without knowing what will happen next.
paras.zh: “我们满怀希望地来到这里，希望能找到一位医生，让我的儿子得到治疗，”他说。 “但现在感觉我们可能不得不回去，而不知道接下来会发生什么。

paras.en: For Singh, who can earn $5 to $7 a day at the kiln where he works, staying in Delhi means not only a loss of income but the need to spend money on food and other daily needs.
paras.zh: 辛格在他工作的窑炉里每天可以赚到 5 至 7 美元，对于他来说，留在德里不仅意味着收入损失，还需要花钱购买食物和其他日常必需品。

paras.en: Six months of saving for another hospital visit
paras.zh: 为再次就诊节省六个月的费用

paras.en: Gulshan Bano, 38, had come to Delhi from Bihar with her 60-year-old mother, Asma Khatoon, and her 6-year-old daughter, Fiza. They had been sleeping outside Safdarjung Hospital for about a week when we met them in August.
paras.zh: 38 岁的古尔珊·巴诺 (Gulshan Bano) 与 60 岁的母亲阿斯玛·哈图恩 (Asma Khatoon) 以及 6 岁的女儿菲扎 (Fiza) 从比哈尔邦来到德里。当我们八月份见到他们时，他们已经在 Safdarjung 医院外睡了大约一周。

paras.en: Bano says her mother has had a heart condition for several years and was receiving treatment in Bihar. Her mother had undergone checkups and tests there, but the family felt she needed further evaluation and care.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，她的母亲患有心脏病好几年了，正在比哈尔邦接受治疗。她的母亲在那里接受了检查和检查，但家人认为她需要进一步的评估和护理。

paras.en: Relatives also advised them to seek treatment in Delhi, and the family decided to travel for further consultations and tests.
paras.zh: 亲戚们也建议他们去德里寻求治疗，一家人决定前往进一步咨询和检查。

paras.en: Bano said doctors have told them that her mother has a heart problem and have prescribed medication rather than recommending surgery.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，医生告诉他们，她的母亲有心脏病，并开了药物，而不是建议手术。

paras.en: The family returns to Delhi for checkups about every six months. To pay for the trips, Bano works in domestic jobs in Bihar.
paras.zh: 一家人大约每六个月返回德里进行一次检查。为了支付旅费，巴诺在比哈尔邦从事家政工作。

paras.en: "I work for months and save whatever I can, and then I come here," she says. "Whatever little money remains has to be used here."
paras.zh: “我工作了几个月，尽我所能存钱，然后才来到这里，”她说。 “剩下的一点钱都得用在这里。”

paras.en: Bano said her husband does not contribute to her mother's medical expenses and she has little choice but to keep making the journey to Delhi.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，她的丈夫不承担她母亲的医疗费用，她别无选择，只能继续前往德里。

paras.en: A visit can last about a month, Bano said, as the family waits for scheduled consultations, tests and follow-up care. Because they cannot afford other accommodation, they sleep outside the hospital between appointments and tests rather than return home and make another journey to Delhi.
paras.zh: 巴诺说，一次探访可能会持续大约一个月，家人会等待预定的咨询、检查和后续护理。由于他们无力承担其他住宿费用，他们在预约和检查之间睡在医院外面，而不是回家并再次前往德里。

paras.en: "Where should I go?" she said. "I have to come here because my mother needs treatment."
paras.zh: “我该去哪里？”她说。 “我必须来这里，因为我母亲需要治疗。”

paras.en: For families like Bano's, charities and volunteers can provide some of the practical support they need while they wait outside the hospitals.
paras.zh: 对于像巴诺这样的家庭来说，慈善机构和志愿者可以在他们在医院外等待时提供他们所需的一些实际支持。

paras.en: Rajiv Ranjan, who works with the Delhi-based Donate A Meal Trust, said his organization regularly helps patients and their attendants staying outside AIIMS and Safdarjung Hospital by distributing food, clothes and rations.
paras.zh: 拉吉夫·兰詹 (Rajiv Ranjan) 在德里的捐赠膳食信托基金 (Donate A Meal Trust) 工作，他表示，他的组织定期通过分发食品、衣服和口粮来帮助留在 AIIMS 和 Safdarjung 医院外的患者及其护理人员。

paras.en: He said the organization has seen many families remain outside the hospitals while seeking treatment or caring for relatives inside.
paras.zh: 他说，该组织发现许多家庭仍在医院外寻求治疗或照顾医院内的亲属。

paras.en: "We come here for people who sleep outside while they or their family members are receiving treatment inside the hospital," he says. "They have nowhere else to stay, so we try to help with whatever we can." The group distributes about 100 meals a day, Ranjan says.
paras.zh: “我们来这里是为了那些在外面睡觉而他们或他们的家人在医院接受治疗的人，”他说。 “他们无处可住，所以我们尽力提供帮助。” Ranjan 说，该组织每天分发大约 100 份餐食。

paras.en: Food, however, is only one of the needs.
paras.zh: 然而，食物只是需求之一。

paras.en: "People need shade from the sun, and during the rainy season they need somewhere to stay dry," Ranjan said. "Some of them take shelter under the Delhi Metro, the city's rapid-transit rail system, when it rains."
paras.zh: 兰詹说：“人们需要遮阳，在雨季，他们需要有地方保持干燥。” “下雨时，他们中的一些人会在德里地铁（该市的快速交通铁路系统）下避难。”

paras.en: For Shalini Yadav, the 20-year-old college student from Madhya Pradesh who traveled to Delhi for treatment, the food distributions and other help have become part of life outside the hospital. She said people arrive to help in whatever way they can, but the assistance does not reach everyone.
paras.zh: 对于前往德里接受治疗的中央邦 20 岁大学生沙利尼·亚达夫 (Shalini Yadav) 来说，分发食物和其他帮助已成为医院外生活的一部分。她说，人们尽其所能地提供帮助，但援助并没有惠及所有人。

paras.en: "Sometimes we get food. When we don't, we buy it nearby. But there are many people here who don't get anything to eat."
paras.zh: “有时我们能买到食物。当我们没有时，我们就在附近买。但这里有很多人没有东西吃。”

paras.en: For families, treatment means returning to Delhi again and again
paras.zh: 对于家庭来说，治疗意味着一次又一次返回德里

paras.en: Suhana Bano, 47, from Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, has been bringing her 18-year-old son, Mohammad Sameer, to Delhi for treatment for about two years.
paras.zh: 47 岁的苏哈娜·巴诺 (Suhana Bano) 来自北方邦巴雷利 (Bareilly)，她带着 18 岁的儿子穆罕默德·萨米尔 (Mohammad Sameer) 来德里接受治疗已有两年了。

paras.en: Sameer has irritable bowel syndrome. He was in seventh grade when this digestive ailment forced him to leave school. The family first sought treatment at several hospitals in Bareilly, about 155 miles from Delhi, before traveling to Safdarjung Hospital.
paras.zh: 萨米尔患有肠易激综合症。当他七年级时，这种消化疾病迫使他辍学。这家人首先在距离德里约 155 英里的巴雷利的几家医院寻求治疗，然后前往萨夫达容医院。

paras.en: Suhana Bano said the family turned to Delhi after seeking treatment locally, hoping to find the specialized care Sameer needed.
paras.zh: 苏哈娜·巴诺说，一家人在当地寻求治疗后转向德里，希望能找到萨米尔所需的专门护理。

paras.en: The family travels to Delhi whenever Sameer is due for a consultation or tests. Typically, they stay one to two months, Bano says. While in Delhi, the family sleeps outside Safdarjung because they cannot afford a room.
paras.zh: 每当萨米尔需要接受咨询或检查时，全家都会前往德里。巴诺说，通常情况下，他们会停留一到两个月。在德里期间，一家人睡在萨夫达琼外面，因为他们买不起房间。

paras.en: Aamar Singh, 60, a farmer from Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, had been sleeping outside AIIMS for about a week when we met him in April.
paras.zh: 60 岁的阿马尔·辛格 (Aamar Singh) 是北方邦哈斯拉斯 (Hathras) 的一名农民，我们四月份见到他时，他已经在 AIIMS 外面睡了大约一周了。

paras.en: His 35-year-old daughter, Neelam, was admitted to the AIIMS intensive care unit with a respiratory problem, he said. His 40-year-old sister, Rashima, stayed outside with him. At night, they sleep alongside stray dogs that also gather on the pavement.
paras.zh: 他说，他 35 岁的女儿尼拉姆 (Neelam) 因呼吸系统问题被送进 AIIMS 重症监护室。他 40 岁的妹妹拉希玛 (Rashima) 和他一起呆在外面。晚上，他们和聚集在人行道上的流浪狗一起睡觉。

paras.en: Singh does not know how long his daughter will remain in the ICU after being admitted for treatment and therefore does not know how long he will have to remain outside.
paras.zh: 辛格不知道他的女儿入院接受治疗后将在重症监护室待多久，因此也不知道他必须在外面待多久。

paras.en: Food is not always available, he said, and some days they go hungry.
paras.zh: 他说，食物并不总是可用，有时他们会挨饿。

paras.en: "Sometimes you eat, sometimes you don't," he said. "My daughter is inside, so I have to stay here. What else can I do? This is our situation."
paras.zh: “有时你吃，有时你不吃，”他说。 “我女儿在里面，所以我必须留在这里。我还能做什么？这就是我们的处境。”

paras.en: So Aamar Singh waits on the pavement for news about his daughter until he can take her home.
paras.zh: 因此，阿马尔·辛格在人行道上等待有关他女儿的消息，直到他能带她回家。

paras.en: Sajad Hameed is an India-based journalist and multimedia storyteller focusing on South Asia. He writes about politics, human rights, health, business, the economy and the impact of climate change, with particular focus on the region's evolving social and political landscape.
paras.zh: 萨贾德·哈米德 (Sajad Hameed) 是一位驻印度记者和多媒体故事讲述者，专注于南亚。他撰写的文章涉及政治、人权、健康、商业、经济和气候变化的影响，特别关注该地区不断变化的社会和政治格局。

paras.en: Rehan Qayoom Mir is an independent journalist whose work has appeared in outlets including Al Jazeera English, The Guardian, Nikkei Asia, The Progressive, Jacobin and more. He reports from across India and South Asia, with a focus on ground reporting and human-interest stories.
paras.zh: Rehan Qayoom Mir 是一名独立记者，其作品曾出现在半岛电视台英语频道、卫报、日经亚洲、进步报、雅各宾报等媒体上。他在印度和南亚各地进行报道，重点关注地面报道和人文故事。

articles.title: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
paras.zh: 军事基地发生致命事件后，阿尔伯塔省发生重大火灾

paras.en: EDMONTON, Alberta — Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at a military base in Alberta that caused a major fire, while reports said that large numbers of injured people were being transported to hospitals.
paras.zh: 艾伯塔省埃德蒙顿——加拿大国防部长周六表示，艾伯塔省一处军事基地发生火灾，造成人员伤亡，有报道称，大量伤者正在被送往医院。

paras.en: Fire crews scrambled late into the night as fierce winds whipped flames beyond Canadian Forces Base Wainwright and into the surrounding rural area.
paras.zh: 消防人员在深夜奋力救援，狂风将火焰从加拿大温赖特军事基地吹到周围的农村地区。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear how many people were killed or injured, but a doctor at a hospital in the city of Edmonton, 180 km (120 miles) northwest, told Canada's national broadcaster that patients were being brought to hospitals across the city as health-care facilities around the base became "completely overwhelmed" by the number of people needing care.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚有多少人死亡或受伤，但西北 180 公里（120 英里）的埃德蒙顿市一家医院的一名医生告诉加拿大国家广播公司，由于基地周围的医疗机构因需要护理的人数而“完全不堪重负”，患者被送往全市各地的医院。

paras.en: "This number of patients would overwhelm the city of Edmonton," Dr. Warren Thirsk, an emergency department physician at the Royal Alexandra Hospital, told CBC News. "It is more patients than any of us want to count right now. It's a disaster. It's a one in every 15 to 25-year disaster."
paras.zh: 皇家亚历山德拉医院急诊科医生沃伦·瑟斯克博士告诉加拿大广播公司新闻网：“这么多的病人将使埃德蒙顿市不堪重负。” “现在的病人数量比我们任何人想要统计的都要多。这是一场灾难。每 15 到 25 年的灾难就有一次。”

paras.en: The town of Wainwright, near the base, has about 7,000 residents.
paras.zh: 基地附近的温赖特镇约有 7,000 名居民。

paras.en: Defense Minister David McGuinty said the Royal Canadian Mounted Police were involved in investigating the incident and described the situation as "very, very active and delicate." He said authorities were still working to determine what happened and expected to provide further information.
paras.zh: 国防部长戴维·麦坚蒂表示，加拿大皇家骑警已参与调查该事件，并称局势“非常、非常活跃且微妙”。他表示，当局仍在努力确定发生了什么，并希望提供进一步的信息。

paras.en: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police said officers were called shortly after 4 p.m. Saturday following reports of a fire in a training area at the base.
paras.zh: 加拿大皇家骑警表示，下午 4 点过后不久，警方接到报警。周六，有报道称基地训练区发生火灾。

paras.en: Firefighters faced a volatile situation. Large areas of the province were hit during the day by a windstorm with gusts up to 100 kilometres an hour. The wind toppled some trees and sent signs flying and garbage cans rolling down streets.
paras.zh: 消防队员面临着不稳定的局势。白天，该省大部分地区遭受阵风高达每小时 100 公里的风暴袭击。风吹倒了一些树木，招牌飞扬，垃圾桶滚落街道。

paras.en: By 11 p.m., the Municipal District of Wainwright said on social media the fire was being held and that property and critical infrastructure were protected. There was no evacuation order for residents.
paras.zh: 晚上 11 点，温赖特市政府在社交媒体上表示，火势已被控制，财产和关键基础设施受到保护。没有居民疏散命令。

paras.en: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe said his province was sending assistance to Alberta but did not specify what resources were being deployed.
paras.zh: 萨斯喀彻温省省长斯科特·莫表示，该省正在向艾伯塔省提供援助，但没有具体说明正在部署哪些资源。

paras.en: "Our thoughts are with all the brave women and men affected," Prime Minister Mark Carney said earlier in a social media post.
paras.zh: “我们的心与所有受影响的勇敢的女性和男性同在，”总理马克·卡尼早些时候在社交媒体帖子中表示。

paras.en: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith described the fire as "significant and tragic" and said it was affecting many military personnel.
paras.zh: 阿尔伯塔省省长丹妮尔·史密斯（Danielle Smith）形容这场火灾“重大而悲惨”，并表示许多军事人员受到影响。

paras.en: CFB Wainwright is one of Canada's busiest military training bases, where soldiers prepare for combat operations. It is home to the Canadian Manoeuvre Training Centre, which conducts realistic battlefield exercises, and the 3rd Canadian Division Training Centre, which provides military training.
paras.zh: CFB 温赖特是加拿大最繁忙的军事训练基地之一，士兵们在这里为作战行动做准备。这里是进行真实战场演习的加拿大机动训练中心和提供军事训练的加拿大第三师训练中心的所在地。

paras.en: Canadian Conservative opposition leader Pierre Poilievre said he had spoken with Carney and the defense minister to offer support to those affected by the fire.
paras.zh: 加拿大保守党反对党领袖皮埃尔·波利耶夫表示，他已与卡尼和国防部长交谈，向受火灾影响的人们提供支持。

paras.en: "Pray for Wainwright, everyone," Poilievre said in a social media post. He urged people in the area to follow emergency instructions and keep roads clear for first responders.
paras.zh: “大家为温赖特祈祷，”波利耶夫在社交媒体帖子中说。他敦促该地区的人们遵守紧急指示，并为急救人员保持道路畅通。

paras.en: The fire also disrupted advance voting ahead of Monday's referendum on whether Alberta should begin a process that could lead to independence from Canada. Elections Alberta said two polling locations, in Lloydminster and Vermilion, closed early Saturday and the ballots were transported securely.
paras.zh: 火灾还扰乱了周一就艾伯塔省是否应该开始从加拿大独立的进程进行公投之前的提前投票。艾伯塔省选举局表示，劳埃德明斯特和弗米利恩的两个投票站周六早些时候关闭，选票已安全运输。

articles.title: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
paras.zh: 教皇利奥表示癌症手术后将逐步恢复职务

paras.en: VATICAN CITY — Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized for an operation to remove a malignant tumor, and said he plans to gradually return to his usual duties.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈城——周日，教皇利奥十四世在他因恶性肿瘤手术住院期间，感谢圣彼得广场数千名信徒的祈祷，并表示他计划逐步恢复正常职责。

paras.en: The crowd erupted in cheers when the pontiff showed himself in the window overlooking the square, where a week ago on the same occasion of the traditional Angelus blessing he revealed that a nodule had been located on his lung, and that it would be surgically removed.
paras.zh: 当教皇出现在俯瞰广场的窗户时，人群爆发出欢呼声。一周前，在传统的三钟经祝福仪式上，他透露自己的肺部发现了一个结节，将通过手术切除。

paras.en: ''Now that this delicate phase is behind me, I will gradually resume my activities, always with God's help and your prayers," Leo said, his voice sounding strong four days after the lower lobe of his right lung was removed.
paras.zh: “现在这个微妙的阶段已经过去，我将在上帝的帮助和你们的祈祷下逐渐恢复我的活动，”利奥说，在右肺下叶被切除四天后，他的声音听起来很有力。

paras.en: The pontiff said the experience of the last week "has made me feel especially close to those facing illness and infirmity." He told the faithful that he had ''truly felt your support,'' and expressed ''particular gratitude to the doctors, nurses and all the staff at Gemelli hospital'' where he was treated.
paras.zh: 教宗表示，上周的经历“让我对那些面临疾病和虚弱的人感到特别亲近”。他告诉信徒，他“真正感受到了你们的支持”，并表达了“特别感谢他接受治疗的格梅利医院的医生、护士和所有工作人员”。

paras.en: The pope paused for a moment and waved to the crowd before retreating into his apartment in the Apostolic Palace.
paras.zh: 教皇停顿了一会儿，向人群挥手致意，然后退回到他在使徒宫的公寓里。

paras.en: A delegation from Africa in Rome for a congress danced and ululated after the pope's blessing.
paras.zh: 来自非洲的代表团在罗马参加一次大会，在教皇的祝福后跳舞并欢呼。

paras.en: ''He was always in our prayers when he was sick, and we are happy to see him today,″ said Alain Kalembu of the Democratic Republic of Congo. ″This is an expression of our joy.″
paras.zh: “当他生病时，我们总是为他祈祷，我们很高兴今天见到他，”刚果民主共和国的阿兰·卡伦布说。 “这是我们喜悦的表达。”

paras.en: The 71-year-old pontiff had the lower lobe of his right lung removed on Tuesday in the first major health event of his 17-month pontificate. The surgery confirmed he had adenocarcinoma, the most common type of lung cancer.
paras.zh: 周二，这位71岁的教皇切除了右肺下叶，这是他就任教皇17个月以来的第一次重大健康事件。手术证实他患有腺癌，这是最常见的肺癌类型。

paras.en: He told a reporter in English that he was doing ''much better'' as he drove away from Rome's Gemelli hospital to return to the Vatican, after a shorter hospital stay than had initially been anticipated.
paras.zh: 他用英语告诉记者，当他开车离开罗马杰梅利医院返回梵蒂冈时，他的情况“好多了”，住院时间比最初预期的要短。

paras.en: "I don't believe it, because he was just operated on the other day," Cosimo Mastrocinque, a retired factory worker visiting the Vatican from the southern region of Puglia, said. "It is a miracle that he recovered already."
paras.zh: “我不相信，因为他前几天刚刚接受手术，”从普利亚南部地区访问梵蒂冈的退休工厂工人科西莫·马斯特罗辛克说。 “他已经康复了，这真是一个奇迹。”

paras.en: American tourists were especially eager to pray alongside the first pope born in the United States. Marla Marsala of Michigan was supposed to attend a Mass with the pope last week that was canceled due to his hospitalization.
paras.zh: 美国游客特别渴望与美国第一位出生的教皇一起祈祷。密歇根州的玛拉·马萨拉原定于上周与教皇一起参加弥撒，但由于教皇住院而被取消。

paras.en: ''I am just happy that we are praying with him today instead of for him, like we were before,'' Marsala said. "It was a tough week for all of the people who love him, which are many. He seems like a very strong soul. So I think he will pull through and fight it, and succeed and keep doing the wonderful work he is doing.''
paras.zh: “我很高兴我们今天与他一起祈祷，而不是像以前那样为他祈祷，”马萨拉说。 “对于所有爱他的人来说，这是艰难的一周。他看起来是一个非常坚强的灵魂。所以我认为他会渡过难关并与之抗争，取得成功并继续做他正在做的出色工作。”

paras.en: Claire Holland from Jacksonville, Florida, said she felt "very blessed" to be present for the pope's return to his flock.
paras.zh: 来自佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔的克莱尔·霍兰德表示，能够出席教皇回到他的信徒身边，她感到“非常幸运”。

paras.en: "I'm so happy that he has recovered so quickly. I think there have been millions and millions of prayers. And he is a strong, determined man, and I am so happy that he is feeling well enough to do this," Holland said.
paras.zh: “我很高兴他康复得这么快。我想已经有数以百万计的人为他祈祷。他是一个坚强、坚定的人，我很高兴他感觉很好，可以做到这一点，”霍兰德说。

paras.en: Leo's next major engagement is an ambitious Nov. 6-17 trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, including a dozen flights and two helicopter rides to high altitudes. His surgeon, Dr. Stefano Margaritora, told Vatican News on Saturday that "there are no clinical reasons why it should not take place."
paras.zh: Leo 的下一个主要活动是 11 月 6 日至 17 日雄心勃勃的乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁之旅，其中包括十几次飞行和两架直升机飞往高海拔地区。他的外科医生斯特凡诺·马加里托拉（Stefano Margaritora）医生周六告诉梵蒂冈新闻，“没有任何临床原因不应该进行这种手术。”

paras.en: "The Holy Father has put his heart and soul into his recovery," Margaritora told Vatican News, adding that he expected the pope to recover fully from surgery "in another 10 days or so."
paras.zh: 马加里托拉告诉梵蒂冈新闻：“教宗全心全意地致力于康复。”他补充说，他预计教皇“再过十天左右”就能从手术中完全康复。

paras.en: Histological testing of the tumor and related lymph nodes was underway. The results, along with details of the tumor's molecular and genetic makeup, will help doctors determine whether the pope needs additional treatment. Options include chemotherapy, a combination of chemotherapy and immunotherapy, or targeted oral therapy based on the tumor's genetic characteristics.
paras.zh: 肿瘤和相关淋巴结的组织学检测正在进行中。结果以及肿瘤分子和基因组成的详细信息将帮助医生确定教皇是否需要额外治疗。选择包括化疗、化疗和免疫治疗相结合，或根据肿瘤的遗传特征进行靶向口服治疗。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它具有市场上最长的 0% 年利率之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高利率。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.en: Wells Fargo is an advertising partner of Motley Fool Money. Joel O'Leary has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has no position in any of the stocks mentioned. The Motley Fool has a disclosure policy.
paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.en: The Motley Fool owns shares of and recommends Visa.
paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口； if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Meloni condemns ‘gangs of thugs’ after protests turned violent across Italy

paras.en: Italy, like France, witnessed a day of protests on Saturday — several turning violent — as some Italian politicians blamed the extreme left for the lawlessness. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni took to social media to condemn the unrest and back law enforcement.
paras.zh: 和法国一样，意大利周六也发生了一天的抗议活动，其中几场抗议活动演变成暴力活动，一些意大利政客将无法无天的行为归咎于极左派。总理乔治亚·梅洛尼在社交媒体上谴责骚乱并支持执法部门。

paras.en: Meloni wrote on X: "Once again, the women and men of the Law Enforcement Forces have had to face the violence of criminals who, even through organized groups, exploit demonstrations to seek confrontation and sow chaos," she posted.
paras.zh: 梅洛尼在 X 上写道：“执法部队的男女成员再次不得不面对犯罪分子的暴力，这些犯罪分子甚至通过有组织的团体，利用示威活动寻求对抗并制造混乱。”

paras.en: She added, "Because they were there to safeguard the safety of citizens, workers, merchants and all the people who have the right to live [in] their city without fear and without seeing it laid to waste and set ablaze by gangs of thugs," she continued. "We stand with you."
paras.zh: 她补充说，“因为他们在那里保护公民、工人、商人和所有有权在自己的城市生活的人的安全，而无需担心，也不会看到城市被暴徒团伙夷为平地和纵火焚烧，”她继续说道。 “我们与你站在一起。”

paras.en: Her Sunday morning post came after scenes of violence between protesters and police, the most visible being outside Milan’s historic Cathedral, known as the Piazza del Duomo.
paras.zh: 她周日早上的帖子是在抗议者和警察之间发生暴力场面之后发布的，其中最明显的发生在米兰历史悠久的大教堂（被称为大教堂广场）外。

paras.en: The Associated Press reported 50 demonstrators, including minors, were detained and at least two police officers were hurt in a protest that required water cannons to disperse the crowd, quoting the LaPresse news agency. Rioters looted stores and smashed windows inside Milan’s Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, one of Italy’s most famous 19th‑century arcades.
paras.zh: 美联社援引拉普雷斯通讯社报道称，在一场需要高压水枪驱散人群的抗议活动中，包括未成年人在内的 50 名示威者被拘留，至少两名警察受伤。米兰维托里奥·埃马努埃莱二世长廊（意大利最著名的 19 世纪拱廊之一）内，暴徒抢劫商店并砸碎窗户。

paras.en: Meloni had already laid blame for the protests on Saturday night, posting: "Thugs who exploit demonstrations to sow chaos, attack those who ensure security and hold entire cities hostage… Demonstrating is a right. Setting our cities ablaze is not."
paras.zh: 梅洛尼已经将周六晚上的抗议活动归咎于他，他发帖称：“暴徒利用示威活动制造混乱，袭击那些确保安全的人，并将整个城市作为人质……示威是一项权利。纵火焚烧我们的城市则不是。”

paras.en: She added a message to her political opponents: "I renew my request to the opposition: do not be ambiguous about this. Unequivocally condemn these acts of violence and issue a clear appeal for every mobilization to be peaceful."
paras.zh: 她还向她的政治对手传达了一条信息：“我再次向反对派提出要求：不要对此含糊其辞。明确谴责这些暴力行为，并明确呼吁每次动员都是和平的。”

paras.en: Il Sole 24 news site quoted Francesco Filini, MP for Meloni's Fratelli d’Italia and national program coordinator, as saying: "It is no longer tolerable that every time left-wing extremists take to the streets, scenes of organized destruction unfold. We are not dealing with mere demonstrators, but with organized groups that plan violence."
paras.zh: 《Il Sole 24》新闻网站援引意大利梅洛尼兄弟会议员兼国家计划协调员弗朗切斯科·菲利尼的话说：“每当左翼极端分子走上街头，就会出现有组织的破坏场面，这已经不再是可以容忍的。我们面对的不仅仅是示威者，还有策划暴力的有组织团体。”

paras.en: Saturday's demonstrations were organized by the Confederazione Generale Italiana del Lavoro, or CGIL, Italy’s oldest labor union with over 5 million members, often connected to Italian political parties on the left.
paras.zh: 周六的示威活动是由意大利劳动总联合会（CGIL）组织的，该工会是意大利历史最悠久的工会，拥有超过 500 万会员，通常与意大利左翼政党有联系。

paras.en: Meloni posted she had "great respect for the thousands" who protested peacefully and calling participation "the foundation of any healthy democracy… we cannot ignore what happened in other Italian squares."
paras.zh: 梅洛尼发帖称，她“非常尊重成千上万”和平抗议的人，并称参与是“任何健康民主的基础……我们不能忽视意大利其他广场发生的事情。”

paras.en: She noted that in Milan "stones were thrown at the Law Enforcement Forces, officers were injured, damage and violence occurred that forced the interruption of the procession. In Turin, people were stopped carrying cobblestones and window-breaking hammers. In Bologna, the disorders led to the precautionary closure of the railway station."
paras.zh: 她指出，在米兰，“有人向执法部队投掷石块，警察受伤，发生破坏和暴力事件，迫使游行中断。在都灵，人们被阻止携带鹅卵石和破窗锤。在博洛尼亚，骚乱导致火车站被预防性关闭。”

paras.en: "In the face of scenes like these, the rejection must be unanimous," Meloni posted. "Any hesitation becomes justification. Silence is not acceptable."
paras.zh: 梅洛尼发帖称：“面对这样的场景，必须一致拒绝。” “任何犹豫都会成为理由。沉默是不可接受的。”

paras.en: Milan’s center-left mayor, Giuseppe Sala, told the Associated Press, "The reasons for the protests were understandable. The violence against law enforcement and serious damage to the city are not justifiable."
paras.zh: 米兰中左翼市长朱塞佩·萨拉对美联社表示，“抗议的原因是可以理解的。针对执法的暴力行为和对城市的严重破坏是不合理的。”

paras.en: Reuters reported some 56 police officers were injured in the protest in Bologna, citing the police union, and the interior ministry says about 100 officers were hurt and around 30 arrests were made in the demonstration in Turin.
paras.zh: 路透社援引警察工会的话说，约有 56 名警察在博洛尼亚的抗议活动中受伤，内政部表示，在都灵的示威活动中约有 100 名警察受伤，约 30 人被捕。

paras.en: Reuters and The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 路透社和美联社对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: LeBron James' wife declines to upgrade best friend's flight, kicking off hot debate

paras.en: An airplane seating arrangement between two friends has travelers debating whether having a bigger budget means picking up the tab for someone else's upgrade — or not.
paras.zh: 两个朋友之间的飞机座位安排让旅行者争论是否拥有更大的预算意味着为别人的升舱买单。

paras.en: Savannah James, entrepreneur and wife of NBA superstar LeBron James, recently discussed how she and her friend April McDaniel handle the difference in their travel budgets when they travel.
paras.zh: 企业家、NBA 巨星勒布朗·詹姆斯的妻子萨凡纳·詹姆斯 (Savannah James) 最近讨论了她和她的朋友阿普丽尔·麦克丹尼尔 (April McDaniel) 在旅行时如何处理旅行预算的差异。

paras.en: Speaking on the "Mental Wealth" podcast, McDaniel said she does not expect to sit in first class simply because Savannah James does.
paras.zh: 麦克丹尼尔在“精神财富”播客上发表讲话时表示，她并不希望仅仅因为萨凡纳·詹姆斯就坐头等舱。

paras.en: "If we're going on the same trip, I don't feel the need to be in first [class] because that's not in my budget," McDaniel said.
paras.zh: “如果我们要进行同一次旅行，我觉得没有必要坐头等舱，因为那不在我的预算之内，”麦克丹尼尔说。

paras.en: Savannah James said her friends understand that traveling with her does not mean she will automatically cover their expenses.
paras.zh: 萨凡纳·詹姆斯说，她的朋友们明白，和她一起旅行并不意味着她会自动承担他们的费用。

paras.en: "My friends are very respectful of my situation," Savannah James said. "There's no expectation of, like, taking care of something or, you know, just having me be responsible for them. It has never, ever been that."
paras.zh: “我的朋友们非常尊重我的处境，”萨凡纳·詹姆斯说。 “没有人期望我去照顾什么东西，或者，你知道，只是让我对它们负责。从来没有这样过。”

paras.en: This approach to traveling together has created debate online — with some people questioning whether the wealthier friend should pay the difference so that the group can sit together.
paras.zh: 这种一起旅行的方式在网上引起了争论——一些人质疑较富有的朋友是否应该支付差价，以便大家可以坐在一起。

paras.en: Diane Gottsman, a national etiquette expert and founder of the Protocol School of Texas, told Fox News Digital there's nothing inherently wrong with friends choosing different cabins as long as everyone is comfortable with the arrangement.
paras.zh: 国家礼仪专家、德克萨斯州礼宾学校创始人黛安·戈茨曼 (Diane Gottsman) 告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，只要每个人都对这种安排感到满意，朋友选择不同的小屋本质上并没有什么问题。

paras.en: "If you have a group of friends, and they are flying coach while you want to fly first class, there's really nothing wrong with it as long as everyone is understanding and agreeable," Gottsman said.
paras.zh: 戈茨曼说：“如果你有一群朋友，他们乘坐经济舱，而你想乘坐头等舱，只要每个人都能理解并同意，这确实没有什么问题。”

paras.en: The situation changes, however, if someone feels excluded or uncomfortable, she said.
paras.zh: 然而，她说，如果有人感到被排斥或感到不舒服，情况就会发生变化。

paras.en: Even when one traveler has considerably more money to spend, Gottsman said that doesn't make that person responsible for paying to upgrade everyone else.
paras.zh: 戈茨曼表示，即使一名旅行者有更多的钱可以花，这并不意味着该人有责任为其他人升级。

paras.en: "It's not an obligation of the person who makes more money to upgrade everyone else," she said. "Just take your seat up front and say you'll see everyone when you land."
paras.zh: “赚更多钱的人没有义务升级其他人，”她说。 “只要坐在前面的座位上，然后说落地后就能见到所有人。”

paras.en: The arrangement shared by Savannah James and her friend April McDaniel drew sharply different reactions from travelers online.
paras.zh: 萨凡纳·詹姆斯 (Savannah James) 和她的朋友阿普丽尔·麦克丹尼尔 (April McDaniel) 分享的安排引起了网上旅行者截然不同的反应。

paras.en: One commenter said that while friends should not feel entitled to someone else's money, having significant wealth would make them want to share more of those experiences with people close to them.
paras.zh: 一位评论者表示，虽然朋友不应该觉得自己有权获得别人的钱，但拥有大量财富会让他们愿意与亲近的人分享更多这些经历。

paras.en: "No one is entitled to anything," the Reddit user wrote.
paras.zh: “没有人有权获得任何东西，”这位 Reddit 用户写道。

paras.en: The person added, "If we're childhood besties, and I have an abundance of wealth, I'm treating my friend to nice experiences!"
paras.zh: 该人士补充道，“如果我们是儿时好友，而且我拥有丰富的财富，我就会为我的朋友带来美好的经历！”

paras.en: Others saw nothing wrong with friends paying for the level of travel they can each comfortably afford.
paras.zh: 另一些人则认为，朋友们为自己能够轻松负担得起的旅行费用付费并没有什么错。

paras.en: "I feel empowered to get what I can afford and not have my friends pay for me just because they have the money," another person wrote. "I'm not her kid."
paras.zh: 另一位网友写道：“我觉得自己有能力得到自己能买得起的东西，而不是因为朋友有钱而让他们为我付钱。” “我不是她的孩子。”

paras.en: "It's really not that big of a deal," another user wrote. "It's a plane ride."
paras.zh: 另一位用户写道：“这确实没什么大不了的。” “这是坐飞机。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to Savannah James for comment but did not immediately hear back.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字联系萨凡纳·詹姆斯置评，但没有立即回复。

articles.title: NFL line judge takes knee and appears to pray after umpire collapses during Jaguars-Texans London game

paras.en: The news surrounding NFL officials has lately not been kind in that there has been fiery criticism and even a couple of suspensions, but on Sunday we saw these people also deserve respect and compassion.
paras.zh: 最近有关 NFL 官员的消息并不好，受到了激烈的批评，甚至有几次停赛，但周日我们看到这些人也值得尊重和同情。

paras.en: During the first quarter of the Jacksonville Jaguars versus Houston Texans game in London, umpire Larry Smith was going about his duties, changing the ball out after a play, when he slipped on the slick Wembley Stadium turf and fell.
paras.zh: 在伦敦杰克逊维尔美洲虎队对阵休斯敦德州人队的比赛的第一节中，裁判拉里·史密斯正在履行职责，在比赛结束后改变球权，突然在光滑的温布利体育场草坪上滑倒并摔倒。

paras.en: Smith got back up under his own power and then collapsed.
paras.zh: 史密斯依靠自己的力量站了起来，然后倒下了。

paras.en: And as trainers came out to attend to Smith, we saw a reminder that these people so often challenged by coaches and players, and criticized and condemned by fans on social media and other forums, are indeed human.
paras.zh: 当教练们出来照顾史密斯时，我们看到了一个提醒，这些经常受到教练和球员挑战、在社交媒体和其他论坛上受到球迷批评和谴责的人确实是人。

paras.en: While Smith lay on the turf getting attention, line judge Carl Johnson came over, took a knee, removed his cap, and began to pray for his fallen friend and colleague.
paras.zh: 当史密斯躺在草坪上引起人们的注意时，司线裁判卡尔·约翰逊走过来，跪下，摘下帽子，开始为他倒下的朋友和同事祈祷。

paras.en: You see this done by players for one another all the time.
paras.zh: 你经常会看到球员们为彼此所做的事情。

paras.en: We saw it this year when Jaxson Dart went down for the Giants and again when Jayden Daniels was injured when the Commanders played the Cowboys. Packers players also kneeled to pray for fallen teammate Jayden Reed when he injured his neck earlier this season.
paras.zh: 今年我们在巨人队的贾克森·达特（Jaxson Dart）受伤时看到了这一点，在指挥官队对阵牛仔队时杰登·丹尼尔斯（Jayden Daniels）受伤时我们再次看到了这一点。包装工队的球员们也下跪为本赛季早些时候颈部受伤的倒下队友杰登·里德祈祷。

paras.en: It was moving to see it done by one official for another.
paras.zh: 看到一名官员为另一名官员完成这件事令人感动。

paras.en: Smith required a cart to leave the field. The report from the NFL Network said Smith suffered a lower-leg injury.
paras.zh: 史密斯需要一辆推车离开球场。 NFL Network 的报道称，史密斯小腿受伤。

paras.en: The officiating crew shifted its formation to work the game with six people instead of the regulation seven.
paras.zh: 裁判组改变了阵型，由六人组成而不是常规的七人组成。

paras.en: And we have a noteworthy moment that adds context to the other news officials have made this season, including a couple of suspensions on October 5 following Jeff Seeman's cursing at Arizona tight end Trey McBride and Adrian Hill's confrontational behavior in a Minnesota Vikings game.
paras.zh: 我们有一个值得注意的时刻，为本赛季官员发布的其他新闻增添了背景，包括 10 月 5 日杰夫·西曼 (Jeff Seeman) 咒骂亚利桑那州近端锋特雷·麦克布莱德 (Trey McBride) 以及阿德里安·希尔 (Adrian Hill) 在明尼苏达维京人队比赛中的对抗行为后的几次停赛。

paras.en: The zebras, this touching moment reminds us, are human.
paras.zh: 这个感人的时刻提醒我们，斑马也是人类。

articles.title: French government in crisis talks after ‘colossal failure of the state’
articles.author: Angelique Chrisafis in Paris

paras.en: The French government was in crisis talks on Sunday after one of the most violent days of unrest in years left public buildings burned, hundreds of shops destroyed and looted, and more than 2000 people arrested in cities across the country.
paras.zh: 法国政府周日正在进行危机谈判，此前法国各城市发生了多年来最暴力的骚乱之一，公共建筑被烧毁，数百家商店被毁和抢劫，2000多人被捕。
