paras.en: Politicians on the left and right called for the resignation of the interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, after the government appeared to have been caught by surprise by the scale of violence as state buildings were stormed and torched, bus stops smashed, roads barricaded and shops broken into and destroyed.
paras.zh: 政府大楼遭到袭击和纵火，公共汽车站被砸坏，道路被设置路障，商店被闯入和毁坏，暴力事件的规模似乎让政府感到惊讶，左翼和右翼政客都呼吁内政部长洛朗·努涅斯辞职。

paras.en: The president, Emmanuel Macron, who is standing down next spring, was preparing to address the nation on Sunday night. He wrote on social media there was “no place for violence” in France.
paras.zh: 明年春天即将卸任的总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙正准备在周日晚上向全国发表讲话。他在社交媒体上写道，法国“没有暴力的容身之地”。

paras.en: Police and officials faced challenges of different types on Saturday. First, tens of thousands of peaceful protesters attended calm marches through major cities including Paris, supporting schoolchildren’s demands for more teachers and repairs to decrepit schools. Those marches, which came after four weeks of street marches and barricades of schools, were attended by parents, teachers and grandparents as well as students and workers protesting over the high cost of living. The demonstrators carried banners saying the government was not listening to them and calling for more money for public services.
paras.zh: 周六，警察和官员面临着不同类型的挑战。首先，数万名和平抗议者参加了巴黎等主要城市的平静游行，支持学童增加教师和修复破旧学校的要求。在经过四个星期的街头游行和学校设置路障之后，参加这些游行的有家长、教师和祖父母，以及抗议高生活成本的学生和工人。示威者举着标语，称政府没有听取他们的意见，并呼吁为公共服务提供更多资金。

paras.en: But separately to those peaceful demonstrations, different groups caught police and officials by surprise with moving gatherings, sporadic burning, the barricading of streets and clashing with police in cities including Paris, Bordeaux, Nice and Marseille.
paras.zh: 但除了这些和平示威之外，巴黎、波尔多、尼斯和马赛等城市的不同团体还通过移动集会、零星焚烧、封锁街道以及与警察发生冲突等方式让警方和官员感到意外。

paras.en: Finally, masked looters took advantage of what French media called the “chaos” on the streets to smash shopfronts and grab goods. In Paris, groups of looters, some of whom appeared to be children, were seen running through the night with clothes and shoeboxes after masked adult men smashed shopfronts.
paras.zh: 最后，蒙面抢劫者利用法国媒体所说的街头“混乱”，砸毁店面并抢夺货物。在巴黎，蒙面成年男子砸毁店面后，有人看到成群的抢劫者（其中一些似乎是儿童）带着衣服和鞋盒彻夜奔跑。

paras.en: In Paris, where police said a record 855 people had been arrested, the burnt-out remains of barricades built using bikes, bins and other materials littered streets on Sunday. Several streets had smashed shop windows and the remains of torched cars. The capital had experienced “a level of violence that we have never seen before, I believe”, said the Socialist deputy mayor, Lamia El Aaraje.
paras.zh: 在巴黎，警方称逮捕了创纪录的 855 人，周日，用自行车、垃圾箱和其他材料搭建的路障残骸散落在街道上。几条街道上的商店橱窗被砸碎，汽车残骸被烧毁。社会党副市长拉米亚·埃尔·阿拉杰 (Lamia El Aaraje) 表示，首都经历了“我相信我们以前从未见过的暴力程度”。

paras.en: In Limoges in central France, where the 19th-century town hall was burned down, the mayor, Guillaume Guérin, said the people who stormed his building “were not demonstrators that defend causes” but “people organised for war”. He said those who stormed and torched the town hall had told a building caretaker he would be killed, and told elected officials they would “burn”. He said there had been a failure of the state to deal with the crisis.
paras.zh: 在法国中部的利摩日，19世纪的市政厅被烧毁，市长纪尧姆·盖兰(Guillaume Guérin)表示，冲进他的建筑的人“不是捍卫事业的示威者”，而是“为战争而组织的人”。他说，那些冲进并纵火焚烧市政厅的人告诉大楼管​​理员他会被杀，并告诉民选官员他们会“烧毁”。他表示，国家未能应对这场危机。

paras.en: “Around 3:30pm our municipal police, although present in number, found themselves no longer able to fight against the violence of rioters because they had run out of munition,” Guérin said. He called this “a colossal failure of the state”.
paras.zh: 盖兰说：“下午 3 点 30 分左右，我们的市警察虽然人数众多，但发现自己无法再对抗骚乱者的暴力行为，因为他们的弹药已经耗尽。”他称这是“国家的巨大失败”。

paras.en: In Marseille, where masked groups stormed the city hall and a police station, the Socialist mayor, Benoît Payan, told BFMTV: “I have no words … I never thought I’d ever live through something like this. Hordes of rioters and looters attacked our common [state] buildings … with no real demands, but with the sole aim to wreck the demands of those who had demonstrated legitimately.”
paras.zh: 在马赛，蒙面团体冲进市政厅和警察局，社会党市长伯努瓦·帕扬 (Benoît Payan) 告诉 BFMTV：“我无话可说……我从来没想过自己会经历这样的事情。成群的暴徒和抢劫者袭击了我们共同的[国家]建筑……没有真正的要求，但唯一的目的是破坏那些合法示威者的要求。”

paras.en: Payan said questions must be asked about policing tactics, as other town hall buildings, for example in Lille, were also targeted.
paras.zh: 帕扬表示，必须就警务策略提出问题，因为里尔等其他市政厅建筑也成为目标。

paras.en: Grégory Doucet, the Green mayor of Lyon, said he had never seen such violence in his city, including the torching of the historic tourist office. He told Le Monde: “I’m stunned by the violence against public and state property. I saw and heard fear and anger. Shop-owners felt abandoned.”
paras.zh: 里昂格林市市长格雷戈里·杜塞表示，他从未在自己的城市见过如此暴力的事件，包括历史悠久的旅游局被纵火焚烧的事件。他告诉《世界报》：“我对针对公共和国家财产的暴力行为感到震惊。我看到并听到了恐惧和愤怒。店主感到被抛弃了。”

paras.en: Doucet said the government must find a “sense of nuance” in properly examining what happened and “avoiding stereotypes”. He said the government needed to give a political response to long-running societal demands from peaceful demonstrators on one hand, and also examine roots of violence.
paras.zh: 杜塞特表示，政府必须找到“细微差别”，正确审查所发生的事情并“避免刻板印象”。他表示，政府一方面需要对和平示威者长期存在的社会诉求做出政治回应，另一方面也要审视暴力的根源。

paras.en: Traders’ unions said over 1,500 shops and businesses had been ransacked with a cost running into tens of millions of euros. “This had nothing to do with the peaceful protesters,” said one shoe-shop owner in Paris. “These were organised groups who were breaking things and looting. We’d never seen anything like it.”
paras.zh: 工会表示，超过 1,500 家商店和企业遭到洗劫，损失高达数千万欧元。 “这与和平抗议者无关，”巴黎一位鞋店老板说。 “这些是有组织的团体，他们破坏东西并抢劫。我们从未见过这样的事情。”

paras.en: Opposition politicians questioned the government’s policing tactics, saying there had been a lack of state intelligence.
paras.zh: 反对派政客质疑政府的治安策略，称政府缺乏情报。

paras.en: The interior ministry said there had been more than 2,000 arrests and about 600 police, firefighters and paramedics had been hurt. A 17-year-old boy had his right hand blown off by a crowd-control grenade in the southern city of Saint-Étienne.
paras.zh: 内政部表示，已有 2000 多人被捕，约 600 名警察、消防员和护理人员受伤。在南部城市圣艾蒂安，一名 17 岁男孩的右手被人群控制手榴弹炸掉。

paras.en: Macron’s centrist government and the far-right frontrunner for the presidential election, Marine Le Pen, both blamed what they called “ultra-left” groups for the violence. The prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, said the government would not be “intimidated” by violence, and blamed the unrest on the “ultra-left” and criminals.
paras.zh: 马克龙的中间派政府和总统选举的极右领跑者马琳·勒庞都指责他们所谓的“极左”团体制造了暴力事件。总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努表示，政府不会被暴力“吓倒”，并将骚乱归咎于“极左派”和犯罪分子。

paras.en: The radical-left presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon, who attended the peaceful street demonstration in Paris on Saturday, accused the government of organisational failings that had “opened the door to chaos”.
paras.zh: 周六，激进左翼总统候选人让-吕克·梅朗雄参加了巴黎的和平街头示威活动，他指责政府的组织失误“打开了混乱之门”。

paras.en: Lecornu replied on social media: “Laying the responsibility for violence on heads of police is a dangerous and cynical reversal of responsibilities.”
paras.zh: 莱科尔努在社交媒体上回应道：“将暴力责任归咎于警察负责人是一种危险且愤世嫉俗的责任倒置。”

articles.title: Multiple people killed as Canadian authorities tackle active blaze at Alberta military base
articles.author: Leyland Cecco in Toronto, Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: Multiple people have been killed and others injured after a deadly blaze tore through one of Canada’s busiest military training bases in Alberta, Canada’s defence minister said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 加拿大国防部长周六表示，加拿大阿尔伯塔省最繁忙的军事训练基地之一发生致命火灾，造成多人死亡、多人受伤。

paras.en: “I’m saddened to share that there have been both fatalities and injuries as a result of an incident on the base,” said David McGuinty. The defence minister described the situation at CFB Wainwright as “active and delicate” with the fire being monitored very closely, telling reporters that high winds had worsened the fire.
paras.zh: 大卫·麦坚蒂说：“我很遗憾地告诉大家，基地发生的事件造成了人员伤亡。”国防部长称 CFB Wainwright 的情况“活跃且脆弱”，火势受到密切监控，并告诉记者，大风加剧了火势。

paras.en: “I cannot recall an incident like this in recent memory,” he said, adding that the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) were involved in the investigation.
paras.zh: 他说：“我最近不记得发生过这样的事件。”他补充说，加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）参与了调查。

paras.en: McGuinty did not provide casualty figures or details about what caused the incident and the Canadian armed forces said on Sunday that its “immediate priority” was notifying next of kin and helping those affected by the fire. The armed forces and federal, provincial and local authorities were coordinating the emergency response, they said.
paras.zh: 麦坚蒂没有提供伤亡数字或事故原因的详细信息，加拿大武装部队周日表示，其“当务之急”是通知近亲并帮助受火灾影响的人。他们说，武装部队以及联邦、省和地方当局正在协调应急响应。

paras.en: Canada’s top soldier, Gen Jennie Carignan, who serves as chief of the defence staff, called the incident “a profoundly difficult moment for the entire Canadian armed forces”.
paras.zh: 加拿大最高军人、国防参谋长珍妮·卡里尼昂将军称这一事件“对整个加拿大武装部队来说是一个极其困难的时刻”。

paras.en: The nearby community of Wainwright was providing hospital and firefighting support. Flares were spotted in the sky and military medical paratroopers dropped in on a local school football field.
paras.zh: 附近的温赖特社区正在提供医院和消防支持。天空中出现了照明弹，军事医疗伞兵空投到了当地学校的足球场上。

paras.en: A doctor at a hospital in the city of Edmonton, 180km (112 miles) north-west of Wainwright, told Canada’s national broadcaster that patients were being brought to hospitals across the city as Wainwright’s healthcare facilities became “completely overwhelmed” by the number of people needing care.
paras.zh: 温赖特西北 180 公里（112 英里）处埃德蒙顿市一家医院的一名医生告诉加拿大国家广播公司，由于温赖特的医疗设施因需要护理的人数而“完全不堪重负”，患者被送往全市各地的医院。

paras.en: “This number of patients would overwhelm the city of Edmonton,” Dr Warren Thirsk, an emergency department physician at the Royal Alexandra hospital, told CBC News. “It is more patients than any of us want to count right now. It’s a disaster. It’s a one in every 15 to 25-year disaster.”
paras.zh: 皇家亚历山德拉医院急诊科医生沃伦·瑟斯克博士告诉加拿大广播公司新闻，“这么多的病人将使埃德蒙顿市不堪重负。” “现在的病人数量比我们任何人想要统计的都要多。这是一场灾难。每 15 到 25 年的灾难中就有一次。”

paras.en: Officials asked people in Edmonton to avoid the emergency department at the University of Alberta hospital in order to prioritise victims from the military base. Air ambulances were dispatched from Saskatoon and Edmonton.
paras.zh: 官员们要求埃德蒙顿的人们避开阿尔伯塔大学医院的急诊室，以便优先处理来自军事基地的受害者。空中救护车从萨斯卡通和埃德蒙顿派出。

paras.en: In an earlier social media post, the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney, said: “A serious incident creating a major fire has occurred at CFB Wainwright, in Alberta. Our thoughts are with all the brave women and men affected.”
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼在早些时候的社交媒体帖子中表示：“阿尔伯塔省温赖特 CFB 发生了一起严重事件，引发了大火。我们的心与所有受影响的勇敢的男女同在。”

paras.en: The Municipal District of Wainwright said the fire crossed the base’s fence earlier on Saturday and was spreading rapidly owing to high winds. Firefighters from multiple jurisdictions were responding and no evacuation order was in effect.
paras.zh: 温赖特市政区表示，周六早些时候，大火越过了基地的围栏，并由于大风而迅速蔓延。来自多个司法管辖区的消防员正在做出反应，但疏散令尚未生效。

paras.en: Large areas of the province were hit during the day by a windstorm with gusts of up to 100kmh. The wind toppled some trees and sent signs flying and refuse cans rolling down streets.
paras.zh: 白天，该省大部分地区遭受阵风高达 100 公里/小时的风暴袭击。风吹倒了一些树木，招牌飞扬，垃圾箱滚落街道。

paras.en: The Alberta premier, Danielle Smith, described the fire as “significant and tragic” and said it was affecting many military personnel.
paras.zh: 艾伯塔省省长丹妮尔·史密斯 (Danielle Smith) 形容此次火灾“重大而悲惨”，并表示许多军事人员受到影响。

paras.en: The Saskatchewan premier, Scott Moe, said his province was sending assistance to Alberta but did not specify what resources were being deployed.
paras.zh: 萨斯喀彻温省省长斯科特·莫表示，该省正在向艾伯塔省提供援助，但没有具体说明正在部署哪些资源。

paras.en: CFB Wainwright is one of Canada’s busiest military training bases, where soldiers prepare for combat operations. It is home to the Canadian Manoeuvre Training Centre, which conducts realistic battlefield exercises, and the 3rd Canadian Division Training Centre, which provides military training.
paras.zh: CFB 温赖特是加拿大最繁忙的军事训练基地之一，士兵们在这里为作战行动做准备。这里是进行真实战场演习的加拿大机动训练中心和提供军事训练的加拿大第三师训练中心的所在地。

paras.en: The RCMP, speaking on behalf of the military, told reporters a fire was reported at the base in the late afternoon on Saturday and that the blaze had extended beyond the boundaries of the training area.
paras.zh: 加拿大皇家骑警代表军方告诉记者，周六下午晚些时候，基地发生火灾，火势已经蔓延到训练区的边界之外。

paras.en: “On behalf of the Nato military committee, we extend our deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in the tragedy at CFB Wainwright, and our wishes for a full recovery to all the injured,” Adm Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, the chair of the Nato military committee, posted on social media. “Those who fell there served our common security, and the military committee will honour their memory.”
paras.zh: 北约军事委员会主席朱塞佩·卡沃·德拉戈涅上将在社交媒体上发帖称：“我们代表北约军事委员会，向温赖特CFB悲剧中遇难者的家人和亲人致以最深切的哀悼，并祝愿所有伤者完全康复。” “那些倒下的人为我们的共同安全服务，军事委员会将缅怀他们。”

paras.en: Canada’s Conservative leader, Pierre Poilievre, said he had spoken with Carney and the defence minister to offer support to those affected by the fire.
paras.zh: 加拿大保守党领袖皮埃尔·波利耶夫表示，他已与卡尼和国防部长交谈，向受火灾影响的人们提供支持。

paras.en: “Pray for Wainwright, everyone,” Poilievre said in a social media post. He urged people in the area to follow emergency instructions and keep roads clear for first responders.
paras.zh: “大家为温赖特祈祷，”波利耶夫在社交媒体帖子中说道。他敦促该地区的人们遵守紧急指示，并为急救人员保持道路畅通。

articles.title: US ambassador to Israel denounces West Bank settler attack on US photojournalist
articles.author: Sam Jones and agencies

paras.en: The US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, has denounced the settler attack that left the Washington Post photojournalist Heidi Levine badly beaten and needing surgery as a “despicable act of terror” and called for the arrest and prosecution of those responsible.
paras.zh: 美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比 (Mike Huckabee) 谴责定居者袭击导致《华盛顿邮报》摄影记者海蒂·莱文 (Heidi Levine) 惨遭殴打并需要接受手术的事件，称其为“卑鄙的恐怖行为”，并呼吁逮捕并起诉肇事者。

paras.en: Levine, an award-winning journalist who lives in Israel, was set upon last Friday by masked Israeli settlers who used clubs and other weapons to attack Palestinian people attempting to harvest their olives in occupied West Bank towns.
paras.zh: 莱文是一位居住在以色列的获奖记者，上周五，蒙面以色列定居者袭击了他们，他们使用棍棒和其他武器袭击试图在被占领的约旦河西岸城镇收获橄榄的巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: The 63-year-old photographer, who is in a hospital in Petah Tikva near Tel Aviv recovering from hand surgery, broken ribs and other injuries she sustained in the attack, said she was beaten for more than 10 minutes by the settlers, who also stole her camera, passport and phone.
paras.zh: 这位 63 岁的摄影师目前正在特拉维夫附近佩塔提克瓦的一家医院接受手部手术、肋骨骨折和其他在袭击中受伤的恢复。她说，她被定居者殴打了 10 多分钟，定居者还偷走了她的相机、护照和手机。

paras.en: “I was attacked, pushed to the ground,” Levine said. “Luckily, I had my flak jacket and helmet, otherwise I probably wouldn’t even be here, because they just kept kicking and kicking me.” She added the attack ended when her Palestinian colleagues intervened to save her.
paras.zh: “我遭到攻击，被推倒在地，”莱文说。 “幸运的是，我有防弹衣和头盔，否则我可能不会在这里，因为他们一直踢我。”她补充说，当她的巴勒斯坦同事介入拯救她时，袭击才结束。

paras.en: Huckabee, a rightwing ally of President Donald Trump with a track record of hardline, pro-Israel rhetoric, was notably blunt in his condemnation of what he called the “vicious and cowardly attack” on Levine. In a post on X on Saturday, he noted that she was a US citizen who had been clearly identifiable as a journalist.
paras.zh: 哈卡比是唐纳德·特朗普总统的右翼盟友，一直发表强硬、亲以色列的言论，他在谴责他所说的对莱文的“恶毒而懦弱的攻击”时尤其直言不讳。在周六 X 上的一篇帖子中，他指出她是一名美国公民，可以清楚地看出她是一名记者。

paras.en: “We have called for a full investigation, arrest, and prosecution to the fullest extent of the law to whoever participated in this,” Huckabee added. “Attacking a female photographer is despicable act of terror carried out by masked cowards. Dishonorable act of senseless violence.”
paras.zh: 哈卡比补充说：“我们呼吁对参与此事的任何人进行全面调查、逮捕和依法起诉。” “袭击女摄影师是蒙面懦夫实施的卑鄙恐怖行为。毫无意义的暴力行为是不光彩的。”

paras.en: Israel’s prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, has been ambiguous in addressing Levine’s assault, condemning “violence against anyone” but referring to the attack as “alleged” and saying its circumstances remain unclear.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在谈到莱文的袭击事件时态度模棱两可，谴责“针对任何人的暴力行为”，但称此次袭击是“据称的”，并表示袭击情况尚不清楚。

paras.en: The attack on the Palestinian farmers and Levine was followed on Saturday by another outbreak of settler violence directed against European diplomats, a French mayor and the archbishop of the French city of Cambrai, who were visiting the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 继对巴勒斯坦农民和莱文的袭击之后，周六又爆发了针对欧洲外交官、法国市长和法国康布雷市大主教的定居者暴力事件，他们当时正在访问被占领的约旦河西岸。

paras.en: Bernard Baudoux, the mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries, was wearing his red, white and blue sash of office and attempting to enter a vehicle with diplomatic plates when he was assaulted and knocked to the ground. A masked militant shouted “Vive la France!” as he launched the attack, a witness said. Badoux’s wife, and Vincent Dollmann, the archbishop of Cambrai, were also threatened by the group of seven men, some armed with clubs.
paras.zh: 奥尔诺耶-艾梅里市市长伯纳德·博杜(Bernard Baudoux)当时戴着红、白、蓝三色的办公室腰带，试图进入一辆挂有外交牌照的车辆，但遭到袭击并被撞倒在地。一名蒙面武装分子高喊“法国万岁！”一名目击者称，当他发动袭击时。巴杜的妻子和康布雷大主教文森特·多尔曼也受到这七人的威胁，其中一些人手持棍棒。

paras.en: The group had joined the olive harvest on lands belonging to the Christian town of Taybeh, along with the French consul general in Jerusalem, his wife and other diplomats, and the Belgian and Polish consuls.
paras.zh: 该团体与法国驻耶路撒冷总领事、他的妻子和其他外交官，以及比利时和波兰领事一起参加了在基督教小镇泰贝的土地上收获橄榄的活动。

paras.en: “I think that if settlers are behaving like this, there is a tolerance on the part of the Israeli government,” Baudoux told Agence France-Presse after he was attacked.
paras.zh: “我认为，如果定居者有这样的行为，以色列政府是可以容忍的，”博杜在遭到袭击后告诉法新社。

paras.en: “The whole world needs to know what’s happening. For me, I’ll go back to my country and everything will be fine. Those who continue to suffer the most are those who are here.”
paras.zh: “全世界都需要知道正在发生什么。对我来说，我会回到我的国家，一切都会好起来的。那些继续受苦最深的人就是那些在这里的人。”

paras.en: Violence is surging ahead of bitterly fought elections to be held on 27 October, with Palestinians’ annual olive harvest being repeatedly disrupted by Israeli settlers as Netanyahu seeks to shore up his pro-settlement rightwing base.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 27 日举行的激烈选举之前，暴力事件正在激增，内塔尼亚胡试图巩固其支持解决问题的右翼基础，以色列定居者一再扰乱巴勒斯坦人一年一度的橄榄收获活动。

paras.en: France’s foreign minister, Jean-Noël Barrot, has called on Israel to “urgently halt criminal violence” and to arrest those responsible for attacking Baudoux. The EU has condemned the attack and urged “full accountability as well as effective measures to prevent continued acts of violence and violent harassment against Palestinians, including during the ongoing olive harvest season, as well as against journalists”.
paras.zh: 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗呼吁以色列“紧急停止暴力犯罪”，并逮捕袭击博杜的责任人。欧盟谴责了这次袭击，并敦促“全面问责并采取有效措施，防止针对巴勒斯坦人的持续暴力和暴力骚扰行为，包括在正在进行的橄榄收获季节以及针对记者的暴力和骚扰行为”。

paras.en: The European Commission executive vice-president, Teresa Ribera, went further, posting an interview with Levine in hospital and adding the caption: “They want no witnesses.”
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会执行副主席特蕾莎·里贝拉走得更远，她发布了对莱文在医院的采访，并添加了标题：“他们不需要证人。”

paras.en: Israel’s foreign ministry has condemned the attack on the diplomats and Israeli police promised to open an investigation.
paras.zh: 以色列外交部谴责了针对外交官的袭击事件，以色列警方承诺展开调查。

paras.en: President Isaac Herzog, who holds a mostly ceremonial role, called Levine in hospital on Saturday, saying the attack was “outrageous and shocking” and was weighing on his conscience.
paras.zh: 总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格（Isaac Herzog）主要担任礼仪性职务，周六打电话给医院的莱文，称这次袭击“令人愤慨且令人震惊”，让他的良心受到沉重打击。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s main rival in the elections, the former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, criticised the prime minister over the violence, saying it was “burning away the little legitimacy the state of Israel still possesses”. He described the attacks as “Jewish terrorism, under the auspices of the Israeli government”.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在选举中的主要竞争对手、前军事首长加迪·艾森科特就暴力事件批评了总理，称这“烧毁了以色列国仍然拥有的一点合法性”。他将这些袭击描述为“以色列政府支持下的犹太恐怖主义”。

paras.en: Trump officially endorsed Netanyahu for re-election in a post on his Truth Social network on Sunday, hailing him as “a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran”. He added: “Bibi Netanyahu has been Strong, Brave, and Brilliant in the face of tremendous opposition, including that coming from even Israel, itself.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周日在其“真相社交”网络上发帖，正式支持内塔尼亚胡连任，称赞他是“一位伟大的战士总理，也是对抗伊朗伊斯兰共和国的更伟大的和平伙伴”。他补充道：“面对巨大的反对，甚至包括来自以色列本身的反对，比比·内塔尼亚胡表现得坚强、勇敢和才华横溢。”

paras.en: The Washington Post has reiterated its call for a full and transparent investigation into the attack on Levine, even though Israel rarely investigates settler violence fully.
paras.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》再次呼吁对莱文袭击事件进行全面、透明的调查，尽管以色列很少全面调查定居者的暴力行为。

paras.en: Yesh Din, an Israeli rights group, says around 94% of investigations into settler violence since 2005 have ended without an indictment, with just 3% leading to full or partial convictions.
paras.zh: 以色列人权组织 Yesh Din 表示，自 2005 年以来，大约 94% 对定居者暴力的调查都以没有起诉的方式结束，只有 3% 最终被全部或部分定罪。

paras.en: The Associated Press and Agence France-Presse contributed to this report
paras.zh: 美联社和法新社对此报道作出了贡献

articles.title: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting

paras.en: France awoke to scenes of widespread damage on Sunday after a day of riots and demonstrations, with shopfronts shattered, burnt out cars, charred bikes, and piles of glass and debris on the pavements of Paris.
paras.zh: 经过一天的骚乱和示威活动后，法国周日醒来时看到了大面积破坏的景象，巴黎的人行道上店面被毁，汽车被烧毁，自行车被烧焦，玻璃和碎片成堆。

paras.en: Police arrested about 1,800 people on Saturday as some 550,000 demonstrators took to the streets for protests that were largely peaceful.
paras.zh: 周六，大约 55 万示威者走上街头进行基本上和平的抗议活动，警方逮捕了约 1,800 人。

paras.en: They were demonstrating against rising fuel prices, the cost of living and deteriorating public services, including schools.
paras.zh: 他们举行示威活动，反对燃油价格上涨、生活成本上涨和公共服务（包括学校）恶化。

paras.en: Groups of rioters, some dressed in black and wearing masks and balaclavas, also came out in Paris, Marseille and other towns and cities, with some setting fire to cars and buildings.
paras.zh: 巴黎、马赛和其他城镇也出现了成群的骚乱者，其中一些人身穿黑衣、戴着面具和头套，其中一些人放火焚烧汽车和建筑物。

paras.en: Widespread looting took place across the cities of Paris, Marseille and Lille, as well as other areas.
paras.zh: 巴黎、马赛和里尔等城市以及其他地区发生了大范围的抢劫。

paras.en: President Emmanuel Macron was due to address the nation at 20:00 local time on Sunday after what has been described as one of the worst outbreaks of disorder in modern French history.
paras.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 定于当地时间周日 20:00 向全国发表讲话，此前这场被称为法国现代历史上最严重的骚乱爆发之一。

paras.en: In Paris, protesters clashed with riot police, who turned tear gas and water cannon on the crowds. During the day, some groups lit fires in the street and torched vehicles. At least one restaurant was gutted by fire, and the BBC saw fighting breaking out among some of the groups.
paras.zh: 在巴黎，抗议者与防暴警察发生冲突，防暴警察向人群发射催泪瓦斯和水枪。白天，一些团体在街上纵火并焚烧车辆。至少一家餐厅被大火烧毁，英国广播公司 (BBC) 看到一些群体之间爆发了战斗。

paras.en: Riot police were seen charging at one crowd in central Paris and hitting several people with batons.
paras.zh: 有人看到防暴警察在巴黎市中心向人群冲锋，并用警棍殴打数人。

paras.en: "It's like we had a war," Paris resident Mehmet Ozeden told news agency AFP.
paras.zh: 巴黎居民穆罕默德·奥泽登告诉法新社：“这就像我们经历了一场战争。”

paras.en: Another resident, Anita GrasIt, said it was "terrifying" to see groups of young people "smashing everything, with total impunity".
paras.zh: 另一位居民安妮塔·格拉斯伊特 (Anita GrasIt) 表示，看到成群结队的年轻人“砸碎一切，却完全不受惩罚”，真是“可怕”。

paras.en: The looters were "proudly carrying supermarket baskets filled with goods and laughing about their thefts", Maryse, a woman living nearby who gave only her first name, told the BBC.
paras.zh: 住在附近的一位只透露名字的妇女玛丽斯告诉英国广播公司，抢劫者“自豪地拎着装满货物的超市篮子，并嘲笑他们的盗窃行为”。

paras.en: Further south in Marseille, protesters broke into the city hall by using a metal fence as a battering ram. In Lille, a McDonalds was set on fire, police said, and an Apple store in the city was broken into and looted.
paras.zh: 再往南的马赛，抗议者使用金属栅栏作为攻城槌闯入市政厅。警方称，里尔的一家麦当劳店被纵火，该市的一家苹果店被闯入和抢劫。

paras.en: More than 500 police officers, gendarmes and firefighters were injured in the unrest on Saturday, France's interior ministry said.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，周六的骚乱中有 500 多名警察、宪兵和消防员受伤。

paras.en: About 1,500 shops and retailers were also damaged in the disturbances, the Retail and Trade Federation said.
paras.zh: 零售贸易联合会表示，大约 1,500 家商店和零售商在骚乱中也遭到破坏。

paras.en: On Sunday morning in Paris, residents surveyed the aftermath, which included the smashed glass frontages of designer stores including Ralph Lauren, Gucci and Versace.
paras.zh: 周日上午，巴黎居民调查了灾后情况，包括拉尔夫·劳伦 (Ralph Lauren)、古驰 (Gucci) 和范思哲 (Versace) 等设计师商店的玻璃正面被砸碎。

paras.en: Shopkeepers were out early with brooms, picking up large shards of glass as they began the clean-up. Rubbish trucks worked their way down some of the larger streets to clear some of the debris.
paras.zh: 店主们很早就拿着扫帚出去，开始清理工作，捡起大块玻璃碎片。垃圾车沿着一些较大的街道行驶，清除一些碎片。

paras.en: Many shops were daubed with graffiti, some reading "tax the rich" and "eat the rich."
paras.zh: 许多商店都涂满了涂鸦，有些写着“向富人征税”和“吃富人”。

paras.en: The BBC visited a clothes shop close to the Place de la RÃ©publique which had been ransacked, with piles of clothes and furniture scattered across the shop floor.
paras.zh: BBC 探访了共和国广场附近的一家服装店，该店已被洗劫一空，成堆的衣服和家具散落在商店地板上。

paras.en: The shop's distraught owner told the BBC he saw looters on the CCTV who were in the shop for just over an hour and a half, and that during that time he saw no police in the process.
paras.zh: 商店的老板心烦意乱地告诉英国广播公司，他在闭路电视上看到抢劫者在商店里待了一个半小时，而在此期间他没有看到警察。

paras.en: The owner - who asked not to be identified - told the BBC he did not believe any of those who robbed the shop were genuine protesters against school conditions or the cost of living. He said the looters were taking advantage of the demonstrations.
paras.zh: 不愿透露姓名的店主告诉英国广播公司，他不相信抢劫商店的人是真正反对学校条件或生活成本的抗议者。他说抢劫者正在利用示威活动。

paras.en: Close to the Place de la RÃ©publique, a BBC reporter visited the Good Vibes bakery, whose glass front was completely shattered, and the Nicolas wine store, where every bottle was either stolen or smashed, leaving smell of alcohol lingering in the street.
paras.zh: BBC记者走访了共和国广场附近的Good Vibes面包店，其玻璃门面被完全粉碎；还有Nicolas葡萄酒商店，那里的每瓶酒要么被偷，要么被砸碎，街上弥漫着酒味。

paras.en: CCTV footage shown on France's Channel 2 shows groups of teenagers, mostly wearing masks, in a shop selling mobile phones helping themselves to items from the shelves.
paras.zh: 法国第二频道播放的闭路电视录像显示，一群青少年在一家销售手机的商店里取用货架上的商品，他们大多戴着口罩。

paras.en: Student protests in France have seen hundreds of thousands take to the streets since they began late last month. Protesters have been demanding additional investment in their schools, criticising the lack of teachers and staff, overcrowded classrooms and run-down buildings.
paras.zh: 自上月底开始以来，法国学生抗议活动已有数十万人走上街头。抗议者一直要求对学校进行额外投资，批评学校缺乏教师和工作人员、教室过度拥挤和建筑破旧。

paras.en: France's Interior Minister Laurent NuÃ±ez said that while demonstrating was a fundamental right, there were "outrages" committed by "several thousand far-left individuals" who were determined to target public buildings and confront the police.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，虽然示威是一项基本权利，但“数千名极左人士”却犯下了“暴行”，他们决心以公共建筑为目标并与警察对抗。

paras.en: Later, they were joined by "delinquents who looted and ransacked numerous businesses in several cities in France", he said.
paras.zh: 他说，后来“犯罪分子也加入了他们的行列，他们在法国几个城市抢劫和洗劫了许多企业”。

paras.en: In the city of Lyon, Mayor GrÃ©gory Doucet said the burning of the city's tourist office was "a tragedy", telling French outlet BFMTV that "it breaks our hearts because it's a very iconic, well-known historic building".
paras.zh: 在里昂市，市长格雷戈里·杜塞特表示，该市旅游局被烧毁是“一场悲剧”，他对法国媒体 BFMTV 表示，“这让我们心碎，因为它是一座非常标志性的、著名的历史建筑”。

paras.en: Local police said "hostile individuals" prevented firefighters from safely tackling the blaze.
paras.zh: 当地警方表示，“敌对人员”阻止消防员安全灭火。

paras.en: Fire crews also battled a fire at Limoges town hall, which caused part of the building to collapse. Local officials said the town hall was "largely lost."
paras.zh: 消防人员还在利摩日市政厅扑灭火灾，导致部分建筑倒塌。当地官员表示，市政厅“大部分已损毁”。

paras.en: "A wild horde" had "deliberately" set fire to the 143-year-old building, said Maurice Barate, the prefect for the Haute-Vienne department.
paras.zh: 上维埃纳省省长莫里斯·巴拉特 (Maurice Barate) 表示，“一群狂野的人”“故意”放火烧毁了这座拥有 143 年历史的建筑。

paras.en: Elsewhere, a young man "had his hand blown off" by a small explosive in Saint-Ãtienne, the south-eastern city's Mayor RÃ©gis Juanico said on social media.
paras.zh: 东南部城市圣蒂安市市长雷吉斯·胡安尼科在社交媒体上表示，在其他地方，一名年轻人的手被小型爆炸物“炸掉”。

paras.en: "Such a tragedy should never have happened," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这样的悲剧根本不应该发生。”

paras.en: France's interior ministry said Saturday's protests involved "targeted acts of violence" from "hooded individuals" in places, including parts of the capital and also in Marseille, Rennes, Toulouse, and the western city of Angers.
paras.zh: 法国内政部表示，周六的抗议活动涉及“蒙面人”的“有针对性的暴力行为”，地点包括首都部分地区以及马赛、雷恩、图卢兹和西部城市昂热。

paras.en: Damage to buildings was reported across France, including in Grenoble, Avignon, Pau, Montpellier and Valence.
paras.zh: 据报道，法国各地的建筑物遭到破坏，包括格勒诺布尔、阿维尼翁、波城、蒙彼利埃和瓦朗斯。

articles.title: Search for Amelia Earhart's plane resumes after stormy weather

paras.en: A search for the wreckage of Amelia Earhart's plane on a remote island in the Pacific Ocean has resumed after severe weather caused researchers to stop for several days.
paras.zh: 在恶劣天气导致研究人员停止几天后，在太平洋一个偏远岛屿上搜寻阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特飞机残骸的工作已经恢复。

paras.en: A team has travelled to Nikumaroro Island, part of Kiribati, hoping to solve the mystery of the famed aviator's disappearance by investigating the so-called Taraia Object, spotted in the atoll's lagoon in aerial imagery.
paras.zh: 一个小组前往基里巴斯的尼库马罗罗岛，希望通过调查航空图像中在环礁泻湖中发现的所谓塔拉亚物体来解开这位著名飞行员失踪的谜团。

paras.en: The American pioneer vanished while attempting to circumnavigate the globe in 1937, spawning decades of speculation about her fate.
paras.zh: 1937 年，这位美国先驱者在尝试环球航行时失踪，引发了数十年来对她命运的猜测。

paras.en: Rough seas and strong winds forced the team to remain on their research vessel for three days, until the weather cleared on Sunday.
paras.zh: 汹涌的海面和强风迫使研究小组在研究船上停留了三天，直到周日天气晴朗。

paras.en: "We are finally getting off the ship and able to land on Nikumaroro," Sirisha Bandla, a technology specialist who is part of the expedition, said in a video update from the deck of the Marin Mainiku.
paras.zh: 参与此次探险的技术专家西里莎·班德拉 (Sirisha Bandla) 在马林·麦尼库 (Marin Mainiku) 甲板上发布的视频更新中表示：“我们终于下船并能够在 Nikumaroro 上着陆了。”

paras.en: The researchers arrived at the uninhabited atoll last week and began an underwater survey of the area of interest.
paras.zh: 研究人员上周抵达无人居住的环礁，开始对感兴趣的区域进行水下调查。

paras.en: But the weather - powered by strong El NiÃ±o conditions in the Pacific - has so far prevented them from beginning a second of three phases, in which underwater objects will be probed to determine their depth and sediment will be dredged.
paras.zh: 但迄今为止，受太平洋强烈厄尔尼诺现象影响的天气阻止了他们开始三个阶段中的第二个阶段，在这个阶段中，将探测水下物体以确定其深度，并疏浚沉积物。

paras.en: "We're working to get everything done today if we can," Bandla said. "The crew's really excited."
paras.zh: “如果可以的话，我们正在努力完成今天的一切，”班德拉说。 “工作人员真的很兴奋。”

paras.en: Earhart had already successfully flown from California across South America, Africa and Asia in her twin-engine Lockheed Electra when she arrived in Lae, Papua New Guinea on 2 July 1937.
paras.zh: 1937 年 7 月 2 日，埃尔哈特驾驶她的双引擎洛克希德·伊莱克特拉 (Lockheed Electra) 抵达巴布亚新几内亚莱城时，已经成功从加利福尼亚州飞越南美洲、非洲和亚洲。

paras.en: From there, she and her navigator Fred Noonan had planned to travel towards Hawaii and then finally back to California.
paras.zh: 从那里，她和她的航海家弗雷德·努南计划前往夏威夷，然后最终返回加利福尼亚。

paras.en: But her plane vanished without a trace while trying to reach Howland Island, a remote, uninhabited coral island near Nikumaroro, to refuel.
paras.zh: 但她的飞机在试图飞往尼库马罗罗附近的一个偏远无人居住的珊瑚岛豪兰岛加油时消失得无影无踪。

paras.en: One theory is that Earhart unintentionally navigated to Nikumaroro, where she ditched her plane and died a castaway.
paras.zh: 一种理论认为，埃尔哈特无意中航行到尼库马罗罗，在那里她抛弃了飞机，不幸遇难。

paras.en: Images of the so-called Taraia Object - which Purdue University says is visible in photography dating back to 1938 - show what could be the remnants of a small aircraft sitting in shallow waters, though other explorers remain sceptical.
paras.zh: 普渡大学称在 1938 年的照片中可以看到所谓的塔拉亚天体 (Taraia Object) 的图像，显​​示可能是浅水中一架小型飞机的残骸，但其他探险家仍持怀疑态度。

paras.en: Interest in the expedition prompted New Zealand's Air Force Museum to publish, external previously unseen reconnaissance images of Nikumaroro on Friday.
paras.zh: 对这次探险的兴趣促使新西兰空军博物馆于周五公布了尼库马罗罗此前未曾见过的外部侦察图像。

paras.en: While the Taraia Object is not obviously visible in any of the black-and-white slides, taken in 1938 from a seaplane, they do show the beached wreck of the SS Norwich City, a British merchant vessel that ran aground on the island during a storm in 1929, killing 11.
paras.zh: 虽然在 1938 年从水上飞机上拍摄的任何黑白幻灯片中都看不到塔拉亚天体，但它们确实显示了搁浅的 SS Norwich City 号商船残骸，这艘英国商船在 1929 年的一场风暴中在岛上搁浅，造成 11 人死亡。

paras.en: Purdue, which with the US-based Archaeological Legacy Institute (ALI) is spearheading the expedition, said the incident demonstrated the risks surrounding the island.
paras.zh: 普渡大学与美国考古遗产研究所（ALI）一起带头进行这次探险，该大学表示，这一事件表明了该岛周围存在的风险。

paras.en: To get into the atoll's lagoon, a boat has to navigate through a narrow gap created in the reef by the British in 1963 - the last time the island was inhabited.
paras.zh: 要进入环礁的泻湖，船只必须穿过英国人在 1963 年（该岛最后一次有人居住）在礁石上开辟的狭窄缝隙。

paras.en: But the university said wind gusts of up to 27 knots (31mph) present around the island until Sunday meant the transport boat could be knocked into the reef by crashing waves.
paras.zh: 但该大学表示，直到周日为止，岛上周围的阵风速度高达 27 节（31 英里/小时），这意味着运输船可能会被海浪撞到礁石上。

paras.en: However, it said the Norwich City wreck may lend credence to the researchers' theory.
paras.zh: 然而，它表示诺维奇市的沉船事件可能会为研究人员的理论提供可信度。

paras.en: Purdue said a 15-year-old in Florida reported hearing Earhart's voice repeating "New York City" over her father's shortwave radio shortly after the aviator vanished. Proponents of the castaway theory argue this may have been a misunderstanding of Earhart giving her location as near the Norwich City.
paras.zh: 普渡大学表示，佛罗里达州一名 15 岁的女孩报告称，在埃尔哈特失踪后不久，她在她父亲的短波收音机上听到了重复“纽约市”的声音。漂流者理论的支持者认为，这可能是埃尔哈特将她的位置定位在诺维奇城附近的误解。

paras.en: As a result of the three-day hold, the research team has extended the expedition time to complete its fieldwork and has yet to indicate whether they had found any promising evidence of Earhart's plane.
paras.zh: 经过三天的停留，研究小组延长了探险时间以完成实地工作，但尚未表明他们是否发现了埃尔哈特飞机的任何有希望的证据。

paras.en: ALI director Rick Pettigrew said the team was aware of the global interest in the expedition and would share its results "as soon as we are able". Purdue suggested before the poor weather hit that it could identify the Taraia Object in a matter of days.
paras.zh: ALI 主管里克·佩蒂格鲁 (Rick Pettigrew) 表示，该团队意识到全球对这次探险的兴趣，并将“尽快”分享其结果。普渡大学在恶劣天气到来之前表示，它可以在几天内识别出塔拉亚天体。

paras.en: While researchers have previously found evidence of a human presence on the island around the time of Earhart's disappearance, some skeptics believe the Taraia Object was just a tree that had fallen from the atoll into the lagoon.
paras.zh: 虽然研究人员之前发现了埃尔哈特失踪前后岛上有人类存在的证据，但一些怀疑论者认为塔拉亚天体只是一棵从环礁掉入泻湖的树。

paras.en: Previous attempts to find her Electra have also come up short.
paras.zh: 此前寻找她的厄勒克特拉的尝试也未能成功。

paras.en: In 2024, a group of researchers said they may have found it lying around 4,877m (16,000ft) below the surface near Howland Island through sonar imaging - but this was later confirmed to be a rock formation.
paras.zh: 2024 年，一组研究人员表示，他们可能通过声纳成像发现它位于豪兰岛附近地表以下约 4,877 m（16,000 英尺）处，但后来证实这是一个岩层。

paras.en: Similarly, an expedition in 2019 to investigate a photograph of what might have been landing gear protruding from the water near Nikumaroro also failed to find anything.
paras.zh: 同样，2019 年的一次探险队调查了尼库马罗罗附近可能是从水中伸出的起落架的照片，但也没有找到任何东西。

articles.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg

paras.en: At least one person has been killed in an overnight attack on St Petersburg that successfully targeted two of the city's oil facilities.
paras.zh: 圣彼得堡夜间发生的袭击成功袭击了该市的两个石油设施，造成至少一人死亡。

paras.en: The region's Governor Alexander Beglov said fires were being extinguished at the St Petersburg Oil Terminal and the Ruchyi oil depot following the attack, which also injured at least five.
paras.zh: 该地区州长亚历山大·贝格洛夫表示，袭击事件发生后，圣彼得堡油码头和鲁奇伊油库的大火正在扑灭，袭击还造成至少五人受伤。

paras.en: A logistics centre belonging to Ozon - known as Russia's Amazon - and a data centre belonging to Facebook equivalent VKontakte were also hit.
paras.zh: 被称为俄罗斯亚马逊的 Ozon 的一个物流中心和 Facebook 类似的 VKontakte 的一个数据中心也受到了袭击。

paras.en: Kyiv has not yet commented on the strikes. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Saturday morning that Russia had targeted his country's energy sector 76 times since Donald Trump declared an "energy ceasefire" last week.
paras.zh: 基辅尚未对袭击事件发表评论。乌克兰总统泽伦斯基周六上午表示，自唐纳德·特朗普上周宣布“能源停火”以来，俄罗斯已经76次针对乌克兰能源部门。

paras.en: Ukraine had paused its strikes on Russian oil facilities - which it says are to limit the main revenue stream for Moscow's war effort - for three days after the announcement, while accusing Russia of continuing.
paras.zh: 乌克兰在宣布这一消息后三天暂停了对俄罗斯石油设施的袭击，称此举是为了限制莫斯科战争努力的主要收入来源，同时指责俄罗斯继续袭击。

paras.en: It then resumed strikes earlier this week, drawing the ire of Trump, who called for a truce to facilitate a deal he struck with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin to supply diesel.
paras.zh: 随后，该公司于本周早些时候恢复罢工，引起了特朗普的愤怒，特朗普呼吁休战，以促进他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京(Vladimir Putin)达成的柴油供应协议。

paras.en: Ukraine has struck St Petersburg before, though regions closer to Ukraine are threatened more often. The city's oil terminal was last hit in July.
paras.zh: 乌克兰此前曾袭击过圣彼得堡，但距离乌克兰较近的地区受到威胁的频率更高。该市的石油码头上次遭受袭击是在七月份。

paras.en: Russia's defence ministry said it had shot down more than 1,000 Ukrainian drones over Russian territory overnight into Sunday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，截至周日，已在俄罗斯领土上空击落了 1000 多架乌克兰无人机。

paras.en: St Petersburg's governor said 12 apartment buildings and two homes were damaged in the attacks on the city, while Pulkovo Airport was temporarily closed.
paras.zh: 圣彼得堡州长表示，该市有 12 栋公寓楼和两栋房屋在袭击中受损，普尔科沃机场暂时关闭。

paras.en: He also said mobile internet service disruption was possible.
paras.zh: 他还表示，移动互联网服务可能会中断。

paras.en: Social network VK confirmed a drone had targeted its regional data centre, but stressed its services were available "as usual" after users reported outages in the early hours of the morning.
paras.zh: 社交网络 VK 证实一架无人机袭击了其区域数据中心，但强调在用户报告凌晨出现服务中断后，其服务“照常”可用。

paras.en: Ozon also confirmed its local logistics centre had been targeted by a drone, sparking a fire.
paras.zh: 奥宗还证实，其当地物流中心遭到无人机袭击，引发火灾。

paras.en: It said staff were evacuated and no one was injured, and that it was not accepting shipments from sellers at the location "as it is currently serving other operational purposes".
paras.zh: 该公司表示，工作人员已被疏散，无人受伤，并且该地点不接受卖家的发货，“因为该地点目前正在服务于其他运营目的”。

paras.en: As well as numerous oil facilities across Russia, Ukraine has also mounted strikes aimed at disrupting the Russian economy more broadly. Earlier this month, it launched a series of attacks on Yandex, Russia's largest search engine, that led to service disruptions.
paras.zh: 除了俄罗斯各地的众多石油设施外，乌克兰还发动了旨在更广泛地扰乱俄罗斯经济的罢工。本月早些时候，它对俄罗斯最大的搜索引擎 Yandex 发起了一系列攻击，导致服务中断。

paras.en: Relations between Washington and Kyiv have frayed since the US struck a controversial deal to import Russian diesel in the hope of bringing down US energy prices, which have skyrocketed during the Iran war, ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 自从美国在中期选举前达成一项有争议的进口俄罗斯柴油协议，以期压低在伊朗战争期间飙升的美国能源价格以来，华盛顿和基辅之间的关系就出现了紧张。

paras.en: Zelensky suggested the deal was tantamount to the US investing in Russia's war effort.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，该协议相当于美国投资俄罗斯的战争努力。

paras.en: Trump's decision to temporarily suspend a raft of sanctions against Russia has brought fresh criticism, including from some US Republicans.
paras.zh: 特朗普决定暂时中止对俄罗斯的一系列制裁，引发了新的批评，其中包括一些美国共和党人的批评。

paras.en: However, on Sunday, Zelensky said on Telegram he had had conversations with Trump's top negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
paras.zh: 然而，周日，泽伦斯基在 Telegram 上表示，他已与特朗普的高级谈判代表史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳进行了交谈。

paras.en: He said their teams are in constant communication and preparing the next diplomatic steps.
paras.zh: 他说，他们的团队正在不断沟通并准备下一步的外交步骤。

paras.en: Both Russia and Ukraine have been striking one another's energy infrastructure with increasing intensity ahead of the winter, as Moscow's full-scale invasion drags on in its fifth year.
paras.zh: 随着莫斯科的全面入侵已进入第五个年头，俄罗斯和乌克兰在冬季到来之前都在加大力度攻击对方的能源基础设施。

paras.en: Russia says it hits targets used by Ukraine's military, though the UN noted on Friday that the first two weeks of October had been the deadliest for Ukrainian civilians in years.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯称它击中了乌克兰军方使用的目标，尽管联合国周五指出，十月的前两周是乌克兰平民多年来死亡人数最多的一周。

paras.en: Russian strikes on energy facilities have left hundreds of thousands without power, raising concerns about civilians enduring another freezing winter.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯对能源设施的袭击导致数十万人断电，引发人们对平民再次忍受寒冷冬天的担忧。

paras.en: Zelensky said on Saturday that tens of thousands of people were still without power. Russia launched nearly 2,700 drones, 1,700 aerial bombs and 66 missiles in the past week, most of which were aimed at energy facilities, he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周六表示，仍有数万人断电。他说，过去一周俄罗斯发射了近2700架无人机、1700枚航空炸弹和66枚导弹，其中大部分针对能源设施。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上展示。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.en: Featuring the latest solutions in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, exhaust recirculation valves and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.en: Demonstrating micro-controller-based platforms for instrumentation and HMI.
paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

paras.en: Exhibiting new electro-hydraulic actuators with a design focus on efficiency, perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications.
paras.zh: 展示新型电动液压执行器，其设计注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精度，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: NABC, Open Road Collision Donate Recycled Ride to New Mexico Mom
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Friday, Oct. 2, an Albuquerque, N.M., woman received a donated refurbished vehicle through the NABC Recycled Rides program, with the vehicle provided by Farmers Insurance and repairs completed by Open Road Collision.
paras.zh: 10 月 2 日星期五，新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基市的一名妇女收到了一辆通过 NABC Recycled Rides 计划捐赠的翻新车辆，该车辆由 Farmers Insurance 提供，并由 Open Road Collision 完成维修。

paras.en: The presentation was made at Open Road Collision in Albuquerque. The recipient was nominated by the Somos Unidos Foundation, the official 501(c)(3) nonprofit arm of the professional USL club New Mexico United.
paras.zh: 该演讲是在阿尔伯克基的开放道路碰撞大会上进行的。获奖者由 Somos Unidos 基金会提名，该基金会是职业 USL 俱乐部新墨西哥联队的官方 501(c)(3) 非营利机构。

paras.en: A 2017 Honda CR-V, donated by Farmers and refurbished by technicians at Open Road Collision, was presented to Lorena Alvarez. Alvarez has faced significant challenges as a single mother and had struggled with a lack of reliable transportation. This NABC Recycled Rides vehicle will provide needed mobility for her family.
paras.zh: 一辆由 Farmers 捐赠并由 Open Road Collision 技术人员翻新的 2017 款本田 CR-V 被赠送给洛雷娜·阿尔瓦雷斯 (Lorena Alvarez)。作为一名单亲母亲，阿尔瓦雷斯面临着重大挑战，并因缺乏可靠的交通而苦苦挣扎。这辆 NABC Recycled Rides 车辆将为她的家人提供所需的机动性。

paras.en: Community members can support the program by donating directly or by contributing unwanted or non-running vehicles through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. Donors receive a tax donation, and proceeds help provide reliable transportation for those in need.
paras.zh: 社区成员可以通过直接捐赠或通过“改变和拯救生命钥匙促进改变”计划贡献不需要或未运行的车辆来支持该计划。捐助者收到税收捐款，收益有助于为有需要的人提供可靠的交通。

paras.en: Additional partners in this presentation include Car Crafters, Copart, Enterprise, Advanced Remarketing Services and Cars for Charity.
paras.zh: 本次演示中的其他合作伙伴包括 Car Crafters、Copart、Enterprise、Advanced Remarketing Services 和 Cars for Charity。

paras.en: Farmers, a level one member of the NABC, has donated nearly 100 vehicles to people and organizations in need through NABC Recycled Rides.
For more information on Recycled Rides, click here.
paras.zh: 有关回收游乐设施的更多信息，请单击此处。

articles.title: What to Know about Static and Dynamic ADAS Calibrations
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Choosing between static and dynamic ADAS calibration depends on the procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer. Regardless of the method, the vehicle and its surroundings must meet the manufacturer’s requirements.
paras.zh: 静态和动态 ADAS 校准之间的选择取决于车辆制造商指定的程序。无论采用哪种方法，车辆及其周围环境都必须满足制造商的要求。

paras.en: ADAS systems affected by a repair may need to be calibrated, relearned or re-zeroed. Terminology may vary, but the purpose is to establish an accurate reference point for the system.
paras.zh: 受维修影响的 ADAS 系统可能需要校准、重新学习或重新调零。术语可能有所不同，但目的是为系统建立准确的参考点。

paras.en: A static calibration is performed while the vehicle remains stationary.
paras.zh: 静态校准是在车辆保持静止时执行的。

paras.en: Technicians position targets at exact distances and heights. The targets must also be square to the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 技术人员将目标定位在精确的距离和高度。目标还必须与车辆中心线成直角。

paras.en: The vehicle must meet specified requirements for weight, ride height, tire pressure, fluid levels, lighting and background conditions.
paras.zh: 车辆必须满足重量、行驶高度、轮胎压力、液位、照明和背景条件的规定要求。

paras.en: Dynamic calibration takes place while driving. The technician places the system into calibration mode and drives the vehicle under specified conditions.
paras.zh: 动态校准在驾驶时进行。技术人员将系统置于校准模式并在指定条件下驾驶车辆。

paras.en: During the drive, the sensors verify that they can identify the roadway, recognize objects and align correctly with the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 在驾驶过程中，传感器验证它们是否可以识别道路、识别物体并与车辆中心线正确对齐。

paras.en: Extra weight, improper tire pressure, incorrect ride height or environmental interference can cause calibration to fail. These conditions can also establish an inaccurate reference.
paras.zh: 额外的重量、不正确的轮胎压力、不正确的行驶高度或环境干扰都可能导致校准失败。这些条件也可能建立不准确的参考。

paras.en: Whether the procedure is static or dynamic, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions exactly. ADAS calibration depends on precision, and even small inconsistencies can affect system performance.
paras.zh: 无论程序是静态还是动态，技术人员都必须严格遵循制造商的说明。 ADAS 校准取决于精度，即使很小的不一致也会影响系统性能。

articles.title: AkzoNobel and Axalta to Be Called Axanzo Following Merger
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AkzoNobel and Axalta Coating Systems have announced Axanzo as the name of the combined company following completion of their intended merger.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔和艾仕得涂料系统公司宣布，在完成合并计划后，合并后的公司名称将更名为 Axanzo。

paras.en: The planned merger, announced in November 2025, will create a global coatings leader with the scale, strength and reach to accelerate sustainable growth and deliver breakthrough innovation. The envisaged post-closing NYSE and Euronext Amsterdam ticker symbol will be AXZ.
paras.zh: 这项计划于 2025 年 11 月宣布的合并将打造一家全球涂料领导者，其规模、实力和影响力足以加速可持续增长并提供突破性创新。预计收盘后纽约证券交易所和阿姆斯特丹泛欧交易所的股票代码将为 AXZ。

paras.en: “We’re excited to announce the new name for our combined company,” said Greg Poux-Guillaume, CEO of AkzoNobel who will also be CEO of the new organization. “Axanzo signals a bold new start for a company which will be stronger in every way. It’s a launchpad for going further and faster than we ever could alone, embodying the pace and power to innovate, the strength to deliver and the excellence to succeed.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔首席执行官格雷格·普吉约姆 (Greg Poux-Guillaume) 表示：“我们很高兴宣布合并后公司的新名称。”他也将担任新组织的首席执行官。 “Axanzo 标志着公司的一个大胆的新开始，它将在各方面变得更加强大。它是一个比我们独自走得更远、更快的发射台，体现了创新的步伐和力量、交付的力量以及成功的卓越能力。”

paras.en: Axalta CEO Chris Villavarayan, who will be deputy CEO of the combined company, added, “Axanzo will continuously reset the standard of what coatings can do. The new name perfectly captures our shared ambition to push boundaries, honoring our heritage and offering an exciting glimpse of what’s to come.”
paras.zh: 艾仕得首席执行官 Chris Villavarayan 将担任合并后公司的副首席执行官，他补充道：“Axanzo 将不断重新设定涂料的标准。新名称完美体现了我们突破界限、尊重我们的传统并令人兴奋地展望未来的共同雄心。”

paras.en: The subtle, but intentional, reference to the heritage of both companies unites both companies’ legacies to usher in a new era for the industry. The combined business will bring together a diversified and balanced portfolio of around 100 highly regarded and trusted brands across paints and coatings, spanning more than 160 countries.
paras.zh: 对两家公司传统的微妙但有意的提及将两家公司的传统结合起来，开创了行业的新时代。合并后的业务将汇集约 100 个备受推崇和信赖的油漆和涂料品牌的多元化、平衡的产品组合，覆盖 160 多个国家。

paras.en: “Axanzo will focus on delivering uncompromising performance to sharpen our competitive edge, while establishing a profitable and sustainable path forward as a world leader in coatings,” Poux-Guillaume said. “By forging our expertise, the best of each of us will become the standard for all of us.”
paras.zh: Poux-Guillaume 表示：“Axanzo 将专注于提供不妥协的性能，以增强我们的竞争优势，同时作为涂料领域的世界领导者建立一条盈利且可持续的前进道路。” “通过锻造我们的专业知识，我们每个人中最好的人将成为我们所有人的标准。”

paras.en: Both AkzoNobel and Axalta will continue to operate as independent companies until closing, which is expected in early 2027 once all regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions have been finalized. The announcement of the new name does not change how customers and partners currently work with either company. They will continue to be served by their existing teams and through the brands and relationships they know and trust.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔和艾仕得都将继续作为独立公司运营，直至交割，预计在所有监管部门批准和惯例交割条件最终确定后，将于 2027 年初完成交割。新名称的公布不会改变客户和合作伙伴目前与任何一家公司的合作方式。他们将继续由现有团队以及他们了解和信任的品牌和关系提供服务。

paras.en: Watch the Axanzo name reveal video here.
paras.zh: 在此观看 Axanzo 名字揭晓视频。

articles.title: NAIC seeks public comment on producer licensing handbook revisions
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: A National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) working group has adopted revisions to the association’s State Licensing Handbook for insurance producers and has requested public comment.
paras.zh: 全国保险专员协会 (NAIC) 工作组已通过对该协会《保险生产商国家许可手册》的修订，并征求公众意见。

paras.en: The Producer Licensing Uniformity (D) Working Group adopted the revisions on Oct. 7. The Producer Licensing (D) Task Force will review all submitted comments and consider adopting the revised handbook at its Nov. 5 meeting.
paras.zh: 生产者许可一致性 (D) 工作组于 10 月 7 日通过了修订版。生产者许可 (D) 工作组将审查所有提交的意见，并考虑在 11 月 5 日的会议上通过修订后的手册。

paras.en: The revisions include several additions to the recommended best practices for insurance regulators on producer exam content and testing administration. These include establishing a state advisory committee made up of state insurance regulators and the industry to work with testing vendors annually to review examination form questions “for substantive and psychometric requirements.”
paras.zh: 这些修订包括对保险监管机构建议的生产者考试内容和测试管理最佳实践的一些补充。其中包括建立一个由州保险监管机构和行业组成的州咨询委员会，每年与测试供应商合作，审查考试形式的问题“是否符合实质性和心理测量要求”。

paras.en: The working group recommends states should work with testing vendors to approve and issue candidate information bulletins that “accurately describe the examinations and examination policies and procedures, and provide sufficient examination content outline and study references for the candidate to prepare for the examination.”
paras.zh: 工作组建议各州应与考试供应商合作批准和发布考生信息公告，“准确描述考试和考试政策和程序，并为考生准备考试提供充分的考试内容大纲和学习参考”。

paras.en: It’s also recommended that states set clear performance standards for test vendors and require accountability.
paras.zh: 还建议各州为测试供应商制定明确的绩效标准并要求问责。

paras.en: The new recommendations include making testing available at locations reasonably convenient to residents of all areas of the state, with registration available online or by phone and the ability for a candidate to schedule testing within two to five business days of registration, according to the proposed revised handbook. It also recommends that states administer exams through a secure test-center network that employs qualified test proctors.
paras.zh: 根据拟议的修订手册，新的建议包括在该州所有地区的居民相当方便的地点提供测试，可以在线或通过电话注册，并且候选人能够在注册后的两到五个工作日内安排测试。它还建议各州通过雇用合格考试监考人员的安全考试中心网络来管理考试。

paras.en: Another proposed addition to the handbook states that there isn’t a uniform approach nationwide on whether the surplus lines license (for residents and non-residents) is a separate license type or a line of authority on the producer license.
paras.zh: 手册中的另一项提议补充指出，对于剩余线许可证（针对居民和非居民）是单独的许可证类型还是生产者许可证的授权线，全国范围内没有统一的方法。

paras.en: “Regardless of the approach taken, a resident must hold a valid property/casualty producer license to qualify for the issuance of a surplus lines license,” the proposed addition states. “This underlying P&C license requirement is for both individuals and business entities.”
paras.zh: 拟议的补充规定：“无论采取何种方法，居民都必须持有有效的财产/伤亡生产者许可证，才有资格获得剩余额度许可证。” “这一基本的 P&C 许可证要求适用于个人和商业实体。”

paras.en: Proposed requirements for remote testing guidelines are included in the revisions as well.
paras.zh: 远程测试指南的拟议要求也包含在修订中。

paras.en: According to the revisions, remote testing offers the same support as in-person test sites but includes several guidelines for states to follow to ensure proper testing:
paras.zh: 根据修订，远程测试提供与现场测试站点相同的支持，但包括一些供各州遵循的准则，以确保正确的测试：

paras.en: - “Procedures for conducting a system check of the candidate’s computer and internet service are sufficient.
paras.zh: - “对候选人的计算机和互联网服务进行系统检查的程序就足够了。

paras.en: - “The installation of any necessary software to facilitate the delivery of the exam.
paras.zh: - “安装任何必要的软件以方便考试的进行。

paras.en: - “Conduct a comprehensive security check, including verifying the identity of the candidate.
paras.zh: - “进行全面的安全检查，包括验证候选人的身份。

paras.en: - “Candidates must be in a distraction-free environment, where they can complete the exam unassisted in a secure environment.
paras.zh: - “考生必须处于无干扰的环境中，可以在安全的环境中独立完成考试。

paras.en: - “Exams are continuously monitored by video and audio recording similar to in-person test sites, as well as AI-enhanced monitoring proctoring.
paras.zh: - “考试通过类似于现场考试现场的视频和音频记录以及人工智能增强监控监考进行持续监控。

paras.en: - “Exam hours should include evening and weekend hours.
paras.zh: - “考试时间应包括晚上和周末时间。

paras.en: - “Testing vendors should establish procedures that analyze post- exam data for patterns of suspicious activity.”
paras.zh: - “测试供应商应建立程序来分析考后数据以发现可疑活动模式。”

paras.en: The proposed changes also provide additional guidance on approval of continuing education instructors.
paras.zh: 拟议的变更还为继续教育教师的批准提供了额外的指导。

paras.en: Comments on the revisions and additions to the handbook will be accepted through Oct. 30. Written comments should be sent to Tim Mullen, NAIC staff support for the Producer Licensing (D) Task Force, at [email protected].
paras.zh: 有关手册修订和补充的意见将于 10 月 30 日之前接受。书面意见应发送至生产者许可 (D) 工作组的 NAIC 工作人员 Tim Mullen，电子邮件地址为 [email protected]。

paras.en: At the Nov. 5 meeting, the task force will also consider adopting proposed revisions to the NAIC Independent Adjuster Licensing Guideline, the 1033 written consent process template, and proposed 2027 task force charges.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 5 日的会议上，工作组还将考虑通过对 NAIC 独立理算师许可指南、1033 书面同意流程模板的拟议修订，以及拟议的 2027 年工作组收费。

paras.en: The agenda and materials for the meeting will be posted on the task force webpage.
paras.zh: 会议议程和材料将发布在工作组网页上。

articles.title: Rivian and Redwood expand partnership to repurpose EV batteries
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Rivian has expanded its partnership with energy technology company Redwood Materials to recycle production scrap and end-of-life EV batteries, according to a Rivian press release. Redwood will also provide stationary battery storage at its manufacturing plant in Normal, Illinois.
paras.zh: 据 Rivian 新闻稿称，Rivian 扩大了与能源技术公司 Redwood Materials 的合作关系，以回收生产废料和报废电动汽车电池。 Redwood 还将在其位于伊利诺伊州诺莫尔的制造工厂提供固定电池存储。

paras.en: Redwood collects Rivian EV battery packs through Rivian’s nationwide network of service centers when they are no longer suitable for in-vehicle use. Redwood then evaluates each battery pack for energy storage at Rivian’s manufacturing facilities or other locations, or for recycling. Redwood will now also recycle battery scrap generated at Rivian’s manufacturing operations.
paras.zh: 当 Rivian 电动汽车电池组不再适合在车内使用时，Redwood 将通过 Rivian 的全国服务中心网络收集这些电池组。然后，Redwood 评估每个电池组在 Rivian 制造工厂或其他地点的储能或回收利用情况。 Redwood 现在还将回收 Rivian 制造业务中产生的电池废料。

paras.en: Rivian says the partnership expansion builds on existing work, announced in April, that provides 10 megawatt-hours (MWh) of battery energy storage from repurposed Rivian battery packs at the automaker’s Illinois manufacturing plant.
paras.zh: Rivian 表示，此次合作伙伴关系扩展建立在 4 月份宣布的现有工作的基础上，该项目通过该汽车制造商伊利诺伊州制造工厂改造后的 Rivian 电池组提供 10 兆瓦时 (MWh) 的电池储能。

paras.en: “Giving Rivian battery packs a second life in stationary storage is a massive unlock for the energy transition,” said RJ Scaringe, Rivian founder and CEO, in the release. “By partnering with JB and the Redwood team, we’re turning retired EV batteries into a powerful tool to make the grid more reliable and lower energy costs for everyone.”
paras.zh: Rivian 创始人兼首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 在新闻稿中表示：“让 Rivian 电池组在固定存储中获得第二次生命，是能源转型的一次重大解锁。” “通过与 JB 和 Redwood 团队合作，我们正在将退役的电动汽车电池转变为强大的工具，使电网更加可靠，并降低每个人的能源成本。”

paras.en: JB Straubel, Redwood Materials founder and CEO, added that every Rivian battery pack can potentially provide domestic grid energy storage and critical materials.
paras.zh: Redwood Materials 创始人兼首席执行官 JB Straubel 补充说，每个 Rivian 电池组都有可能提供国内电网储能和关键材料。

paras.en: “Redwood’s unique ability to integrate and redeploy Rivian batteries with our technology is an opportunity to enable fast, flexible, and more cost-efficient energy storage,” he said. “As the demand and cost for energy keep rising, working with companies like Rivian is how we help meet these challenges.”
paras.zh: “Redwood 具有将 Rivian 电池与我们的技术集成和重新部署的独特能力，这是实现快速、灵活且更具成本效益的能源存储的机会，”他说。 “随着能源需求和成本不断上升，与 Rivian 这样的公司合作是我们帮助应对这些挑战的方式。”

paras.en: Energy storage applications with repurposed batteries can ease grid stress during periods of high electricity demand, improving grid reliability while reducing energy costs for users and the grid at large, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，采用重新利用电池的储能应用可以缓解电力需求高时期的电网压力，提高电网可靠性，同时降低用户和整个电网的能源成本。

paras.en: During periods of low demand or when low-cost renewable energy is most productive, the packs can store electricity for easy dispatch during periods of higher demand. When paired with EV battery packs from Rivian and others, the release states that Redwood’s proprietary technology architecture offers an integrated system that can respond intelligently to the needs of the facility it is serving.
paras.zh: 在需求低迷时期或低成本可再生能源最具生产力时，电池组可以储存电力，以便在需求较高时期轻松调度。该新闻稿称，当与 Rivian 等公司的电动汽车电池组配合使用时，Redwood 的专有技术架构提供了一个集成系统，可以智能地响应其所服务设施的需求。

paras.en: Then, when batteries are no longer useful in energy storage applications, or when manufacturing generates scrap, they can be recycled.
paras.zh: 然后，当电池不再用于储能应用时，或者当制造产生废料时，它们可以被回收。

paras.en: Redwood’s process can recycle and recover critical minerals, such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and copper, at rates exceeding 95%, encouraging circular, domestic supply chain development for battery materials in the U.S., according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，Redwood 的工艺可以回收和回收锂、镍、钴和铜等关键矿物，回收率超过 95%，从而鼓励美国电池材料循环国内供应链的发展。

paras.en: “This expanded partnership reflects a broader shift underway in how American manufacturers source power,” the release states. “As grid connections take years to secure and conventional infrastructure remains supply-constrained, companies increasingly need partners who can solve more than one piece of the problem — recovering materials, managing recycling, and deploying storage as a single system rather than separate vendors.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“这种扩大的合作伙伴关系反映了美国制造商获取电力的方式正在发生更广泛的转变。” “由于电网连接需要数年时间才能确保安全，而且传统基础设施仍然供应有限，企业越来越需要能够解决多个问题的合作伙伴——回收材料、管理回收以及将存储部署为单个系统而不是单独的供应商。”

paras.en: BMW and General Motors have also previously announced partnerships with Redwood. BMW’s was to recycle lithium-ion batteries, similar to recycling partnerships Redwood signed with Toyota, Ford, Volvo, and Volkswagen.
paras.zh: 宝马和通用汽车此前也宣布与 Redwood 建立合作伙伴关系。宝马的目标是回收锂离子电池，类似于红木与丰田、福特、沃尔沃和大众签署的回收合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: GM launched a program to accelerate the deployment of energy storage systems using new and second-life battery packs from the automaker’s EVs.
paras.zh: 通用汽车启动了一项计划，利用该汽车制造商电动汽车的新型电池组和二次电池组来加速储能系统的部署。

paras.en: Featured image: Rivian’s manufacturing operations at its Normal, Illinois plant.
paras.zh: 特色图片：Rivian 在伊利诺伊州诺莫尔工厂的制造业务。

articles.title: BMW N54 Cooling System Problems
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The BMW N54 is known for its smooth power delivery, nearly nonexistent turbo lag and robust forged internals. It’s also known to suffer from a few common issues, one of which is its electric water pump. That’s right, the water pump, the component that circulates coolant throughout the engine cooling circuit, is electric.
paras.zh: BMW N54 以其平稳的动力传输、几乎不存在的涡轮迟滞和坚固的锻造内部结构而闻名。众所周知，它还存在一些常见问题，其中之一就是电动水泵。没错，水泵是使冷却剂在整个发动机冷却回路中循环的部件，是电动的。

paras.en: The water pumps we’re discussing are used in a number of vehicles. This includes the 128i, 325i, 325xi, 330i, 330xi, 525i, 525xi, 528i, 528xi, 530i, 530xi, X3, X5, and Z4. Let’s take a closer look at this unique water pump, how to replace it efficiently and what other components should be replaced along with it.
paras.zh: 我们正在讨论的水泵用于许多车辆。其中包括 128i、325i、325xi、330i、330xi、525i、525xi、528i、528xi、530i、530xi、X3、X5 和 Z4。让我们仔细看看这个独特的水泵，如何有效地更换它，以及应该一起更换哪些其他组件。

paras.en: Electric water pumps are becoming more and more common on modern engines. Electric auxiliary water pumps have been around for a long time. Their job is to circulate warm coolant through the heater core or to circulate coolant throughout an additional cooling circuit, such as a water-to-air charge air cooler.
paras.zh: 电动水泵在现代发动机上变得越来越普遍。电动辅助水泵已经存在很长时间了。它们的工作是使温暖的冷却剂循环通过加热器核心或使冷却剂循环通过附加冷却回路，例如水-空气增压空气冷却器。

paras.en: Using an electric water pump instead of the more common belt- or chain-driven mechanical pump does offer a number of advantages to both automakers and customers. The speed of a mechanical pump is directly tied to engine RPM, so the pump is able to circulate coolant only at a given rate. But since there is no mechanical link between the engine and the electric water pump, it is able to circulate coolant at whatever rate is needed based on operating conditions.
paras.zh: 使用电动水泵代替更常见的皮带或链条驱动机械泵确实为汽车制造商和客户提供了许多优势。机械泵的速度与发动机转速直接相关，因此泵只能以给定的速率循环冷却液。但由于发动机和电动水泵之间没有机械连接，因此它能够根据运行条件以所需的任何速率循环冷却剂。

paras.en: The electric water pump on the N54 has a power output of 400W, and a maximum flow rate of 9,000 liters per hour. The motor power is electronically controlled by the control module inside the pump housing, and this module is connected via the communication BUS to the Digital Motor Electrics (DME), also known as the engine control unit or ECU. The DME uses the engine load, the operating mode and the data from the temperature sensors to calculate the required cooling output, then commands the electric pump according to the current operating conditions. The electric pump regulates its speed based on this command from the DME. Coolant flows through the motor inside the pump, providing cooling to both the motor and the electronic module.
paras.zh: N54 上的电动水泵输出功率为 400W，最大流量为每小时 9,000 升。电机功率由泵壳内的控制模块进行电子控制，该模块通过通信总线连接到数字电机电气系统 (DME)，也称为发动机控制单元或 ECU。 DME 使用发动机负载、运行模式和温度传感器的数据来计算所需的冷却输出，然后根据当前运行条件命令电动泵。电动泵根据 DME 的命令调节其速度。冷却剂流过泵内的电机，为电机和电子模块提供冷却。

paras.en: The electric water pump circulates coolant even after the engine has been shut off. Doing this can cool down the turbochargers and help to prolong their service life.
paras.zh: 即使在发动机关闭后，电动水泵也会循环冷却液。这样做可以冷却涡轮增压器并有助于延长其使用寿命。

paras.en: Electric water pumps on the N54 have been known to fail around 60,000-80,000 miles.
paras.zh: 据了解，N54 上的电动水泵在行驶 60,000-80,000 英里左右时会出现故障。

paras.en: When the DME detects an issue with the pump, or if it sees engine coolant temps rising, it will notify the driver through the instrument cluster. This may take the form of one of two different messages: “Engine Temp High – Drive Moderately” displayed in yellow, or “Engine Overheat – Stop” displayed in red. The vehicle may go into “limp mode” which limits the engine RPM and available gear selection in an effort to protect engine components from damage. The electric cooling fan will usually jump to its maximum speed. You may also find stored 2E81 and/or 2E82 trouble codes, which indicate a problem with the pump.
paras.zh: 当 DME 检测到泵出现问题，或者发现发动机冷却液温度上升时，它将通过仪表板通知驾驶员。这可能采用两种不同消息之一的形式：“发动机温度高 - 适度驾驶”显示为黄色，或“发动机过热 - 停止”显示为红色。车辆可能会进入“跛行模式”，限制发动机转速和可用档位选择，以保护发动机部件免受损坏。电动冷却风扇通常会跳至最大速度。您还可能会发现存储的 2E81 和/或 2E82 故障代码，这些代码表明泵存在问题。

paras.en: There are two other cooling system issues you should be on the lookout for whenever you’re inspecting or quoting a replacement to a customer: The coolant inlet pipe, and the “Mickey Mouse” hose.
paras.zh: 每当您检查或向客户报价更换件时，您还应该注意另外两个冷却系统问题：冷却液入口管和“米老鼠”软管。

paras.en: The coolant inlet pipe is an aluminum pipe with a rubber elbow on one end and an aluminum flange on the other end. The aluminum flange bolts up to the cylinder head between the turbochargers, and the rubber elbow connects to the water pump. The aluminum portion of this component should last for a long, long time, but the rubber elbow is prone to failing. This is largely due to the fact that it is mounted so close to the front turbocharger.
paras.zh: 冷却液入口管是一根铝管，一端有橡胶弯头，另一端有铝制法兰。铝制法兰用螺栓固定在涡轮增压器之间的气缸盖上，橡胶弯头连接到水泵。该部件的铝制部分应该可以使用很长很长的时间，但橡胶弯头很容易出现故障。这主要是因为它安装得非常靠近前涡轮增压器。

paras.en: The real issue for customers is that BMW offers only the entire assembly; the hose isn’t available from the dealer separately. The hose clamp on the water pump side is a standard worm-drive unit so it’s easy to remove, but the other clamp is proprietary and it’s extremely difficult to remove without cutting it off. Worst of all, the flanged end of the pipe is tucked between the turbochargers, behind a number of heat shields and the downpipes.
paras.zh: 对于客户来说，真正的问题是宝马只提供整个总成；该软管无法从经销商处单独购买。水泵侧的软管夹是标准的蜗杆驱动装置，因此很容易拆卸，但另一个夹子是专有的，在不切断它的情况下很难拆卸。最糟糕的是，管道的法兰端塞在涡轮增压器之间，在许多隔热罩和落水管后面。

paras.en: All in all, it’ll take 6.7+ hours to replace this pipe, which feels like a waste if the rubber elbow is the only part that really failed. Thankfully, Rein offers the hose by itself, and it should take only an hour to install.
paras.zh: 总而言之，更换这条管道需要 6.7 个多小时，如果橡胶弯头是唯一真正失效的部件，这感觉就像是浪费。值得庆幸的是，Rein 自己提供了软管，安装仅需一个小时。

paras.en: One of the many hoses which connects to the thermostat and water pump connects to the front of the engine just under the valve cover. This hose is commonly referred to as the “Mickey Mouse hose” due to the unique shape of the flange.
